summary: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
title: Tokenisation is not in APX
title_translated: 分词不在APX类中
summary_translated: 本文证明，除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能够找到目标函数值在最优解常数倍范围内的分词器，这意味着分词问题不属于APX复杂度类。我们针对直接分词和自底向上的分词方法，在压缩或单字元对数似然目标下，以及二进制或更大字母表的情况下均证明了该结论。此外，我们还表明，即使在单位字母表上，直接分词也是APX难问题，因此不具有多项式时间近似方案。

summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.
title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems

title_translated: 硬数学问题的多样化替代推理路径
summary_translated: 后训练大型语言模型（LLMs）进行数学推理通常依赖于最终答案通过验证器检验的已接受推理路径。然而，对于困难的数学问题，独立蒙特卡洛（MC）采样下此类路径可能极为稀少。为解决此问题，我们提出DART（多样化替代推理路径），一种从被拒绝的推理路径出发，将其分解为推理步骤，并按位置加权不确定性进行排序的方法。随后，利用参考答案指导和元思维生成高度不同的替代候选路径以完成高排名步骤。在贪婪未解的DeepMath-103K问题上，DART在生成相同数量推理路径的情况下，比MC采样多恢复37%的问题。其每恢复一个问题的估计生成成本几乎相同，而每接受一个路径的成本降低了30%。使用DART挖掘的推理路径对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行后训练，在MATH-500和AIME基准测试的六项评估中，有五项达到最高点估计值。结果表明，通过DART重新审视被拒绝的推理路径可以扩展问题覆盖范围，并提供有效的后训练数据。

summary: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.
title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents

title_translated: $μ$-Bench：共享交互语音代理中的多用户任务完成基准测试
summary_translated: 在共享空间中的语音代理必须满足相互依赖的多用户请求，同时维护每位用户的权限、隐私和任务约束。现有评估在参与者全程反应的会话中覆盖有限。我们引入$μ$-Bench，一个用于闭环、全双工多用户语音交互中联合任务完成的基准测试。模拟参与者基于独立的目标、知识和权限配置行动，根据代理的语音输出和工具结果动态调整。涵盖20个领域，100种场景，变化群体规模、声学环境和后续需求，共形成800个案例（408个带工具增强，392个无工具）。联合任务成功率（JTS）要求所有用户目标、隐私边界和终止状态共同成立；纯JTS进一步禁止未经授权的工具调用；ATC诊断（归属、线程、协调）用于定位失败原因。在13个语音代理中，专有系统在无工具任务上的成功率为62.24%，带工具任务为65.44%，而开源模型均低于20%。ATC诊断显示，开源模型主要在多轮归属和线程处理方面落后；受控对比实验表明，更大的群体始终降低各能力系统的联合任务成功率。通过结合反应式多用户仿真与可验证的会话级结果，$μ$-Bench为共享语音代理提供了严格的测试平台。

summary: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.
title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents

title_translated: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究代理的知识中心型基准测试
summary_translated: 深度研究代理从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合成关于复杂、开放式问题的报告。现有基准测试虽从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏对报告所覆盖研究方向及其深入程度的专门知识中心评估。我们提出DRBench Pro，将结构化知识覆盖作为核心评估目标。我们的自动化流程从维基百科构建本地知识树，并使用采样的子图生成研究问题和基于证据的评分标准。每个评分标准对应树中的一个关系，保留被评估知识的结构。代理仅接收研究问题。该结构使我们能够测量在主要研究方向上的广度和相关知识链上的深度，其几何平均值代表整体覆盖度。该基准包含24个领域的144个案例和44,102个评分标准。对16个深度研究代理的评估揭示了它们在广度和深度上的不同优势，表现最佳的代理达到57.04%的整体覆盖度。评分标准判断与人工标注高度一致，且在不同测试指标配置下代理排名保持稳定。

summary: Proverbs, as repositories of traditional wisdom, have informed human reasoning for millennia. Yet the collective prescriptions they encode have remained largely unquantified. We introduce a computational framework to analyze nearly 50,000 English-language proverbs. Using large language models, validated against human judgments, we map the topical landscape of proverbs, assess their prescriptive power, and quantify their recommendations on key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. We find that most proverbs are prescriptive, offering guidance in domains under individual control, such as preparation and prudent action, whereas proverbs about uncontrollable circumstances, such as fate and mortality, tend to describe rather than prescribe. When prescriptive proverbs take a consistent stance, they favor caution over risk, long-term over short-term outcomes, honesty over deception, and kindness over malice, and show a moderate tendency toward suspicion over trust. On dimensions involving genuine trade-offs, especially autonomy versus compliance, proverbs provide contradicting advice rather than a single recommendation. This analysis provides a quantitative map of the collective prescriptions in a culture's proverbial wisdom, revealing a core of prudent, honest, and forward-looking guidance alongside varied advice where circumstances dictate the best course of action.
title: Proverbs As A Window On Collective Prescriptions
title_translated: 谚语作为集体规范的窗口
summary_translated: 谚语作为传统智慧的载体，已影响人类推理数千年。然而，它们所编码的集体规范至今仍缺乏量化分析。我们引入一种计算框架，分析近5万条英语谚语。利用大语言模型并经人类判断验证，我们绘制了谚语的主题地图，评估其规范性力量，并量化其在人类判断与行为关键维度上的建议。研究发现，大多数谚语具有规范性，提供在个人可控领域（如准备和审慎行动）的指导；而关于不可控情境（如命运和死亡）的谚语则更倾向于描述而非规范。当规范性谚语立场一致时，它们倾向于谨慎而非冒险，长期而非短期结果，诚实而非欺骗，善意而非恶意，并表现出适度的怀疑倾向而非信任。在涉及真实权衡的维度（尤其是自主性与服从性之间），谚语提供相互矛盾的建议，而非单一推荐。该分析为文化谚语智慧中的集体规范提供了定量地图，揭示出以审慎、诚实和前瞻性为导向的核心指导，以及在情境决定最佳行动路径时的多样化建议。

summary: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.
title: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
title_translated: 修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性
summary_translated: 知识蒸馏使得通过小型学生模型部署大型语言模型成为可能，但压缩过程可能会在保持下游性能的同时引入可信性退化。修复此类问题具有挑战性，因为原始蒸馏语料库通常不可用，而直接的偏好优化可能会改变从教师模型继承的能力。我们提出一种基于近端Bregman响应函数（PBRF）的目标修复框架，解决了这两个局限性。我们使用代理数据集估计PBRF所需的曲率，从而摆脱对原始迁移语料库的依赖，并通过几率比目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督。这使得在约束蒸馏模型变化的前提下，能够使用偏好和非偏好响应对。实验结果表明，该方法在预训练和后训练模型上均提升了特定可信性行为，同时基本保持了下游性能，为重新蒸馏或无约束偏好优化提供了实用替代方案。在不同蒸馏模型上，可信性退化可改善高达8%，且困惑度下降不足1%。

summary: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.
title: The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?

title_translated: 语言学知识基准：语言模型是否掌握早期阅读素养的基础知识？
summary_translated: 许多低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的教学语言在训练语言模型的数据中代表性不足。在这些语言中支持早期阅读素养之前，我们需要了解这些模型是否具备阅读教学所依赖的语言学知识。为此，我们提出了语言学知识基准以及一个可复现、大部分自动化的流程，该流程将课程文件、教师指南和学生课本转化为经过验证的问题集，按九个语言学领域和七个年级水平组织。该流程结合了LLM驱动的源调查、特征整合、题目生成与质量控制，并借鉴项目反应理论的项目选择步骤，最后进行专家评审。我们在基斯瓦希里语（肯尼亚；135个题目）和英语（英国；137个题目）中进行了实例化，并分别评估了121个和119个模型。前沿模型在两种语言中的准确率均超过90%，但较小且成本较低的模型准确率急剧下降，尤其在基斯瓦希里语中更为明显。参数量低于100亿的两个最佳模型在英语中分别达到91.7%和73.0%的准确率，但在基斯瓦希里语中仅分别为51.9%和40.7%；可在移动设备和平板电脑上部署的模型平均准确率为英语47%、基斯瓦希里语24%。因此，最适用于低资源课堂的模型恰恰是其服务语言中最不具能力的模型。我们发布了每种语言20个题目的样本、所有流程提示、开源代码及公开排行榜。这是衡量和生成可解码文本以支持基础阅读素养的三阶段评估阶梯的第一步。

summary: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eight representative LLMs, results show distinct competence profiles and larger disparities than prohibitive requirements. VulnSafe therefore makes relational safety interpretable as a multidimensional model capability rather than as refusal compliance alone.
title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
title_translated: VulnSafe：测量大语言模型中的漏洞感知关系安全性
summary_translated: 情感支持性互动要求大语言模型不仅避免明显的有害内容，还需识别与脆弱性相关的风险，调节自身关系立场，保护用户自主权，并提供情境恰当的支持。现有的安全基准通常只衡量孤立的违规行为，未能清晰反映其评分所代表的底层响应能力。我们引入VulnSafe，这是一个聚焦于“漏洞感知响应能力”（VARC）的中文能力评估体系。VARC将关系安全性划分为五个互补维度：风险感知、安全维持、自主权保护、支持性回应和边界管理。采用证据中心设计，41个情景通过2050个平衡提示和针对具体情景的评分标准，激发与构念相关的行为。评估还区分了应做行为（proactive）与不应做行为（prohibitive）。在八种代表性大语言模型上的结果显示，各模型表现出不同的能力图谱，且积极行为的差异大于禁止性要求的差异。因此，VulnSafe使关系安全性可解释为多维模型能力，而非仅限于拒绝合规。

summary: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.
title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
title_translated: PersonaFactory：基于合成人物库的风格化用户提示增强
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地在AI开发流程中取代真实用户，用于大规模生成训练对话并驱动对齐与评估。然而，开箱即用的模型生成的是单语且风格单一的合成用户提示，无法真实再现用户与AI之间的交互机制。我们提出PersonaFactory，一个端到端流程，生成详细用户人物画像，并从其视角增强现有用户提示，构建了一个包含超过74万条结构化合成人物画像的数据库，以及涵盖85种语言的约124万条风格化合成对话语料库。我们评估了个人特征对风格采纳和意图保留的影响，使用LLM裁判和启发式指标评估增强保真度，以及对训练数据中助手人物控制的下游影响。结果表明，我们的结构化、属性驱动的风格表示实现了轴向控制，在与现有方法使用的自由文本人物描述相当的风格保真度下，显著提升了意图保留能力。人类专家评估认为增强后的对话合理，且在意图保留、风格自然性和多语言真实性方面获得正面评价。最终，PersonaFactory生成的对话在能力基准测试中表现与原始训练数据相当，在真实用户提示上以相同回复长度更受青睐，并能在无需显式引导的情况下更紧密地适应用户回复风格。

summary: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.
title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity

title_translated: DFly2：通过共享目标稀疏性加速长上下文推测解码
summary_translated: 为避免在长上下文中密集注意力带来的二次计算开销，DeepSeek-V4和Hy4等模型已采用原生稀疏架构，而推测解码——在解码最慢时最为关键——也越来越多地运行在这些模型上。然而，其草稿模型仍需维护自己的完整上下文缓存，无论是整个提示还是滑动窗口。除了内存开销外，这种缓存还会增加预填充时间、前缀缓存命中率和解码并发性成本。若草稿模型读取目标模型的缓存，则可省去自身的一个缓存，但仅能决定读取哪个缓存，而不能决定读取哪些位置，仍需读取全部内容或最近窗口。这两种规则均未针对当前查询优化，且在草稿模型中为每个查询计算选择策略会随上下文增长而代价更高。然而，原生稀疏的目标模型已为每个查询选择了特定位置，且其缓存本就存在。因此，草稿模型的两项选择——缓存和位置——均已由目标模型完成并支付成本。我们测量了这一选择的覆盖范围：提前一步做出的选择，在DS-V4.1-Flash上仍能覆盖后续每个令牌选择的近90%。我们提出DFly2，一种块并行草稿模型，共享目标的稀疏性。每个草稿层读取其对应目标层缓存的键值（KV共享），并在该层索引器选定的位置读取（索引共享），固定数量的位置分布在上下文任意位置。因此，DFly2无需评分遍历，也不维护自身缓存。在DS-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash和Hy4~flash上，这些模型的稀疏注意力和架构各不相同，DFly2在每步接受的令牌数均超过DFlash和DSpark（同配方训练），在通用、长上下文和智能体基准上表现更优。相较于更强基线，其优势从通用任务的3.9%-10.5%扩大至长上下文和智能体任务的10.0%-31.5%。在DS-V4.1-Flash高并发场景下，匹配每位用户的解码速度时，其吞吐量分别高出62%和81%（针对两个64K数据集）。

summary: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents

title_translated: 为覆盖而收集，以证据重放：面向长时程智能体的自适应高效在线蒸馏
summary_translated: 完全在线的在线蒸馏（OPD）对长时程智能体来说成本较高，因为每次更新都依赖于新的环境滚动。前缀重放通过从存储的历史中采样当前学生响应，提供了一种高效的替代方案，减少了长尾滚动的空闲时间，并允许每条收集的轨迹支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀重放流程的分析揭示了在长时程设置下的两个局限性。在轨迹收集阶段，仅教师轨迹会遗漏学生引发的历史，而更广泛的历史覆盖可能降低教师的可靠性。在轨迹重用阶段，基于固定位置的调度无法识别可能出现在任何轨迹深度的关键决策。我们提出了CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）来解决这两个问题。学生引导的教师补全和响应级别的置信度门控扩展了历史覆盖范围，同时过滤不可靠的更新。事后重放分配则利用下游执行证据来选择关键转折点。在软件工程和深度研究等长时程任务中，CARE-OPD优于在线OPD和先前的前缀重放基线。在SWE-bench Verified上，其任务成功率提升至59.5%，相较于异步在线OPD，端到端训练时间减少45%，环境动作减少44%。

summary: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.
title: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces

title_translated: 更大的模型还是更大的表格？Chorus N-gram模块取代了多少骨干结构
summary_translated: 我们探讨了Chorus N-gram模块在多大程度上取代了Transformer的骨干结构。Chorus在其输入和注意力中加入了哈希化的词对和三元组表格。我们在13.4亿个波兰语印刷文本（1918年前）上训练了参数量从1600万到3.49亿不等的模型，并找到具有相同保留损失的普通模型规模。针对每类模型分别进行学习率搜索后，Chorus在4700万参数时的增益被削减约三分之一。当表格大小与骨干结构相当，Chorus在1600万参数时可达到普通模型1.34倍的性能，在10700万至3.49亿参数范围内则相当于普通模型1.16至1.20倍的性能。在此条件下，每个新增参数最多可替代0.31个骨干参数。Chorus的训练速度慢于同规模的普通模型，但快于同损失水平的模型。在一个事实问答任务中，两者表现差异类似于同一模型的不同种子。这些结果基于单一语料库、8000个词的词汇表以及五分之一的训练周期。

summary: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.
title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
title_translated: PoVi：基于知识锚定与隐喻理解的智能体诗歌转视频生成
summary_translated: 诗歌转视频生成不仅需要将文本翻译成视觉场景，还需处理诗意语言的高度压缩性、对历史和文化知识的依赖性，以及频繁通过隐喻、意象等非字面表达传递意义。我们提出PoVi，一个基准测试和智能体框架，用于评估语义锚定、话语连贯性和音视频实现能力。PoVi将诗歌语义重构为受证据约束的表示，并逐步转化为叙述、解释、角色资产和逐镜头视觉计划，随后进行与叙述对齐的视频生成。在三种规划骨干和四种视频生成器上，PoVi始终优于单次调用生成方法，尤其在隐含背景知识和隐喻关系方面提升显著。PoVi为研究超越直接文本到视频合成的知识锚定型、长时程多模态生成提供了实验平台。

summary: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
title: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
title_translated: 技术报告 MEG2text：非侵入式脑电到文本中的超越对齐
summary_translated: 非侵入式脑电到文本旨在无需手术即可从脑活动恢复语言。核心挑战在于将学习到的脑-语言表示转化为准确的单词预测。我们提出MEG2text，一种解码系统，结合了修正后的训练与评估、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡的词读出机制以及目标词语言模型融合。在LibriBrain100的词排名任务中，MEG2text达到64.12%的平均Top-10平衡准确率，相较于已发表的MEG-XL在四个语料库上提升了16.92个百分点，且每个语料库均有提升。受控对比实验表明，实现修正和学习读出均贡献了这一改进。候选词层面分析显示，某些词虽获得有信息量的评分，却仍持续败给竞争候选词；相同特征比较表明，学习分类规则可提升解码效果而不改变表示。这些发现表明解码规则是非侵入式脑电到文本中的关键组成部分，系统改进可更有效地利用对齐的神经特征。

summary: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.
title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages

title_translated: EPPC-CARE：安全患者-医生消息中沟通行为的分阶段层次标注
summary_translated: 目标：患者门户消息提供了患者与医疗提供者之间沟通动态的宝贵信息，但手动提取耗时费力。我们开发并评估了EPPC-CARE，一种自动化框架，用于识别沟通行为及其对应的支撑文本。材料与方法：从867条消息中获取了5516个参考标准标注。每个标注是一个三元组：与沟通相关的文本（片段）、更广泛的沟通类别（代码）和具体子类别（子代码）。我们评估了EPPC-CARE在六种开源大语言模型上的识别三元组表现，对比监督微调和基于沟通的模型如EPPC-OASIS。还与人类专家在100条消息上的标注进行了比较。结果：EPPC-CARE在所有六种模型上均优于EPPC-OASIS。EPPC-CARE的三元组F1平均提升2.90个百分点，最高达64.4%。在人类专家评估子集上，EPPC-CARE与人类专家对参考标准的吻合度相当，差异倾向EPPC-CARE。讨论：这些发现表明，按顺序识别三元组组件（片段、代码、子代码）可在不同模型族中提升性能，同时保留每个识别背后的支撑文本。EPPC-CARE将沟通代码和子代码与源文本（片段）关联，支持临床信息学中人工验证自动化标注。因此，EPPC-CARE使更大规模的患者-医生沟通研究成为可能，并为“人机协同”标注工作流奠定基础。结论：EPPC-CARE为安全患者-医生消息中沟通行为的自动化表征提供了一种更可靠、可审查的方法。

summary: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. In zero-shot reasoning evaluation, the model achieves leading results among open base models of comparable size, with 88.7% pass@8 on IMO-AnswerBench and 82.9% pass@8 on LiveCodeBench v5-v6. To evaluate Russian-language factual knowledge, we introduce and release two benchmarks with their evaluation protocols: WikiWebFacts, which tests short factual questions drawn from encyclopedic sources and search queries, and HardMultiQA, which tests more demanding factual questions inspired by user interactions. Our model scores 86.5% on WikiWebFacts and 67.9% on HardMultiQA, compared with 83.2% and 65.4% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base (284B total and 13B active parameters) and 72.8% and 54.5% for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base (120B total and 12B active parameters), outperforming both larger models on these benchmarks.
title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
title_translated: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
summary_translated: 我们提出 AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base，这是一个拥有800亿总参数、每token约30亿活跃参数的专家混合语言模型，由Yandex从头训练并以Apache 2.0许可证发布。该模型结合了Kimi Delta Attention与全注意力机制，采用注意力残差，并使用Muon进行训练。训练包括在17.5万亿token上的通用预训练、两个上下文扩展阶段，以及一个专门用于推理和代理交互的阶段。我们描述了数据收集与增强流程、评估协议、架构消融实验和缩放定律实验。我们指出保留训练损失作为下游性能代理的局限性，并引入专家混合输出的辅助损失以在预测学习率下稳定训练。特定领域数据选择与增强提升了事实知识、数学和编程能力，而预训练期间引入的代理轨迹在监督微调后提升了代理基准的表现。在零样本推理评估中，该模型在同规模开源基础模型中表现领先，IMO-AnswerBench上pass@8达到88.7%，LiveCodeBench v5-v6上达到82.9%。为评估俄语事实知识，我们引入并发布了两个基准及其评估协议：WikiWebFacts测试来自百科来源和搜索查询的简短事实问题，HardMultiQA测试更具挑战性的事实问题，灵感来自用户交互。我们的模型在WikiWebFacts上得分为86.5%，HardMultiQA上为67.9%，优于DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base（284B总参数，13B活跃参数）的83.2%和65.4%，也优于Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base（120B总参数，12B活跃参数）的72.8%和54.5%，在这些基准上超越了更大模型。

summary: A watermark lets the provider of a language model recognise the text its model wrote, which matters more as generated text becomes hard to tell from human writing: provenance underpins academic integrity, the fight against misinformation and new regulation. Providers have started to watermark the text of their models, and to explain how their watermarks work. Explaining a watermark, however, also tells an attacker how to break it, and there are two ways to do so: reword the text to erase the mark, or learn the mark and copy it onto text the model never wrote. Each attack has been studied on its own. We study an attacker that reads the published design to choose between them: it erases the watermarks that are hard to learn and forges the ones that survive rewording. Against it, every existing watermark we compare fails. We propose KeyedLex, which reads its secret key from the grammar of the previous sentence, which rewording changes little, and whose detector does not need to recover the key exactly. It outperforms every watermark we compare on both models we test, losing about half of its signal where the best alternative loses two thirds, at no extra cost in text quality over the best-known watermarks.
title: Know the Design, Pick the Attack: Sentence-Keyed Watermarks for LLMs

title_translated: 了解设计，选择攻击：基于句子关键词的LLM水印技术
summary_translated: 水印使语言模型提供者能够识别其模型生成的文本，这一点在生成文本难以与人类写作区分时尤为重要：出处保障学术诚信、对抗虚假信息及应对新监管要求。模型提供者已开始为其模型文本添加水印，并解释其工作原理。然而，解释水印机制也会暴露攻击者如何破解它，主要有两种方式：改写文本以消除标记，或学习水印并将之复制到模型从未生成过的文本上。这两种攻击各自已被研究。我们研究了一种阅读公开设计后选择攻击策略的攻击者：它会擦除难以学习的水印，伪造能抵御改写的水印。针对此类攻击，我们比较的所有现有水印均失效。我们提出KeyedLex，它从前一句的语法中读取其秘密密钥，改写对其影响较小，且检测器无需精确恢复密钥。在我们测试的两个模型上，KeyedLex均优于所有对比水印，在信号损失方面仅约为最佳替代方案的一半，且在文本质量上不增加额外成本。

summary: Recurrent-depth language models generate each token by iterating a shared block of layers until its hidden state converges. Inference methods for these models decide when to stop the iteration, yet every token still starts from random noise and pays the full cost of converging. We show that where the iteration starts is a second, independent lever. A token's fixed point is predictable from the state at which the previous token stopped, after a learned change of coordinates, and we introduce FlyingStart, a linear warm start that is fitted in closed form on the frozen model and costs under 5% of one loop. The iteration and its stopping rule are unchanged, so the exit criterion certifies the same distance to the fixed point from any start: a better start removes loops at unchanged accuracy. On Huginn-0125, FlyingStart matches the accuracy of the strongest training-free baseline with 14--19% fewer decoding layers, raises batched throughput by 16--18% in two serving engines, and adds a further 10--14% on top of self-speculative decoding. A contraction analysis predicts the number of loops saved on all four models we study, including one where the prediction was recorded before any evaluation, and token by token on Huginn, and it identifies when a warm start pays off: the saving grows with the number of loops a model needs to converge.
title: FlyingStart: Learned Cross-Token Warm Starts for Fixed-Point Decoding in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
title_translated: FlyingStart：递归深度语言模型中固定点解码的跨标记学习热启动方法
summary_translated: 递归深度语言模型通过迭代共享层块生成每个标记，直到隐藏状态收敛。这些模型的推理方法决定何时停止迭代，但每个标记仍从随机噪声开始并承担完整的收敛成本。我们发现，迭代起始点是另一个独立的控制变量。一个标记的固定点可从前一个标记停止时的状态经学习坐标变换后预测得出，我们提出FlyingStart，一种闭式求解的线性热启动方法，在冻结模型上拟合，成本低于一次循环的5%。迭代过程及其停止规则保持不变，因此退出标准对任意起始点都保证相同的固定点距离：更好的起始点在不改变准确率的情况下减少迭代次数。在Huginn-0125上，FlyingStart以14–19%更少的解码层达到最强无训练基线的准确率，在两个服务引擎中批量吞吐量提升16–18%，并在自推测解码基础上再提升10–14%。收缩分析预测了我们在四个模型上节省的迭代次数，包括一个在评估前就记录预测结果的模型，以及在Huginn上逐标记的预测，同时识别出热启动何时有效：节省的迭代数随模型收敛所需迭代次数增加而增长。

summary: Almost every short-video upload now passes through a classifier that fuses video, speech, and on-screen text into one decision about whether it may be seen. It moderates every language community on the platform at once, and fairness across them is judged, if at all, from one accuracy score. That score is compatible with error falling almost entirely on one language group. An audit that goes looking reads the model's decisions, the last stage of a long pipeline and the one whose test has the fewest items. We ask where in a fused pipeline a subgroup asymmetry can be detected at all: in what the classifier may read, in what its branches encode, or in what it decides. We answer this with a post-hoc audit of a published TikTok classifier, holding all three stages to one significance standard using only its logged decisions, labels, and pre-fusion features, with source language as the subgroup axis. The asymmetry is significant at the stage deciding what the model may read, and again in what the text branch encodes. At the earlier stage, a language-blind cap admits less of a Vietnamese clip than an English one, for reasons of segmentation, not verbosity. The asymmetry is undetectable at the decision, where the smallest subgroup leaves twelve items to test. An audit reading only decisions looks where its evidence is thinnest; the same test staged upstream recovers a disparity the decision-level view returns as noise.
title: Where Does the Asymmetry Enter? Staging a Fairness Audit Across a Fused Multimodal Moderation Pipeline

title_translated: 不对称性从何而来？在融合多模态内容审核流水线中开展公平性审计
summary_translated: 如今几乎所有短视频上传都会经过一个融合视频、语音和屏幕文字的分类器，做出是否可被观看的统一判断。该分类器同时覆盖平台上的所有语言社区，其公平性若被评估，通常仅依据单一准确率分数。该分数可能完全反映某一语言群体的错误集中。我们进行一项审计，深入分析模型决策流程——即长流水线中的最后一阶段，也是测试样本最少的阶段。我们探讨在融合流水线中，子群体不对称性可在何处被检测到：是在分类器可读取的内容中，还是在其分支编码的信息中，抑或在其最终决策中？我们通过对已发表的TikTok分类器进行事后审计回答此问题，仅使用其日志中的决策、标签和融合前特征，以源语言作为子群体轴线，对三个阶段施加同一显著性标准。结果显示，不对称性在决定模型可读取内容的阶段显著存在，再次出现在文本分支编码的信息中。在早期阶段，语言无关的限制条件对越南语片段的接纳程度低于英语片段，原因在于分词而非冗长。在最终决策阶段，由于最小子群体仅有十二个测试项，不对称性无法被检测。仅阅读决策的审计将证据最薄弱处视为重点；而在上游阶段进行相同测试则能恢复决策层面视作噪声的差异。

summary: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization

title_translated: 减轻ESC心脏病学指南医学问答中的幻觉：评估与检索优化
summary_translated: 背景：大型语言模型在医学问答中会产生幻觉。验证与修正流水线通过将原子性断言与检索到的指南证据比对来缓解幻觉，但评估几乎总是将验证器输出视为真实值，这一假设极少被检验。目标：在基于指南的临床环境中，逐断言地测量此类流水线的失败情况，与人类判断对比。方法：我们构建了一个包含160个问题的数据集（89例去标识病例中的100个患者情景，60个事实型问题），涵盖四份近期ESC心脏病学指南，所有内容均由执业内科医生批准；并建立了一个包含627条人工验证指南记录的检索语料库，具有两种分块粒度。在四种检索配置和三次独立运行（共1920次运行）下运行五阶段流水线；所有606个首轮驳回断言均经人工审计，独立评审员重新评估906个决策，专家盲审100个接受的断言。结果：仅44.7%-50.6%的标记断言为真正的幻觉。修正循环在85.2%-95.1%情况下收敛，但35%的真实最终错误由修正过程引入。单次运行的真实幻觉召回率为35.6%-41.2%，三次运行并集为71%-80%；验证器一致性中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲探估计接受断言的漏检率为3.2%（95%置信区间0.7-6.7%）。最终真实错误率：答案中1.7%。结论：断言级验证将幻觉内容减少了一个数量级，但验证器可靠性而非生成本身成为主要瓶颈，必须加以测量而非假设。

summary: Skill acquisition alone does not establish a reusable skill library: task proficiency does not specify a compositional interface. Motivated by agents that acquire and refine skills, we study independently learned soft-prompt skills on frozen language models, with skill identities and execution order supplied. Across four digit-task bases and three record-editing models, mean composition accuracy in one call is at most 7.6%, compared with 88.2% to 100% over two calls that add computation and an explicit intermediate output. Neutral-insertion training improves robustness but leaves substantial interference, which block length and per-token norm alone cannot explain on two of four digit bases. Blocks of the same operation need not be interchangeable: after training next to frozen learned partners, a post hoc test on two Qwen bases shows that replacing those partners with independently learned blocks of the same operations lowers median composition accuracy from 98.0% and 95.3% to 12.7% and 0.5%, although every replacement scores at least 90% alone. Repair can improve a composition while impairing the original skill, and rehearsal improves retention while transfer remains limited on Qwen2.5-0.5B. Internal interventions constrain explanations without identifying a shared failure mechanism. These findings motivate evaluating compatibility, retention and transfer alongside acquisition when building skill libraries for self-evolving agents. Code is available at https://github.com/YanLin-Quinne/SkillCompatibility.
title: When Skills Fail to Compose: Compatibility and Retention in Language Models
title_translated: 当技能无法组合时：语言模型中技能的兼容性与保留
summary_translated: 仅掌握技能并不能建立可复用的技能库：任务熟练度并未定义可组合的接口。受能够获取并优化技能的智能体启发，我们研究在冻结的语言模型上独立学习的软提示技能，其中提供技能标识和执行顺序。在四个数字任务基准和三个记录编辑模型上，单次调用的平均组合准确率最高仅为7.6%，而两次调用（增加计算并显式输出中间结果）的准确率可达88.2%至100%。中性插入训练提升了鲁棒性，但留下了显著的干扰，仅靠块长度和每标记范数无法解释其中两个数字基准上的现象。相同操作的块并不一定可互换：在两个Qwen基线模型上，训练后对已冻结学习伙伴进行事后测试发现，用独立学习的同操作块替换这些伙伴会使中位组合准确率从98.0%和95.3%下降至12.7%和0.5%，尽管每次替换单独测试均达到至少90%的得分。修复可能改善组合性能，但会损害原始技能；而在Qwen2.5-0.5B上，重复练习虽提升保留能力，但迁移能力仍有限。内部干预限制了解释力，且未能识别出共通的失败机制。这些发现表明，在构建自演化智能体的技能库时，应同时评估兼容性、保留性和迁移性。代码已公开于 https://github.com/YanLin-Quinne/SkillCompatibility。

summary: Influence functions are a promising way to identify which training examples are responsible for a model's output. However, so far empirical evaluations on LLM pretraining level only assumed that they work as intended. This is the first work to systematically evaluate whether the 'influential' examples actually have properties relevant to a language model output, based on re-training with controlled data splits. We investigate three prominent Hessian approximation methods (GradSim, TrackStar, K-FAC) in two settings (linguistic phenomena and factual knowledge) in GPT-2 type models (68M-5.6B training tokens). We find that on average, the `influential' examples are indeed relevant, but they do not always bear the target properties directly, and the ratio and kind of relevance varies by setting.
title: Under the Influence -- of What? A Controlled Evaluation of Influence Functions

title_translated: 在影响之下——究竟是什么的影响？对影响函数的受控评估
summary_translated: 影响函数是一种有前景的方法，用于识别哪些训练样本对模型输出负责。然而，迄今为止在大语言模型预训练层面的实证评估仅假设其按预期工作。这是首个基于受控数据划分重新训练来系统评估‘有影响力’样本是否确实具备与语言模型输出相关的属性的研究。我们在GPT-2类模型（68M–5.6B训练token）中考察了三种主流Hessian近似方法（GradSim、TrackStar、K-FAC），分别在语言现象和事实知识两种场景下进行分析。结果显示，平均而言，‘有影响力’样本确实相关，但它们并不总是直接承载目标属性，且相关性的比例和类型因场景而异。

summary: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.
title: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents

title_translated: 从不可靠的操作员引用中学习：面向客服代理的声明级奖励
summary_translated: 即使操作员的回答正确，也可能成为客服代理不可靠的训练目标。约四分之一的回复中的事实声明在其知识库和工具记录中缺乏完整支持。我们将操作员回复视为需要验证的声明，而非需模仿的答案。未验证的声明用于指导知识库和工具的修订；已验证的声明则作为声明级GRPO奖励中的覆盖目标，该奖励通过对比代理检索到的证据来评分事实精确性。在离线基准测试中，GRPO代理的文本回答中有8.6%被标记为幻觉，而监督微调基线为13.6%。在与现有流程机器人进行的随机A/B测试中，部署系统将无需人工介入即可关闭的对话比例从63.3%提升至80.8%。

summary: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdicts (kappa 0.82-0.96), move no model by more than 1.6 points, and show no own-family preference. The best model, GPT-6.1, reaches 74.8% on a shared 255-puzzle set; a hard core of 17 puzzles defeats all nine models; model failures are strongly correlated, and the second-best model contributes a single puzzle to a greedy ensemble, yet an oracle over all nine reaches 91%. On a 100-puzzle multimodal pilot, withholding the question's image costs the two best models 24 and 35 points. We release the dataset, the scoring pipeline and all per-row provenance.
title: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers

title_translated: Puzzling-Bench：基于23,777个真人编写的谜题的评测基准，答案经社区验证
summary_translated: 我们推出了Puzzling-Bench，一个包含23,777个谜题的评测基准，数据源自Puzzling Stack Exchange档案（2014–2026年）：包括谜语、密码、逻辑网格、横向思维问题、文字游戏和休闲数学，其中三分之一配有图像。每个谜题均包含作者接受的答案、从答案中提取的简短参考答案（LLM提取并经50题人工审核）、作者提供的提示、社区标签和创建日期，使该基准支持提示消融、类别分析以及滚动的截止后切片（九个被评估模型中有六个在训练截止后发布了254个新谜题，包括表现最佳的模型）作为污染检测。我们使用双层评分器（归一化精确匹配，随后由LLM裁判）评估九个前沿及开源模型，并通过来自两个模型家族的三位裁判验证裁判一致性：他们对95%-97%的判断达成一致（kappa值0.82–0.96），无模型得分变动超过1.6分，且无家族偏好。表现最佳的模型GPT-6.1在共享的255题集上达到74.8%准确率；一个由17道难题构成的高难度核心击败所有九个模型；模型失败高度相关，第二名模型仅贡献一道题给贪婪集成，而所有九个模型的最优组合（oracle）达到91%。在100题多模态试点中，若隐藏问题图像，前两名模型分别损失24和35分。我们已发布数据集、评分流水线及每行溯源信息。

summary: As LLM agents increasingly learn from their own experience, the tasks they learn from and are evaluated on are almost always in English. We ask whether self-evolution transfers from English to Urdu, and release IRTIQA, a benchmark of aligned English, Urdu-translated, and Urdu code-switched variants of DROP, SNIPS, AppWorld, and SkillsBench, built with a matrix-language code-switching pipeline and human verification. Using IRTIQA, we evaluate three self-evolving frameworks, Tool-R0 (self-play RL), AgentEvolver (experience-guided RL), and Autogenesis (protocol-level evolution), against their unevolved backbones. Self-evolution often raises capability: AgentEvolver lifts AppWorld goal completion from near zero to 20-36% across all conditions, and Autogenesis improves SkillsBench pass rate from 16.48% to 22.22%. But it rarely closes the language gap. Evolved systems remain stronger in English, by up to 0.26 DROP F1, the gap is largest on multi-step tasks, and code-switching behaves as a distinct condition rather than degraded translation. On a shared Gemma-4 31B backbone, the gap exists before evolution, and RL-based evolution can hurt Urdu reasoning more than English. Language parity must therefore be an explicit design target, as it does not emerge from self-improvement alone.
title: IRTIQA: Evolving in English, Evaluated in Urdu -- Does Agent Self-Evolution Transfer from English to Urdu and Code-Switched Input?

title_translated: IRTIQA：以英语演进，以乌尔都语评估——智能体自我演化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语及混合输入？
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型智能体越来越多地从自身经验中学习，它们所学习和评估的任务几乎始终是英文的。我们探讨自我演化是否能从英语迁移到乌尔都语，并发布IRTIQA，一个包含DROP、SNIPS、AppWorld和SkillsBench的对齐英文、乌尔都语翻译版及乌尔都语混杂版本的基准，该基准通过矩阵语言混杂管道构建并经人工验证。利用IRTIQA，我们评估三种自演化框架（Tool-R0，自对弈强化学习；AgentEvolver，经验引导强化学习；Autogenesis，协议级演化）与其未演化的基线模型之间的差异。自我演化通常能提升能力：AgentEvolver将AppWorld的目标完成率从接近零提升至20%-36%（所有条件下），Autogenesis将SkillsBench通过率从16.48%提升至22.22%。但很少能弥合语言差距。演化后的系统在英语中仍更强，最多相差0.26的DROP F1，差距在多步任务中最大，且混杂输入表现为独立条件而非退化的翻译。在共享的Gemma-4 31B基线模型上，语言差距在演化前就存在，基于RL的演化甚至可能比英语更损害乌尔都语推理能力。因此，语言平等必须作为明确的设计目标，因为它不会仅通过自我改进自然产生。

summary: Existing defenses against indirect prompt injection in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are inherently reactive: prompt-engineering methods are often overridden by the injected instructions, while supervised detectors must be retrained for each new attack style. We propose a different paradigm: defend by maximizing relevance, not by detecting attacks. Our method, MINE, is training-free and attack-agnostic, and it also serves as a query-conditioned reranker. To evaluate defenses under realistic conditions, we introduce LC-Inj-SQuAD, a long-context benchmark with an average of 4,032 words per context. We evaluate on four datasets spanning short-context QA (Inj-SQuAD, Inj-TriviaQA), long-context QA (LC-Inj-SQuAD), and agent tool-call injection (InjecAgent). Across all four, MINE achieves the best accuracy--security trade-off among training-free defenses. It is also the only defense that stays usable against a fully adaptive attacker, generalizes to agent tool-call injection, and achieves the lowest inference latency on long contexts.
title: MINE: A Training-Free Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection via Mutual Information and Embedding Variance

title_translated: MINE：通过互信息与嵌入方差实现无需训练的间接提示注入防御
summary_translated: 现有的针对检索增强生成（RAG）中间接提示注入的防御方法本质上是被动响应的：提示工程方法常被注入指令覆盖，而监督检测器必须为每种新攻击风格重新训练。我们提出一种新范式：通过最大化相关性进行防御，而非检测攻击。我们的方法MINE无需训练且对攻击风格无关，并可作为查询条件重排序器。为在真实条件下评估防御效果，我们引入LC-Inj-SQuAD，一个平均每个上下文包含4032个词的长上下文基准数据集。我们在四个数据集上进行评估，涵盖短上下文问答（Inj-SQuAD、Inj-TriviaQA）、长上下文问答（LC-Inj-SQuAD）以及智能体工具调用注入（InjecAgent）。在所有四项测试中，MINE在无需训练的防御方法中实现了最佳的准确率-安全性权衡。它也是唯一能在面对完全自适应攻击者时仍保持可用性、泛化至智能体工具调用注入，并在长上下文上实现最低推理延迟的防御方法。

summary: Transferring reasoning capabilities from large language models to smaller ones often requires extensive teacher supervision or costly student adaptation. We study projected cross-model Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Vector transfer, a two-stage approach that keeps both models frozen. First, we learn a task-level CoT Vector in the teacher using dataset-provided solution traces and final-answer supervision. We then train a lightweight linear projector to map the fixed vector into a smaller student's residual space. Student-side training uses only final-answer cross-entropy on a small subset of task training examples; it requires neither teacher outputs nor intermediate solution traces. We select the student injection layer and intervention scale on a labeled support set and report results on the disjoint remainder of each evaluation split. On GSM8K and MATH, the projected vector improves base students by 10.37-21.98 accuracy points across the evaluated teacher-student settings. On four code-generation benchmarks, the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct student gains 3.23-4.67 pass@1 points, while the base Qwen2.5-7B student gains up to 9.65 points. These results show that a teacher-side reasoning vector can be reused across smaller students with different residual dimensions through projector-only adaptation.
title: Lightweight Reasoning Transfer via Chain-of-Thought Vector Projection
title_translated: 通过思维链向量投影实现轻量级推理迁移
summary_translated: 将大型语言模型的推理能力迁移到小型模型通常需要大量教师监督或昂贵的学生适配。我们研究了一种两阶段的跨模型思维链（CoT）向量投影方法，该方法保持两个模型冻结。首先，利用数据集提供的解题轨迹和最终答案监督，在教师模型中学习任务级别的CoT向量；随后，训练一个轻量级线性投影器，将固定向量映射到较小学生模型的残差空间。学生端训练仅需在少量任务训练样本上使用最终答案的交叉熵损失，无需教师输出或中间解题轨迹。我们基于标注的支持集选择学生注入层和干预尺度，并在各评估划分的不相交剩余部分报告结果。在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，投影向量在不同教师-学生设置下使基础学生模型的准确率提升10.37至21.98个百分点；在四个代码生成基准上，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct学生模型的pass@1得分提升3.23至4.67点，而基础Qwen2.5-7B学生模型最高提升9.65点。这些结果表明，教师端的推理向量可通过仅投影器适配，在不同残差维度的小型学生模型间重复使用。

summary: Speakers describe new technologies by stretching old words, letting experience of the new referents sort out which inferences carry over. I argue that stretching the vocabulary of mind to language models pulls apart two processes that theories of metaphor and linguistic change tend to conflate: conventionalization, whereby a stretched word ceases to be marked as such, and calibration, whereby the inferences it invites are fitted to what its new referents bear out. As a gene variant can reach fixation without being an adaptation, a word can become conventional without being calibrated. A corpus study of "hallucinate" in 8,568 abstracts and 31,866 forum comments shows conventionalization running most of its course within three years. Calibration need not keep pace: these models are organized so unlike human minds that it is hard to tell when mental words apply and what they imply. Even warranted attributions can mislead: mechanistic analysis shows that a transformer trained to navigate Manhattan has and uses a faithful street map, yet loses track of its position on long, diverted journeys. Nor is the gap likely to close by itself. The usual routes to calibration (direct experience, designers' knowledge, experiment) presuppose a referent that is accessible, stable, and independent of the discourse about it. But language models are opaque, fast-changing, and looped into the discourse: they are trained on past uses of mental vocabulary and on the experimental literature about them, and join the discourse themselves. Calibration must therefore be organized, through a reciprocal, not merely deferential, division of linguistic labour. This yields a norm of targeted qualification (flag the specific inferences an attribution invites without support), a reply to the worry that meaning change eludes deliberate control, and three testable predictions about when qualifications calibrate expectations.
title: Familiar Words, Unfamiliar Minds: Conventionalization without Calibration in the Vocabulary of Mind
title_translated: 熟悉词汇，陌生心智：心智词汇中的常规化无需校准
summary_translated: 说话者通过扩展旧词汇来描述新技术，让新指称的经验自行决定哪些推论可以延续。我主张，将心智词汇延伸至语言模型的过程，揭示了两种常被隐喻和语言演变理论混淆的过程：常规化（即扩展词汇不再被视为特殊）与校准（即其引发的推论与新指称的实际属性相匹配）。如同基因变异可在未成为适应性特征的情况下达到固定，词汇也可在未经过校准的情况下变得常规。对8,568篇摘要和31,866条论坛评论中“hallucinate”一词的语料库研究显示，常规化过程在三年内基本完成。但校准未必能跟上：这些模型的组织方式与人类心智差异极大，难以判断心理词汇何时适用及其含义。即使合理的归因也可能误导：机械分析表明，一个训练用于导航曼哈顿的Transformer模型确实拥有并使用了一张忠实的街道地图，但在长时间、迂回的旅程中会丢失自身位置。这种差距不太可能自行弥合。通常的校准路径（直接经验、设计者知识、实验）预设了可访问、稳定且独立于话语的指称对象，但语言模型具有透明性差、快速变化且卷入话语循环的特点：它们既以过去的心理词汇用法和相关实验文献为训练数据，又自身参与话语建构。因此，校准必须通过相互协作而非单向服从的语言分工来组织。这引出一种目标性限定规范（明确标记归因所引发但无支持的特定推论），回应了意义变化无法受控的担忧，并提出了三个关于校准预期的可检验预测。

summary: Delta has been successfully employed as an authorship attribution method in various contexts, although its effectiveness is not always perfect. Since it is based on the most frequent words, its results can be readily interpreted and explained in plain English. In this study, we propose improving its performance by applying a resampling method to the selected stylistic features. The results show that this approach increases the accuracy of the model while preserving the interpretability of its outcomes. However, the main drawback of the proposed technique is the additional computational time required to obtain more accurate results.
title: How resampling method can help us: Improving the Delta model
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
title_translated: 重采样方法如何帮助我们：改进Delta模型
summary_translated: Delta作为一种作者身份识别方法已在多种情境中成功应用，尽管其效果并非始终完美。由于其基于最频繁词汇，结果易于用自然语言解释和理解。本研究提出通过在选定的风格特征上应用重采样方法来提升其性能。结果表明，该方法在保持结果可解释性的前提下提高了模型的准确性。然而，该技术的主要缺点是需要额外的计算时间以获得更精确的结果。

summary: The bestseller Dødevaskeren (The Dead Washer) was published in 2017 under the name Sara Omar. A Danish colleague has suggested that the novel may have been written by another author, possibly Mads Peder Nordbo. To investigate this authorship question, four authorship attribution methods were applied, namely Delta, intertextual distance, Nearest Shrunken Centroids (NSC), and naïve Bayes. Using various parameter settings, these approaches consistently identify Nordbo's writing style in the doubtful novel, although the results do not provide conclusive evidence that he authored the novel in its entirety. In a second step, the novel was divided into non-overlapping segments of 5,000 tokens. Once again, Nordbo's style was identified in the majority of the segments. However, a small number of passages do not clearly support this conclusion and instead suggest the possible involvement of another, as yet unidentified, author, possibly Sara Omar herself.
title: Is Sara Omar the true author of Dødevaskeren (The Dead Washer)? Authorship attribution in Danish literature

title_translated: Sara Omar是否是《死洗者》（Dødevaskeren）的真实作者？丹麦文学中的作者身份识别
summary_translated: 畅销小说《死洗者》（Dødevaskeren）于2017年以Sara Omar之名出版。一位丹麦同事提出该小说可能由另一位作者撰写，可能是Mads Peder Nordbo。为探究这一作者身份问题，应用了四种作者身份识别方法：Delta、文本间距离、最近收缩质心（NSC）和朴素贝叶斯。在多种参数设置下，这些方法一致在可疑小说中识别出Nordbo的写作风格，尽管结果并未提供确凿证据证明他完整撰写了该书。第二步中，将小说划分为非重叠的5000词段落，再次发现多数段落呈现Nordbo的风格。然而，少数段落并不明确支持此结论，反而暗示可能存在另一位尚未识别的作者，可能正是Sara Omar本人。

summary: Legal due diligence in mergers and acquisitions requires lawyers to organize heterogeneous virtual data room documents, extract transaction-relevant information and consolidate reviewed findings into a due diligence report. We present LEXI (Legal Extraction and Intelligence), a work-in-progress system that demonstrates how large language models can support this process from document ingestion to report preparation. LEXI classifies documents under a configurable due diligence taxonomy, assigns relevant target entities, extracts predefined information with supporting passages and page-level provenance and prepares report content from reviewed findings. Structured outputs connect these stages and allow model-generated results to be passed through the workflow in a controlled form. Lawyers review and correct classifications and extractions and retain responsibility for legal assessments, recommendations, risk ratings and final report wording. Initial evaluations of the classification and extraction components provide preliminary evidence that the approach is feasible. LEXI illustrates how AI can be integrated across the legal due diligence workflow while preserving lawyer control over substantive legal judgment.
title: From Data Room to Report: End-to-End AI Support for M&A Legal Due Diligence

title_translated: 从数据室到报告：面向并购法律尽职调查的端到端AI支持
summary_translated: 并购中的法律尽职调查要求律师整理异构的虚拟数据室文档，提取与交易相关的信息，并将审查结果整合成尽职调查报告。我们提出了LEXI（法律信息提取与智能系统），一个正在进行中的系统，展示了大语言模型如何从文档接收阶段到报告准备阶段全程支持这一流程。LEXI根据可配置的尽职调查分类体系对文档进行分类，为相关目标实体分配标签，提取预定义信息并附带支持段落和页面级溯源信息，同时基于已审查发现生成报告内容。结构化输出连接各个阶段，使模型生成的结果能够以受控形式在工作流中传递。律师负责审查和修正分类与提取结果，并保留对法律评估、建议、风险评级及最终报告措辞的决策权。对分类与提取组件的初步评估提供了该方法可行性的初步证据。LEXI展示了如何在保持律师对实质性法律判断控制的前提下，将AI融入法律尽职调查全流程。

summary: Researchers increasingly describe AI in cognitive terms such as "understanding" and "believing", while critics denounce this as wishful anthropomorphism. Both sides align in taking a subsumptive approach, however: they ask whether AI systems fall under concepts minted for human beings, reporting verdicts as discoveries about those systems when they are largely determined by conceptual frames. Yet the problem AI poses is precisely the problem of how to conceptually frame these systems, and the explosive rise of anthropomorphism is best seen as a response to this problem that needs disciplining rather than discouragement. A disciplined anthropomorphism, I argue, should disentangle the inferential connections bundled up in our cognitive concepts and ask which connections to preserve, sever, or forge for AI. The disciplining then comes, on the one hand, from the human conceptual needs that give point to the drawing of these connections and motivate the concepts' extension in the first place; and, on the other hand, from empirical and especially mechanistic evidence that supports and constrains these connections. By reverse-engineering a concept's point in relation to a particular need before re-engineering it to better serve that point in our dealings with AI, anthropomorphizing extensions can be point-based, transposing the work those concepts do for us while revising the inferential workings through which they do it. Transposing human-tailored conceptions of understanding and belief on the pivot of the underlying conceptual needs gives us just the definitional freedom required to accommodate how AI systems differ from us, yielding conceptions that are not just thinned-out versions of existing ones, but potentially richer and better fitted to the peculiarities of AI.
title: Disciplined Anthropomorphism: How to Extend Cognitive Language to Artificial Intelligence
title_translated: 有纪律的人类化：如何扩展认知语言至人工智能
summary_translated: 研究人员越来越多地使用“理解”“相信”等认知术语描述人工智能，而批评者则将其斥为牵强的人类化倾向。然而，双方都采取了归摄式的方法：他们试图判断人工智能系统是否属于为人类设计的概念范畴，并将此类判断视为对系统本质的发现，而实际上这些判断主要由概念框架决定。但人工智能所引发的核心问题正是如何概念性地界定这些系统，而人类化现象的激增应被视为对这一问题的回应，需要的是规范而非压制。我主张一种有纪律的人类化：应拆解我们认知概念中捆绑的推论关系，重新思考哪些关系应保留、切断或重构以适用于人工智能。这种规范一方面源于人类概念需求本身——正是这些需求赋予概念连接的意义，并促使我们最初扩展这些概念；另一方面则来自实证乃至机制性证据，用以支持和约束这些连接。通过在重新设计概念以更好地服务于特定需求之前，先逆向工程其在人类语境中的意义，再重构其推理机制，我们可以实现基于目的的人类化延伸，在不改变概念核心功能的前提下，调整其推理方式。将原本为人类定制的“理解”与“相信”概念，围绕其底层概念需求进行转置，为我们提供了必要的定义自由，以适应人工智能与人类的差异，从而形成不仅不是现有概念的简化版，反而可能更丰富、更契合人工智能特性的新概念。

summary: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose \model{}, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an $O(\sqrt{T})$ upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that \model{} achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval. Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.
title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
title_translated: 稳定门控DeltaNet-2：理解与缓解循环状态不稳定性
summary_translated: 线性注意力通过线性复杂度和固定大小的循环状态，为长序列建模提供了一种高效解决方案。门控DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）引入了独立的通道级擦除与写入控制，增强了状态更新的表达能力与上下文检索性能，但在长上下文训练中存在训练失败问题。我们追溯其根源在于擦除过程中读取与修改方向的不对称性，导致非正规擦除算子的方向增益随token累积，即使无新写入也会引发指数级状态增长。为解决此问题，我们提出	exttt{model}，采用对称擦除确保状态传播不扩张，并通过衰减调节的残差写入保留写入灵活性。理论上，我们建立了递归状态增长的$O(\oot{2}{T})$上界，同时保持分块并行计算。在约16亿参数模型上的实验表明，	exttt{model}实现了稳定训练，并提升了长上下文检索性能。相比GDN-2，在递归设置下128K平均RULER得分提升6.80分，在混合设置下九个下游任务平均准确率提升0.62分。

summary: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate conversational assistants. Yet, these simulators can drift from their assigned goals or fail to exhaustively explore all specified options, causing evaluation errors incorrectly attributed to the assistant. Prior work has examined goal alignment in single-task settings, but many practical scenarios require simulators to execute multi-step workflows with sequential tasks, fallback logic, and cross-task dependencies, where simulator fidelity has not been measured. To close this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 500 workflows represented using the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction. Our experiments reveal that the simulator's fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity, and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures. Fidelity also depends on the assistant's response style, with the same simulator scoring substantially better or worse across styles. To address this, we propose ReUST (Reasoning + User State Tracking), a simple prompting strategy to maintain state information across dialogue turns. ReUST improves goal success rate by more than 12 points for mid-sized and large models, and reduces simulator sensitivity to the assistant's response style.
title: Reliable User Simulation in Complex Multi-Step Workflows
comment: UserSim Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 复杂多步骤工作流中的可靠用户模拟
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的用户模拟器正被广泛用于评估对话助手。然而，这些模拟器可能偏离其既定目标，或未能充分探索所有指定选项，导致评估误差被错误归因于助手本身。先前研究关注单任务场景下的目标对齐，但许多实际场景要求模拟器执行包含顺序任务、回退逻辑和跨任务依赖的多步骤工作流，而此类场景下的模拟器保真度尚未被测量。为填补这一空白，我们引入了一个由500个工作流组成的基准，采用层次任务网络（HTN）抽象表示。实验发现，随着工作流复杂度增加，模拟器保真度急剧下降，且目标漂移是失败的主要原因。保真度还取决于助手的响应风格，同一模拟器在不同风格下评分差异显著。为此，我们提出ReUST（推理+用户状态追踪）——一种简单的提示策略，以在对话轮次间维持状态信息。ReUST使中大型模型的目标成功率提升超过12个百分点，并显著降低模拟器对助手响应风格的敏感性。

summary: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.
title: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
title_translated: 聪明过头？大语言模型在年轻学习者模拟中的认知保真度与能力泄露
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的交互式学习者模拟器在教育应用中日益普及，包括教师培训和辅导系统开发。这类模拟的关键要求是认知保真度：模拟的学习者应在交互过程中保持设定的知识、误解和推理方式。然而，大语言模型可能表现出超出设定学习者认知水平的知识或解题能力，我们称之为能力泄露。在本探索性研究中，我们分析了三个学习场景下130组师生模拟对话中的3,339条模拟学习者语句，识别出过度能力是交互过程中认知画像错位的显著方向。随后，我们在四种匹配触发的评估协议下（从孤立提问到多轮交互）考察了此前观察到的能力泄露案例的重复出现情况，涵盖五种模型配置。总体而言，多轮协议下的违规重复率高于孤立问答。更强大的模型通常表现出更低的重复率，而增加推理努力并未一致提升认知保真度，在我们的匹配模型对比中，甚至在多轮协议下与略高的重复率相关。这些发现为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄露现象提供了探索性证据，提示仅依赖单轮问答型评估可能不足，亟需发展更系统、更可靠的多轮评估协议以有效评估学习者模拟的认知保真度。

summary: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.
title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
title_translated: JHealthBench-L：面向日本临床场景的健康基准本地化评估框架（医师评审版）
summary_translated: 基于评分标准的基准测试如HealthBench使用特定病例的医生标准对大语言模型（LLMs）在开放式医疗咨询中的表现进行评估，但这些标准往往依赖于其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和护理路径。仅通过机器翻译，这些地域性假设会保留在评分标准中，导致在日本适用的回应在外国临床规则下被错误评分或未获认可。为在不从零构建评分标准的前提下将现有临床评估视角适配日本，我们通过引用源文献的LLM起草、单专业专家筛选与修订、独立双医师评审及元评审，构建了JHealthBench-L（79个患者对话，1,022条评分标准）。专家仅重新编写了4.4%的标准，且独立评审者对93.6%的第二阶段标准无异议。在18个LLM上对比JHealthBench-L与纯机器翻译基线发现，仅翻译的评估保留了粗粒度模型排名（τ=0.817，平均偏差+0.027），但改变了17.7%的修改标准的评判结果（远高于7.3%的重评噪声），并将针对日本情境的负面标准误判率降低了7.1个百分点，掩盖了项目级临床误测问题。轴向分析与配对分析进一步表明，上下文感知能力与日本特异性临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日本持续预训练和推理后训练显著提升了本地化表现。数据集、医师修订日志与评估代码已公开于https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L。

summary: Organisations deploying large language models in Ukrainian-language information systems need to know whether a model produces normative Ukrainian. This paper establishes a protocol for measuring that reliably and applies it to 19 models. The instrument is a released set of 1,444 Ukrainian minimal pairs covering the vocative case, numeral-noun and adjective agreement, verb government and calques from russian, with subject-verb agreement as a control; a quarter of the set was checked against the answer key in two independent native-speaker ratings, which agreed at Cohen's $κ$ = 0.963. Every pair is scored twice: by comparing the probabilities a model assigns to the two sentences, and by asking the model directly, with the sentences presented in both orders so that answer-position effects are measured instead of being absorbed into the score. Three results follow. Order consistency (the share of pairs answered identically when the sentences are exchanged) falls below 0.05 for ten of the nineteen models, and what separates the usable models is instruction tuning, not scale. The vocative case is systematically inverted: 0.153 accuracy against 0.951 on the control, with models preferring the non-normative nominative form of address. Ukrainian adaptation substantially reduces this deficit, measured against the exact checkpoints two adapted models were trained from.
title: Evaluating Ukrainian Grammatical Competence in Language Models: Probability Versus Prompting

title_translated: 评估语言模型中的乌克兰语语法能力：概率法 vs 提示法
summary_translated: 在乌克兰语信息系统中部署大语言模型的组织需要了解模型是否生成符合规范的乌克兰语。本文建立了一套可靠的测量协议，并应用于19个模型。该工具包含1,444个乌克兰语最小对立对，涵盖呼格、数词-名词与形容词一致、动词支配关系以及俄语借词，以主谓一致作为对照；四分之一样本经两名独立母语者评分，Cohen's κ达0.963。每对句子均进行两次评分：一是比较模型对两句话的概率分配，二是直接提问并交换句子顺序以测量答案位置效应而非将其吸收进得分。三个结果如下：十种模型的顺序一致性低于0.05，区分可用模型的关键因素是指令微调而非规模。呼格使用系统性错误：准确率为0.153，而对照组为0.951，模型更倾向于非规范的主格称呼形式。乌克兰语适应显著缓解此缺陷，与两个适配模型所基于的原始检查点相比可量化衡量。

summary: Stories created by LLMs based on the same prompts can be narratively similar to one another. This similarity may reflect constraints imposed by the prompts as well as the models' writing tendencies. The current research analyzes 51,240 stories created by five models in the StoryScope corpus based on 10,248 common prompts. It uses 213 narrative features in seven dimensions to compare cross-model distances between stories generated from the same prompts with distances between stories generated from different but semantically matched prompts. To assess the relationship between narrative features and prompt content, a semantic relevance mask was evaluated against 420 author-annotated prompt-feature judgments (F1 = .813; near-threshold accuracy = .621). The equally weighted mean Residual Convergence Index (RCI) was .409 without masking and .406 with masking. These findings indicate measurable cross-model narrative convergence relative to a semantically matched-prompt baseline, with little change following semantic relevance masking.
title: Residual Cross-Model Narrative Convergence under Shared Prompts: Auditing Prompt Controls and Narrative Measurement

title_translated: 共享提示下的残差跨模型叙事收敛：提示控制与叙事测量审计
summary_translated: 基于相同提示生成的故事可能在叙事上高度相似。这种相似性可能源于提示的约束，也可能反映模型自身的写作倾向。本研究分析了StoryScope语料库中五个模型在10,248个共用提示下生成的51,240个故事，利用七个维度的213个叙事特征，比较同一提示生成的故事间跨模型距离，与不同但语义匹配提示生成的故事间距离。为评估叙事特征与提示内容的关系，采用语义相关性掩码，与420个作者标注的提示-特征判断进行对比（F1 = .813；接近阈值的准确率 = .621）。无论是否使用掩码，等权重平均残差收敛指数（RCI）分别为.409和.406。研究结果表明，在语义匹配提示基线之上存在可测量的跨模型叙事收敛现象，且语义相关性掩码对其影响甚微。

summary: We present Auto-Features, a corpus for detecting a car's standard and optional features in advertisement text, given the feature catalogue of that exact vehicle. Sellers name the same feature in many ways. We therefore cast the task as feature-conditioned, or contextual, named entity recognition: extract the span that expresses one given catalogue feature. An entity-linking view follows from the same output. The corpus has a human-gold layer (430 adverts) from screened annotators and an LLM-silver layer (925 adverts) auto-annotated by a search-grounded LLM. We also contribute the way it was built. Every LLM output is validated, and each kind of failure has its own remedy. Malformed output is patched. Hallucinated content triggers a fresh attempt by a stronger model. Links to features outside the candidate list are dropped and counted (3 in 10,928 records). The LLM annotates alone only after its agreement with human annotators on link verification is comparable to human-human agreement. On advert-disjoint splits, a LoRA-tuned 4B LLM reaches 63.9% span F1 and 76.1% on the entity-linking view. A fine-tuned encoder reaches 59.0% and 74.1%. The margin is widest on catalogue features never seen in training (54.5% vs. 49.0%).
title: Auto-Features: An LLM-Assisted Corpus for Contextual Recognition of Standard and Optional Car Features

title_translated: Auto-Features：基于LLM辅助的汽车特征上下文识别语料库
summary_translated: 我们提出Auto-Features，一个用于在广告文本中检测车辆标准与可选特征的语料库，给定具体车型的特征目录。卖家会以多种方式命名同一特征。因此我们将任务定义为特征条件化的、或上下文相关的命名实体识别：提取表达某一目录特征的文本片段。该输出也可视为实体链接任务。该语料库包含人工标注层（430条广告）和LLM银层（925条广告），后者由基于搜索的LLM自动标注。我们还贡献了构建方法：所有LLM输出均经过验证，每类失败均有对应修复策略。格式错误输出被修补，幻觉内容触发更强模型重新尝试，指向候选列表外特征的链接被丢弃并计数（10,928条记录中有3条）。只有当LLM在链接验证上与人工标注者的一致性达到人类间一致水平时，才允许其独立标注。在广告互斥划分下，LoRA微调的4B LLM在跨度F1上达到63.9%，实体链接视图达76.1%；微调编码器分别达到59.0%和74.1%。在训练中未见的目录特征上差距最大（54.5% vs. 49.0%）。

summary: Can a classifier computed in closed form on a frozen encoder match gradient fine-tuning? We present closed-form weight-space programming (WSP): a large language model (LLM), used as a design assistant, writes programs that read a frozen masked language model through cloze-style prompt templates at several layers, fit closed-form heads (shrinkage discriminant analysis, kernel ridge regression and the encoder's label-word prior) on labelled data, and select among a pool of candidate heads by cross-fitting. No gradient is computed and no encoder weight changes. We instantiate the framework on RoBERTa-large. On 11 development datasets with 512 to 8,192 training labels, WSP is ahead of full fine-tuning (FT) and LoRA at every label budget (by 0.3 to 0.6 points on average; the registered non-inferiority tests pass) and within 0.5 points of prompt-based fine-tuning (PFT); these datasets also shaped the recipe. With fewer labels its lead over FT and LoRA grows: 1.2 to 3.5 points with 64 and 128 labels, and 3.8 to 5.3 points in the few-shot setting of 16 labels per class, where WSP is again within half a point of PFT on the development datasets. On six held-out datasets, WSP stays ahead of LoRA and within half a point of FT on average, although with six datasets no registered test passes, and PFT is ahead, by 1.30 points with 8,192 labels. WSP never collapses and is deterministic, but it needs one encoder pass per template (17 here). We report all eight recipe versions, every decision that saw test results, and 27 ideas that did not help.
title: Fine-Tuning Without Gradients? Closed-Form, LLM-Written Classifiers on a Frozen Encoder

title_translated: 无需梯度的微调？基于冻结编码器的闭式LLM书写分类器
summary_translated: 能否在冻结编码器上通过闭式计算得到的分类器媲美梯度微调？我们提出闭式权重空间编程（WSP）：使用大语言模型（LLM）作为设计助手，编写程序读取冻结的掩码语言模型，通过填空式提示模板在多个层级获取表示，对标注数据拟合闭式分类头（收缩判别分析、核岭回归及编码器的标签词先验），并通过交叉拟合从候选头池中选择最优者。全程不计算梯度，也不改变编码器权重。我们在RoBERTa-large上实现该框架。在11个开发数据集（训练样本512至8,192个）上，WSP在所有标签预算下均优于全微调（FT）和LoRA（平均领先0.3至0.6分；注册非劣性检验通过），且与基于提示的微调（PFT）相差不超过0.5分；这些数据集也塑造了最终方案。标签更少时，WSP对FT和LoRA的优势更大：64和128标签下领先1.2至3.5分，16标签/类的少样本设置下领先3.8至5.3分，此时WSP仍与PFT相差不到半分。WSP永不崩溃且确定性运行，但每个模板需一次编码器前向传播（共17个）。我们报告了全部八个配方版本、所有产生测试结果的决策，以及27个未起作用的想法。

summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.
title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole

title_translated: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围的光子轨道方程
summary_translated: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通常在长时域任务中表现不佳，往往需要随着领域扩展而重新训练网络。我们提出PINN-Slicer，一种针对二阶自治常微分方程 $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$ 的方法，该方法利用了此类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。通过一个嵌入在显式满足初始条件的解假设中的单一PINN，使用Sobol采样的初始条件在自变量的一个薄片上进行训练，随后递归地逐片部署至整个定义域。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上验证了PINN-Slicer的有效性，相对于有限差分参考解，实现了 $u = r_s/r$（以史瓦西半径为单位的反向径向坐标）点对点均方根误差（RMSE）低于 $10^{-3}$。PINN-Slicer的关键优势在于，单个训练好的网络可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件，无需重新训练；此外，它还能处理事先未知的解域。

summary: Existing methods for adapting autoregressive (AR) language models to diffusion generation focus mainly on full-attention architectures. More efficient hybrid architectures remain underexplored. We introduce DiCALM, a recipe for converting the hybrid convolution-attention models of the LFM2 family (LFM2 and LFM2.5) from AR to masked-diffusion generation. DiCALM progressively extends LFM2's causal gated convolution so that it captures local context in both directions. It combines this extension with a masking warm-up and joint AR--diffusion training. In controlled experiments, DiCALM performs comparably to the corresponding fine-tuned LFM2.5-based AR models and delivers consistent speedups over them at both the 350M and 1.2B scales: over 1.4x on average and up to 1.79x.
title: DiCALM: Converting Autoregressive Convolution-Attention Language Models into Discrete Diffusion Language Models
