title_translated: DiCALM：将自回归卷积-注意力语言模型转换为离散扩散语言模型
summary_translated: 现有将自回归（AR）语言模型适配为扩散生成的方法主要集中在全注意力架构上，而更高效的混合架构仍缺乏探索。我们提出了DiCALM，一种将LFM2系列（LFM2和LFM2.5）的混合卷积-注意力模型从自回归转换为掩码扩散生成的方案。DiCALM逐步扩展LFM2的因果门控卷积，使其能够双向捕捉局部上下文；结合掩码预热机制与自回归-扩散联合训练。在受控实验中，DiCALM的表现与对应的微调后的LFM2.5自回归模型相当，并在3.5亿和12亿参数规模下均实现显著加速：平均提速超过1.4倍，最高达1.79倍。

summary: Spoken narratives extensively connect moment-to-moment language processing with knowledge accumulated through language and literacy experience. This study examined that relationship using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) during Cantonese story listening and contextual representations from large language model (LLM). The imaging cohort comprised 23 school-age children; 16 contributed complete standardized literacy and language assessments and served as held-out participants in a nested cross-subject encoding analysis of the same story. Contextual embeddings predicted distributed narrative responses, with prominent correspondence in temporoparietal and default-network parcels. Regional summaries of the top 25% of voxels ranked by held-out correlation yielded atlas-wide means of r=0.174 and partial R2=0.0165. A joint feature model identified negative surprisal and positive predictive-entropy coefficients across cortical and subcortical parcels, including control, salience, hippocampal and amygdalar regions. Higher word-dictation and overall literacy scores were associated with lower regional encoding performance. Higher Cantonese grammar scores were associated with more negative semantic-update coefficients in parietal control, somatomotor and dorsal-attention parcels. Together, these findings connect language and literacy skills to the regional strength and direction of neural coupling with narrative context. They position naturalistic context processing as a possibly measurable link between oral comprehension and literacy in childhood.
title: Contextual language representations link narrative processing to language and literacy in children
title_translated: 情境化语言表征将叙事加工与儿童的语言和读写能力联系起来
summary_translated: 口语叙事广泛连接即时的语言处理与通过语言和读写经验积累的知识。本研究通过在粤语故事聆听过程中使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）以及大型语言模型（LLM）提取的情境化表征，探讨了这一关系。影像队列包含23名学龄儿童；其中16名完成了完整的标准化读写与语言评估，并作为嵌套跨被试编码分析中的保留参与者，分析同一故事的响应。情境嵌入能预测分布式的叙事反应，尤其在颞顶叶和默认网络区域表现出显著对应。基于保留相关性排名前25%的体素区域总结得出，全脑平均相关系数r=0.174，偏R²=0.0165。联合特征模型识别出皮层与皮层下区域（包括控制、显著性、海马及杏仁核区）中负意外度与正预测熵系数。更高的单词听写和整体读写分数与更低的区域编码性能相关。更高的粤语语法分数则与顶叶控制区、躯体运动区和背侧注意区中更负的语义更新系数相关。这些发现将语言与读写能力与神经耦合的区域强度和方向联系起来，表明自然情境处理可能是儿童口头理解与读写能力之间一个可测量的联结。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in chemical knowledge and reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether they can solve problems whose answers must be discovered through experimentation. We investigate this question through Unknown Chemical Identification, where a model must actively design experiments, interpret observations, update hypotheses, and ultimately identify a hidden substance. We introduce ChemDeduce, an interactive evaluation framework for assessing LLMs through simulated experiments. ChemDeduce formulates chemical identification as a sequential decision process and provides a stateful simulated laboratory with explicit instrument and operational constraints, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation of iterative experimental reasoning. We benchmark eight frontier LLMs on 200 chemicals, yielding 1600 model--target pairs and 4800 episodes over three independent repetitions, and evaluate identification accuracy, operational compliance, interaction efficiency, and trajectory-level reasoning quality. Despite generating seemingly plausible experimental plans, current models achieve an average identification accuracy ranging from 23.83% to 67.33%, revealing substantial limitations in experiment selection, evidence interpretation, and sequential hypothesis refinement.
title: ChemDeduce: Benchmarking LLMs for Unknown Chemical Identification through Interactive Simulated Experiments
title_translated: ChemDeduce：通过交互式模拟实验基准测试LLMs对未知化学物质的识别能力
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在化学知识与推理方面表现出色，但尚不清楚它们是否能通过实验发现来解决答案必须通过实验探索的问题。我们通过“未知化学物质识别”问题探究这一疑问，即模型需主动设计实验、解释观察结果、更新假设并最终识别隐藏物质。我们引入ChemDeduce，一个通过模拟实验评估LLMs的交互式评测框架。ChemDeduce将化学识别建模为序列决策过程，并提供具有明确仪器与操作约束的状态化模拟实验室，支持可扩展且可复现的迭代实验推理评估。我们在200种化学品上对8个前沿LLMs进行基准测试，生成1600个模型-目标对和4800个实验回合（三次独立重复），评估识别准确率、操作合规性、交互效率及轨迹级推理质量。尽管模型生成看似合理的实验计划，当前模型的平均识别准确率仅为23.83%至67.33%，暴露出在实验选择、证据解读和序列假设修正方面的显著局限。

summary: Standalone reranker quality does not determine its value in a multistage RAG pipeline. We systematically study heterogeneous rerankers composed without joint training, spanning lexical, single-vector, late-interaction, and joint query-context scoring. Two lightweight semantic coarse scorers, Cache-Pointwise and Cache-Shapley, learn from passage relevance labels and share cacheable representations and linear-time singleton inference. Under matched candidates and budgets, we compare cascades with stage-removal references to measure evidence retention, repair and breakage, reader accuracy, and online pruning cost. On NoLiMa 32K with Gemma, inserting these scorers before CrossEncoder or Provence improves answer accuracy by 4.02-9.43 percentage points while accelerating online pruning by 1.57-1.88x relative to the corresponding reranker alone. Cache-Pointwise composed with ColBERTv2 through reciprocal rank fusion improves accuracy by 4.60 points at 1.36x speedup over direct ColBERTv2. The stage-removal comparisons reveal an asymmetry: a cascade can outperform its final reranker alone while underperforming its coarse selector alone. Two readers, a second multi-hop dataset, and three-stage extensions show that the gains depend on the reader, reranker pairing, and stage configuration. These findings demonstrate a practical route to better and faster reranking without joint training and motivate studying stage order, candidate budgets, and rank fusion as determinants of composition quality.
title: When Rerankers Work Together: Better and Faster Reranking without Joint Training
title_translated: 当重排序器协同工作时：无需联合训练即可实现更好更快的重排序
summary_translated: 独立重排序器的质量并不决定其在多阶段RAG管道中的价值。我们系统研究了不进行联合训练的异构重排序器组合，涵盖词法、单向量、后期交互以及查询-上下文联合评分等类型。两种轻量级语义粗排器Cache-Pointwise和Cache-Shapley从段落相关性标签中学习，共享可缓存表示和线性时间的单例推理。在匹配候选集和预算条件下，通过移除阶段的对比基准，衡量证据保留、修复与破坏、阅读器准确率及在线剪枝成本。在NoLiMa 32K数据集上使用Gemma模型，将这些粗排器插入CrossEncoder或Provence之前，使答案准确率提升4.02至9.43个百分点，同时在线剪枝速度提升1.57至1.88倍。Cache-Pointwise与ColBERTv2通过倒数排名融合组合后，准确率提升4.60点，速度提升1.36倍，优于直接使用ColBERTv2。阶段移除对比揭示出不对称性：一个级联结构可能优于其最终重排序器，却劣于其粗排选择器。两个阅读器、第二个多跳数据集及三阶段扩展表明，收益取决于阅读器、重排序器配对及阶段配置。这些发现展示了无需联合训练即可实现更优更快重排序的实用路径，并推动研究阶段顺序、候选预算和排序融合作为组合质量的决定因素。

summary: Massively multilingual translation models usually have one tag per language and no control over regional varieties, and they cover a region's smaller languages poorly or not at all. We report three fine-tunes of MADLAD-400-3B-MT, each adding target tags with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), back-translation of monolingual text and replay of the base model's own translations: <2es_ES> for Spanish as written in Spain, <2es_419> for Latin American Spanish, and one model for three Romance languages of the Iberian Peninsula, Asturian (<2ast>), Aragonese (<2an>) and Aranese (<2oc_aranes>). For the Spanish varieties we annotate the 250.9M documents of MADLAD-400's Spanish split with a domain-supervised Spain vs. Latin America classifier and select variety text with a rule that admitted no Latin American document in a 340-document reference set. The Castilian model chooses Spain's everyday vocabulary in 97% of a targeted test (base model 62%) and vosotros for informal plural address in 70% (10%), while improving chrF++ on human references. A first finding is tag collapse: with a new tag initialised from <2es>, the parent tag drifts to the new variety (84-87% identical outputs). In the Iberian model, contrastive pairs and a separate learning rate for the tag embeddings keep each tag in its own language. Trained only on publicly available data, mostly the TAN-IBE Wikipedia corpora, the Iberian model matches or beats the TAN-IBE Marian systems in four of six Spanish directions on FLORES+, is 1.9 BLEU behind in Spanish->Aranese, and is second only to SalamandraTA-7B in most directions. The exception, Spanish->Aragonese, reflects a difference of written variety between Aragonese Wikipedia and the FLORES+ reference, not model quality. All three fine-tunes lose 0.6-0.7 chrF++ on average in thirteen other FLORES-200 directions. We release the models, data and variety classifier under open licences
title: Teaching a Multilingual Translation Model Regional Varieties: Castilian and Latin American Spanish, Asturian, Aragonese and Aranese with MADLAD-400-3B-MT

title_translated: 教学多语言翻译模型的地区变体：西班牙语（卡斯蒂利亚与拉丁美洲）、阿斯图里亚斯语、阿拉贡语和阿兰埃斯语，基于MADLAD-400-3B-MT
summary_translated: 大规模多语言翻译模型通常对每种语言仅使用一个标签，且无法控制地区变体，对较小地区语言的覆盖也较差或完全缺失。我们报告了MADLAD-400-3B-MT的三次微调，每次通过低秩适应（LoRA）、单语文本的反向翻译以及基础模型自身翻译的重放添加目标标签：分别用于西班牙本土西班牙语（<2es_ES>）、拉丁美洲西班牙语（<2es_419>），以及一个涵盖伊比利亚半岛三种罗曼语的语言模型——阿斯图里亚斯语（<2ast>）、阿拉贡语（<2an>）和阿兰埃斯语（<2oc_aranes>）。针对西班牙语变体，我们使用领域监督的西班牙 vs. 拉丁美洲分类器对MADLAD-400的西班牙语数据集中的2.509亿文档进行标注，并通过规则筛选出不包含任何拉丁美洲文档的340个文档参考集。卡斯蒂利亚模型在目标测试中以97%的比例选择西班牙日常词汇（基线模型为62%），在非正式复数称呼中使用vosotros的比例达70%（基线为10%），同时在人类参考下的chrF++得分提升。一个初步发现是标签坍缩现象：当新标签从<2es>初始化时，父标签会漂移到新变体（84-87%输出相同）。在伊比利亚模型中，对比对和标签嵌入的独立学习率使每个标签保持在其对应语言范围内。该模型仅使用公开数据（主要是TAN-IBE维基百科语料库），在FLORES+的六个西班牙语方向中有四个表现优于或匹配TAN-IBE Marian系统，仅在西班牙语→阿兰埃斯语方向落后1.9 BLEU，且在多数方向仅次于SalamandraTA-7B。例外情况（西班牙语→阿拉贡语）源于阿拉贡语维基百科与FLORES+参考之间的书面变体差异，而非模型质量。所有三个微调模型在其他十三个FLORES-200方向上平均损失0.6-0.7 chrF++。我们已将模型、数据和变体分类器以开源许可发布。

summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have shown strong performance on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, Trip Planning, and Countdown. MDMs introduce a freedom in the order in which tokens may be unmasked, and to exercise this freedom for good accuracy, early decoding strategies relied on signals of confidence or the downstream impact of decoding a token. However, simple examples seem to illustrate that resolving a token's dependencies before unmasking it should be important. Therefore, we examine whether this principle, which we call dependency-ready decoding, would contribute to better accuracy, from a practical and a theoretical perspective. We examine a recent decoder that implements dependency-readiness through attention, and generally find that when it performs better than confidence-based or future utility baselines, its decoding order collapses to left-to-right decoding. For theoretical analysis, we establish a definition of dependency without resorting to attention, measured by an information-theoretic score of how much revealing a single masked token (or a set) would shift the model's prediction for another. We prove that when the margin is large relative to this score, no such revelation can change the top prediction, so in this regime Maximum-Margin decoding already commits dependency-ready tokens. These findings leave only a narrow scope for future dependency-ready decoders: their potential benefit is limited to positions with margins smaller than the information-theoretic sensitivity, and reliance on attention should be questioned.
title: Pitfalls of Dependency-Ready Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models

title_translated: 掩码扩散语言模型中依赖就绪解码的陷阱
summary_translated: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）在结构化推理任务（如数独、行程规划、倒计时）中表现出色。MDMs允许以任意顺序解掩码token，为了获得高精度，早期解码策略依赖于置信度信号或解码token的下游影响。然而，简单示例表明，在解掩码前解决token依赖关系应至关重要。因此，我们从实践和理论角度考察‘依赖就绪解码’这一原则是否能提升准确性。我们分析了一种近期通过注意力实现依赖就绪性的解码器，发现当其优于基于置信度或未来效用的基线时，其解码顺序往往退化为从左到右的解码。在理论分析方面，我们提出一种不依赖注意力的依赖性定义，通过信息论评分衡量揭示单个掩码token（或一组）会对另一个token的预测产生多大影响。我们证明，当边际值相对于该评分较大时，任何此类揭示都无法改变最高预测，因此在此区间内最大边际解码已自动完成依赖就绪。这些发现表明，未来依赖就绪解码器的潜在收益空间极为有限：其优势仅存在于边际值小于信息论敏感度的位置，且对注意力机制的依赖值得质疑。

summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in Japanese-language settings, yet multimodal safety evaluation has been largely English-centric. We extend the Multimodal Safety Test Suite (MSTS) of Röttger et al. (2025) to Japanese as the 12th language, contributing 320 machine-translated and post-edited cases with reference answers plus 82 culturally localized Japanese images. We introduce an evaluation framework that (i) extends MSTS's 3-class safety grouping with a 5-point scale that also rewards useful (not just safe) responses, and (ii) separates image recognition from safety judgment to isolate recognition errors. Using this framework, we evaluate five modern Japanese VLMs (Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5, InternVL3, LLM-JP-4-VL, Qwen3-VL) against human evaluation, and find substantial variance in the safety readiness across the models. Finally, we evaluate two LLM-as-a-Judge models and find that providing a reference answer improves agreement with human safety judgments, though recall for detecting unsafe responses remains limited, underscoring the difficulty of automating multimodal safety evaluation. The dataset created for our study will be released upon publication.
title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Japanese

title_translated: 日语视觉-语言模型的多模态安全评估
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在日语环境中的部署日益增多，但多模态安全评估仍主要以英语为中心。我们将Röttger等人（2025）提出的多模态安全测试套件（MSTS）扩展至日语，成为第12种语言，贡献了320个机器翻译并人工润色的案例及参考答案，以及82张文化本地化的日语图像。我们引入一个评估框架，（i）在MSTS的三类安全分组基础上扩展为五级评分体系，不仅奖励安全响应，也奖励有用性；（ii）将图像识别与安全判断分离，以隔离识别错误。利用该框架，我们对五个现代日语VLM（Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5、InternVL3、LLM-JP-4-VL、Qwen3-VL）进行了人类评估对比，发现各模型间安全准备程度存在显著差异。最后，我们评估了两个LLM作为裁判模型的表现，发现提供参考答案可提高与人类安全判断的一致性，但检测不安全响应的召回率仍然有限，凸显了自动化多模态安全评估的困难。本研究创建的数据集将在发表后公开。

summary: Social-deduction games give models opposing objectives, but they also give roles different information and speaking obligations. We analyze 5,404 public utterances from 150 Chinese Werewolf games played by 12 models, comparing ordinary wolves with ordinary villagers so that special roles are excluded. Private knowledge and goals still differ, and no utterance is verified as true or false. After model and length adjustment, wolf utterances score higher on both certainty and uncertainty (coefficients +0.074 and +0.072). Emotional intensification has the largest rank-biserial effect (r = .145), but it depends on a single degree marker and correlates weakly with human-rated affect. Three annotators' ratings of 392 utterances show higher wolf scores on four behavioral dimensions, and five LLM judges reach 60.8%-70.2% accuracy on a shared evaluation set. In a generation probe that prompts six models with a wolf identity but a villager speaking goal under fixed public context, certainty (+0.164) and emotional intensification (+0.095) increase. These findings describe role-associated language rather than verified lying, and they argue for explicit comparison groups and lexicon sensitivity checks in game-based deception evaluation. Data and code are available at https://github.com/justinchoi929/Tells-of-a-Lying-Machine
title: Tells of a Lying Machine: Analyzing LLM-Generated Strategic Dialogue in Chinese Werewolf

title_translated: 说谎机器的线索：分析中文狼人杀中LLM生成的战略对话
summary_translated: 社交推理游戏赋予模型对立目标，但也赋予不同角色不同的信息和发言义务。我们分析了12个模型在150场公开中文狼人杀游戏中产生的5,404条发言，比较普通狼人与普通村民的发言，排除特殊角色。尽管私有知识和目标仍存在差异，且无任何发言被验证为真或假。经过模型和长度调整后，狼人发言在确定性和不确定性两个维度上的得分均更高（系数分别为+0.074和+0.072）。情感强化具有最大的等级双样本效应（r = .145），但其依赖单一程度标记，且与人类评定的情感强度相关性较弱。三位标注者对392条发言的评分显示，狼人在四个行为维度上得分更高，五名LLM裁判在共享评估集上的准确率达60.8%-70.2%。在一项生成探测实验中，提示六种模型以狼人身份但以村民说话目标，在固定公共语境下，确定性（+0.164）和情感强化（+0.095）均上升。这些发现描述的是角色相关的语言特征，而非经证实的说谎行为，强调在基于游戏的欺骗评估中应设立明确的对照组并检查词表敏感性。数据与代码可在https://github.com/justinchoi929/Tells-of-a-Lying-Machine 获取。

summary: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.
title: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment

title_translated: NORMCRAFT：面向上下文感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
summary_translated: 文化对齐要求大语言模型（LLMs）从场景及其文化背景中推断常被隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常通过微调单个模型或引入外部文化知识，而将规范推断与下游响应生成独立学习的研究仍不充分。我们提出NORMCRAFT，一种模块化框架，将规范推断与响应生成解耦。通过以规范为中心的多视角监督，我们训练一个LLM作为规范生成器，无需下游响应标签即可从前景、遵守和违反场景中恢复共享规范。生成的规范指导一个独立的冻结LLM（响应者）。以Qwen3.5-4B作为响应者，NORMCRAFT在五个下游指标中的四项上优于提示法和监督微调（SFT）基线。在SafeWorld任务中，其响应更频繁地反映参考规范（覆盖率）且更精确（忠实度），分别超过响应者SFT 18.0和14.1个百分点。直接规范评估也显示其生成规范质量高于基础模型和少样本生成器。同一训练好的生成器在跨14个冻结LLM（涵盖五个模型家族，参数量0.8B至27B）上提升了文化对齐效果，尤其在最小模型上增益最大。

summary: Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence.   We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning and tool orchestration, and a unified Feedback Engine connecting online execution with offline evolution. The engine assesses responses and execution trajectories, verifies factual claims, diagnoses failures, and generates evolution signals. Model evolution combines SQL-to-Question Scaling for coverage expansion with Graph-Guided Scaling for error-targeted synthesis. Generated questions undergo trajectory distillation and quality filtering for iterative supervised fine-tuning, followed by a separate Post-RL stage. Harness evolution translates recurrent failures into bounded prompt and skill updates, validated through independent audits, execution replay, and regression testing. Performance-tolerance checks guard against unacceptable degradation during simplification.   The resulting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-based model outperforms Qwen3.8-Max on sports question answering and analysis while achieving approximately three times the inference efficiency. Across 30 harness-evolution rounds, the aggregate performance score improves by 10.8 points. In a live sports analytics product, the evolved system improves factual correctness by 10.5 points and average response length, a proxy for answer richness, by 158.1%, while reducing average latency by 41.3% relative to the baseline.
title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics

title_translated: 体育智能体：一种用于对话数据分析的自演化系统
summary_translated: 对话式体育分析需要低延迟、基于证据的准确响应。查询分布、数据资源和模型行为的变化会损害静态智能体配置，因此需要基于运行时证据的受控演化。我们提出Sports Agent，一个集成代理SQL模型（用于结构化数据推理）、规划与工具编排框架以及统一反馈引擎的自演化框架。该引擎评估响应和执行轨迹，验证事实声明，诊断失败并生成演化信号。模型演化结合了SQL到问题的扩展以扩大覆盖范围，以及基于图的扩展以针对性合成错误修复。生成的问题经过轨迹提炼和质量过滤，用于迭代监督微调，随后进入独立的后强化学习阶段。框架演化将重复失败转化为有界提示和技能更新，通过独立审计、执行回放和回归测试进行验证。性能容差检查防止简化过程中的不可接受退化。基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的最终模型在体育问答与分析任务上优于Qwen3.8-Max，同时推理效率提升约三倍。在30轮框架演化中，综合性能得分提升了10.8分。在实际体育分析产品中，演化后的系统使事实正确性提升10.5分，平均响应长度（作为答案丰富度的代理）提升158.1%，平均延迟相比基线降低41.3%。

summary: The Locate-Then-Edit framework enables efficient knowledge updates in large language models without requiring full retraining. Recent research has increasingly focused on sequential editing, where knowledge arrives continuously and the model is updated incrementally. However, existing sequential methods commonly suffer from catastrophic forgetting and model collapse after only a few hundred edits. In contrast, batch editing - which jointly optimizes all edits and yields the optimal solution under a specified editing objective - can support tens of thousands of edits with high edit efficacy while preserving the model's general capabilities, resulting in a substantial performance gap between the two editing paradigms. In this paper, we demonstrate that this gap can be closed via a batch-equivalent sequential editing approach. Moreover, we investigate the underlying mechanism of model degradation in existing sequential methods by analyzing the convergence behavior of weight perturbations as edits accumulate. Our analysis reveals that current methods typically exhibit linear or logarithmic growth in perturbation, whereas the proposed batch-equivalent method achieves time-invariant growth, thereby theoretically guaranteeing long-term stability and preserving the integrity of pretrained knowledge throughout massive-scale sequential editing.
title: Rethinking Sequential Locate-Then-Edit: Optimality and Stability

title_translated: 重新思考顺序定位-编辑：最优性与稳定性
summary_translated: 定位-编辑框架可在无需完整重训练的情况下实现大语言模型的知识高效更新。近期研究日益关注顺序编辑，即知识持续到来并逐步更新模型。然而，现有顺序方法通常在仅数百次编辑后便出现灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃。相比之下，批量编辑——联合优化所有编辑并达到指定编辑目标下的最优解——可支持数万次编辑，保持高编辑有效性的同时保留模型的通用能力，导致两种编辑范式间存在显著性能差距。本文证明，通过一种等效于批量编辑的顺序编辑方法，这一差距可以被弥合。此外，我们通过分析权重扰动随编辑累积的收敛行为，探究了现有顺序方法中模型退化的根本机制。分析表明，当前方法通常表现出线性或对数增长的扰动，而所提出的等效批量方法则实现时间不变的增长，从而理论上保证长期稳定性，并在大规模顺序编辑过程中始终保护预训练知识的完整性。

summary: Bias audits of conversational models often discard refusals (responses such as "I can't assist with that request") before scoring, a filtering step which is rarely examined as a measurement decision even though it determines which responses an audit is capable of evaluating. This work examines what the step removes, applying seven bias-evaluation instruments spanning both deployed paradigms, three dictionary-based and four LLM-as-judge, to two intersectional datasets of 360 generated responses each. In both datasets, the filter removed a demographically skewed subset produced entirely by one of the three responder models, which refused North Korean prompts at 2.15 times the rate of American prompts on declarative content and 1.76 times on operational content. We then remove the filter and pass every refusal to all seven instruments. Bias-Lexicon scores refusals as clean, and including them shrinks the nationality disparity it reports. HurtLex appears to register the disparity, but we trace this entirely to a single lexicon entry matching the token "can" in "I can't". The LLM judges either flag most responses or rate refusals as unbiased. For the two judges that discriminate, including refusals lowers the nationality disparity they report, and no instrument identifies the refusal disparity. The failure is therefore a coverage limit upstream of scoring rather than a calibration gap that a better lexicon or judge prompt would be expected to close, which makes the behavioral channel an instrument is sensitive to a question of construct validity rather than one of method selection.
title: Refusal Is Not Scored: A Coverage Limit in Content-Based Bias Evaluation

title_translated: 拒绝不计分：基于内容的偏见评估中的覆盖局限
summary_translated: 对话模型的偏见审计通常在评分前剔除拒绝响应（如“我无法协助该请求”），这一过滤步骤虽决定审计可评估的响应范围，却极少被当作测量决策进行审视。本研究考察该步骤移除了什么内容，采用七种偏见评估工具（涵盖两种部署范式，三种基于词典的方法和四种以大模型为裁判的方法），对两组各360个生成响应的交叉数据集进行分析。在两个数据集中，该过滤步骤移除了由三个响应模型之一产生的具有人口统计学偏差的子集，该模型对朝鲜相关提示的拒绝率分别比美国提示高出2.15倍（陈述性内容）和1.76倍（操作性内容）。随后我们移除过滤步骤，将所有拒绝响应提交给全部七种工具。Bias-Lexicon将拒绝响应视为无偏，包含它们后缩小了其报告的国籍差异；HurtLex似乎检测到了差异，但我们发现这完全源于一个匹配“can”的词典条目。以大模型为裁判的工具要么标记大多数响应，要么将拒绝响应评为无偏。对于两个具有区分性的裁判，包含拒绝响应反而降低了其报告的国籍差异，且没有任何工具识别出拒绝差异。因此，问题在于评分之前的覆盖局限，而非可通过更优词典或裁判提示弥补的校准差距。这使得工具敏感的行为通道成为构念效度问题，而非方法选择问题。

summary: Knowledge distillation has recently proven highly effective for improving autoregressive models, but its applicability to DLMs remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic study of KD for DLMs and uncover two non-intuitive failures of classical forward-KL (FKL) distillation: (i) student perplexity does not improve monotonically with more teacher-generated data, and (ii) on the same teacher-generated corpus, FKL distillation underperforms simply training the student with the original DLM denoising objective. To address them, we propose a unified, data-free distillation framework for masked DLMs. First, the framework runs an off-policy distillation phase that absorbs general knowledge from a static set of teacher-generated data. Then, the framework employs on-policy distillation which consists of three techniques: a trajectory loss along the student's own reverse process, confidence reweighting that down-weights tokens where the teacher is unsure, and a trust-region anchor that stabilizes the moving target. On MDLM, the resulting student attains a GPT-2 perplexity of $24.75$, surpassing the teacher's $27.04$; on Dream-7B distillation to a 93M student model, the framework reduces Qwen-2.5 perplexity from the FKL-distilled baseline of $25.23$ to $19.83$ while preserving performance on zero-shot general capability benchmarks.
title: Rethinking Knowledge Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: 重新思考扩散语言模型的知识蒸馏
summary_translated: 知识蒸馏在提升自回归模型方面已被证明非常有效，但其在扩散语言模型（DLMs）中的适用性仍不清楚。我们首次对DLMs的知识蒸馏进行了系统性研究，并揭示了经典前向KL（FKL）蒸馏的两个非直观缺陷：(i) 学生模型困惑度不会随着教师生成数据量增加而单调改善；(ii) 在同一教师生成语料库上，FKL蒸馏的表现不如直接使用原始DLM去噪目标训练学生模型。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种统一的、无需数据的掩码DLM蒸馏框架。首先，框架执行离策略蒸馏阶段，从静态教师生成数据中吸收通用知识；然后采用在线策略蒸馏，包含三项技术：沿学生自身反向过程的轨迹损失、对教师不确定处的置信度重加权，以及稳定移动目标的信任区域锚点。在MDLM上，所得学生模型达到GPT-2困惑度24.75，超过教师的27.04；在Dream-7B蒸馏至93M学生模型时，框架将Qwen-2.5的困惑度从FKL蒸馏基线的25.23降至19.83，同时在零样本通用能力基准测试中保持性能。

summary: Quality control for proposition decomposition by large language models (LLMs) raises two asymmetric questions. After decomposition, one can verify: given a sentence and a candidate proposition, does the proposition belong to that sentence? Before decomposition, one would like to predict: how many propositions should the sentence yield? On PropSegmEnt, a corpus of English Wikipedia sentences each segmented by three human annotators, we find that the two questions live in different representational spaces. A natural language inference (NLI) judge verifies membership with 92.8% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.977, and its residual errors turn out to be mostly propositions that are true in document context rather than genuine entailment mistakes. Vector geometry cannot verify: cosine similarity saturates, and a sentence embedding is not a linear combination of its propositions' embeddings. For prediction, every symbolic anchor we test, namely token count, the CPIDR idea-density counter, and a Neo-Davidsonian predicate count, reduces to a length proxy once token count is controlled. A linear ridge probe on sentence embeddings is the only predictor that keeps genuine count signal: its length-partialled correlation with human counts is 0.40-0.49 with bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs) excluding zero, and it orders length-matched sentence pairs correctly 67-71% of the time against a 50% chance level, statistically matching the inter-annotator agreement ceiling. This signal survives INT8 quantization without loss, INT4 at a small cost, and Matryoshka truncation to 256 dimensions, and it works as well in a 2021 encoder as in a 2025 one. Its structured weakness is a systematic under-splitting of long sentences. We distill the protocol lessons, including a retracted pilot study, into a checklist for probing length-confounded quantities.
title: Verifiable but Not Predictable: What Sentence Embeddings Know About Propositional Decomposition

title_translated: 可验证但不可预测：句子嵌入对命题分解的认知
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）进行命题分解的质量控制引发两个不对称问题。分解后可验证：给定一个句子和候选命题，该命题是否属于该句子？分解前希望预测：该句子应产生多少个命题？在PropSegmEnt数据集（由三位人工标注者分割的英文维基百科句子组成）上，我们发现这两个问题存在于不同的表征空间中。自然语言推理（NLI）裁判对成员关系的验证准确率达92.8%，ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.977，其残余错误主要来自文档上下文中为真的命题，而非真正的蕴含错误。向量几何无法验证：余弦相似度趋于饱和，句子嵌入并非其命题嵌入的线性组合。在预测方面，我们测试的所有符号锚点——词元数量、CPIDR思想密度计数器、Neo-Davidsonian谓词计数——在控制词元数量后均退化为长度代理。唯一能保留真实计数信号的是对句子嵌入的线性岭探测器：其在去除长度影响后的相关系数为0.40–0.49，置信区间（CIs）不包含零，且在长度匹配的句子对中正确排序的比例达67–71%（高于50%的随机水平），统计上与标注者间一致性上限相当。该信号在INT8量化下无损失，INT4下略有损失，Matryoshka截断至256维后仍有效，且在2021年和2025年的编码器中表现一致。其结构性弱点是系统性地低估长句的拆分。我们总结了这些协议教训，包括一次撤回的试点研究，形成了一套探测长度混淆量的检查清单。

summary: Understanding how models internally represent information is a central challenge in interpretation and control. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense hidden representations into sparse features, and cross-layer methods capture structure spanning multiple layers. However, existing objectives do not explicitly train the sparse code at one layer to predict the sparse code at the next layer. We propose sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S), where sparse features at each intermediate layer are trained to predict those of the immediately following layer, with the final layer anchored by an output-distribution loss and optimization proceeding sequentially from output to input. Experiments across eight language models show stronger adjacent-layer correspondence than matched sparse-feature baselines. We evaluate feature-based interventions at matched output-distribution shift, separating steering-induced effects from sparse-pathway reconstruction effects. Causal ablation provides complementary evidence beyond correspondence metrics.
title: Sparse-to-Sparse Feature Learning for Cross-Layer Analysis and Steering

title_translated: 跨层分析与引导中的稀疏到稀疏特征学习
summary_translated: 理解模型内部如何表征信息是解释与控制中的核心挑战。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将密集的隐藏表示分解为稀疏特征，而跨层方法则捕捉跨越多个层级的结构。然而，现有目标并未显式训练某一层的稀疏代码以预测下一层的稀疏代码。我们提出稀疏到稀疏特征学习（S2S），其中每个中间层的稀疏特征被训练以预测紧随其后的层的稀疏特征，最终层通过输出分布损失进行锚定，并从输出向输入顺序推进优化。在八种语言模型上的实验表明，S2S相比匹配的稀疏特征基线具有更强的相邻层对应性。我们在匹配的输出分布偏移条件下评估基于特征的干预措施，将引导引起的效应与稀疏路径重建效应分离。因果消融提供了超越对应度量的补充证据。

summary: Large language model agents can self-improve over time by utilizing procedural memory derived from prior task trajectories, yet the distinct utilities of memories derived from local successes and failures remain underexplored. This work studies this question in a realistic setting with heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks and various environment constraints common in real-world scenarios. We develop \emph{Dual-Polarity Memory with Periodic Maintenance} (DualPM), a simple, retrieval-free memory workflow characterized by (1) customizable reflection and procedural memory generation from both local successes and failures within each trajectory, and (2) periodic memory consolidation over long task streams under a given memory capacity, preventing memory explosion. Online prequential evaluation with fine-grained metrics reveals that failure memory more strongly broadens coverage, success memory better streamlines execution, while combining both polarities effectively integrates both benefits. Further studies demonstrate that DualPM enables cross-domain memory generalization and continual memory adaptation, while external evaluation on EvoMemBench reveals the portability and effectiveness of DualPM as a general long-term procedural memory method.
title: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory

title_translated: 失败拓宽，成功聚焦：基于双极性记忆的工具使用智能体在多样化任务中的持续适应
summary_translated: 大型语言模型代理可通过利用先前任务轨迹中衍生的过程记忆实现自我改进，但源自局部成功与失败的记忆各自独特效用仍缺乏深入探索。本研究在包含异构多领域工具使用任务和多种环境约束的真实场景中探讨该问题。我们开发了	extit{周期维护的双极性记忆}（DualPM），一种简单且无需检索的记忆工作流，其特点包括：(1) 可定制地从每条轨迹中的局部成功与失败中生成反思与过程记忆；(2) 在给定记忆容量下对长任务流进行周期性记忆整合，防止记忆爆炸。在线预序评估结合细粒度指标显示，失败记忆更显著拓宽覆盖范围，成功记忆更有效优化执行流程，而两者结合可有效整合双重优势。进一步研究表明，DualPM支持跨领域记忆泛化与持续记忆适应；外部在EvoMemBench上的评估也证实了DualPM作为通用长期过程记忆方法的可移植性与有效性。

summary: Detailed knowledge of a user's persona is valuable for personalizing generative AI models and agents, yet such details are difficult to obtain and change over time. We address the task of inferring persona attributes from a single day of mobile activity logs. No suitable publicly available benchmark exists for this task, so we introduce a synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs. We target on-device inference so that raw logs never leave the phone, which makes memory rather than speed the limiting constraint: a day of activity yields roughly 30K tokens, whose key-value cache alone exceeds the INT4 weights of a 4B-parameter model. We therefore propose a log filtering method that retains only behaviorally distinct entries. Filtering reduces the memory footprint by up to 39% across nine models from four families and more than halves prefill time, while maintaining or improving prediction quality. For Qwen3-4B it removes 2.5GB, bringing the model from well beyond a realistic per-process budget to a manageable one. Within our benchmark, these results indicate that preserving diverse behavioral events matters more for persona prediction than retaining every semantically similar log entry.
title: LogToPersona: New Benchmark and Efficient Persona Prediction through Semantic Log Filtering
title_translated: LogToPersona：新基准与通过语义日志过滤实现的高效人格预测
summary_translated: 用户人格的详细知识对于个性化生成式AI模型与代理至关重要，但此类细节难以获取且随时间变化。我们致力于从单日移动活动日志中推断人格属性。目前尚无适用于该任务的公开可用基准，因此我们引入了一个包含1600个人格-日志配对的合成基准。我们专注于设备端推理，确保原始日志不离开手机，这使得内存而非速度成为主要限制：一天的活动日志约产生3万token，其键值缓存本身已超过一个40亿参数模型的INT4权重。因此，我们提出一种日志过滤方法，仅保留行为上具有差异性的条目。该过滤方法在九个来自四个模型家族的模型上将内存占用减少高达39%，并使预填充时间减半以上，同时保持或提升预测质量。对于Qwen3-4B，该方法可移除2.5GB内存，使其从远超实际进程预算的状态变为可管理状态。在我们的基准中，这些结果表明，保留多样化的行为事件比保留所有语义相似的日志条目对人格预测更为重要。

summary: Language models can stand in for survey respondents, but leading approaches build their simulated people from interviews or individual records. We show that a model can learn how European population groups respond from published statistics, without interviews and without training on individual records. We fine-tune an open-weight language model on more than 12 million published group-level answer distributions from about 40 European countries, setting it up to predict each group's departure from a reference distribution. On opinion surveys from its training families it calls the direction of group differences right 84% of the time, ahead of a demographic statistical model (77%, paired test) and level with Claude Opus 5 and 5.5, which it also ties on accuracy; the frontier models are more accurate on new questions. On 278 held-out questions, almost all from the survey families seen in training, its error is 12% lower than that statistical model. It runs on a single 32 GB GPU or a high-memory laptop, and in a test with an earlier model, an evidence gate calibrated on half of a survey's questions fell back to the reference where the model's adjustments did not help. Coupled to a transport simulation of a planned metro closure, with a conventional elasticity as the reference, it adds a testable age gradient to the response, which we freeze for later scoring.
title: Using AI to Simulate the Behaviour of European Populations

title_translated: 利用AI模拟欧洲人口的行为
summary_translated: 语言模型可以充当调查受访者，但主流方法通常基于访谈或个体记录构建模拟人群。我们展示了一种模型如何仅从已发布的统计数据中学习欧洲群体的响应模式，无需访谈，也无需在个体记录上进行训练。我们将一个开源权重的语言模型在来自约40个欧洲国家的超过1200万条群体级回答分布上进行微调，使其能够预测每个群体相对于参考分布的偏离情况。在训练家族的民意调查上，该模型正确判断群体差异方向的比例达到84%，优于人口统计学模型（77%，配对检验），并与Claude Opus 5和5.5持平，在准确率上也与之相当；前沿模型在新问题上表现更优。在278个保留问题上，其误差比统计模型低12%。该模型可在单块32GB GPU或高内存笔记本上运行；在一项测试中，当早期模型在一半调查问题上校准的证据门失效时，其调整未能带来改善，系统回归至参考基准。结合对计划地铁关闭的交通模拟，以传统弹性为参考，该模型引入了可验证的年龄梯度响应，我们将其冻结以供后续评分。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to misinterpret and misrepresent regional and social varieties of English other than Mainstream American English (MAE), such as African American English (AAE), yet most evaluations of these biases have relied on synthetic, stylized or decontextualized data. This paper instead evaluates LLMs on authentic, conversational AAE to more closely reflect how such models may encounter AAE when deployed as chatbots. Concretely, we perform two complementary evaluation tasks on 100 six-turn segments randomly sampled from the Corpus of Regional African American Language (CORAAL; Kendall and Farrington, 2024), comparing three closed-weight LLM configurations: Gemini 2.5 Flash with and without reasoning, and GPT-4.1 mini. The first task compares the models against gold-standard manual annotations for five AAE morphosyntactic features, while the second assesses their ability to generate contextually appropriate next turns, evaluating outputs for AAE feature frequency, diversity (Self-BLEU), and pragmatic quality. Reasoning-enabled Gemini is the strongest feature detector by a clear margin (macro F1 of 0.91), outperforming both other LLMs as well as a finetuned BERT-based baseline (Masis et al., 2022). In generation, however, all LLMs underproduce AAE relative to the human speakers and produce relatively uniform continuations, with reasoning-enabled Gemini producing the least AAE and the least diverse output. We conclude that a model's ability to detect AAE does not straightforwardly translate into its spontaneous use of AAE in generation, and argue that addressing this gap requires changes upstream, in how pretraining and alignment data represent dialectal variation.
title: Evaluating Large Language Models on conversational African American English: Feature classification and next-turn generation
title_translated: 评估大语言模型在对话式非裔美国人英语上的表现：特征分类与下一回合生成
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）常误解或歪曲除主流美式英语（MAE）外的其他地区和社会英语变体，如非裔美国人英语（AAE），但大多数相关偏差评估依赖于合成、风格化或去情境化数据。本文则在真实对话式AAE上评估LLMs，以更贴近模型作为聊天机器人部署时可能遇到的实际情形。具体而言，我们在从《区域非裔美国人语言语料库》（CORAAL；Kendall和Farrington，2024）中随机抽取的100段六轮对话样本上执行两项互补评估任务，对比三种闭源权重LLM配置：带与不带推理能力的Gemini 2.5 Flash，以及GPT-4.1 mini。第一项任务将模型结果与人工标注的金标准对比，评估五种AAE形态句法特征；第二项任务评估其生成上下文恰当的下一回合的能力，评估输出在AAE特征频率、多样性（Self-BLEU）和语用质量方面的表现。带推理能力的Gemini在特征检测方面明显领先（宏平均F1达0.91），优于其他两个LLM及一个微调的BERT基线（Masis等，2022）。但在生成方面，所有LLM均表现出对AAE的使用不足，且生成内容相对单一，其中带推理能力的Gemini产生的AAE最少、多样性最低。我们得出结论：模型识别AAE的能力并不能直接转化为其在生成中自发使用AAE的能力，认为解决这一差距需在预训练和对齐数据中上游层面改变方言变异的表示方式。

summary: A looped language model repeatedly applies the same block to its hidden state before predicting each token. The number of passes is its recurrent depth. Increasing this depth gives the model more computation per token with the same parameters. Can the shared block learn from the predictions it makes at greater depth? Following prior work, we retrofit pretrained OLMo-2-1B with a shared recurrent block and continue mid-training over varying recurrent depths. In the four-pass model, additional passes mainly redistribute probability among tokens that already rank highly after one pass. We use the continuations generated at greater depth to train only the shared block through a single pass, without reference answers or correctness filtering. We call this transfer preference write-back. Write-back further improves one-pass and multi-pass accuracy on most tasks. At their target depths, the updated models outperform a non-recurrent control matched for mid-training data and token budget on all six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with a mean relative gain in accuracy of up to 46.2% across tasks. At four-pass inference, one-pass training outperforms full-depth training on the same targets in the model with input injection. This advantage disappears in the matched model without injection. On GSM8K, using the updated block only on passes two through four recovers nearly the entire four-pass gain, showing that an update learned in one pass can improve later applications of the same block.
title: Learning from Recurrence: Internalizing Depth-Induced Preferences in Looped Language Models

title_translated: 从循环中学习：在循环语言模型中内化深度诱导的偏好
summary_translated: 循环语言模型通过反复应用相同的模块作用于隐藏状态来预测每个词元，其循环深度即为迭代次数。增加深度可在参数不变的情况下提升每个词元的计算量。共享模块能否从更高深度下的预测中学习？受先前工作启发，我们对预训练的OLMo-2-1B模型引入共享循环模块，并在不同循环深度下继续训练。在四次迭代模型中，额外的迭代主要是在一次迭代后已排名较高的词元之间重新分配概率。我们利用高深度生成的延续内容，仅通过一次迭代训练共享模块，无需参考答案或正确性过滤。这种方法称为偏好回写。回写进一步提升了单次和多次迭代在多数任务上的准确率。在目标深度下，更新后的模型在所有六个数学推理基准测试上均优于匹配中段训练数据和词元预算的非循环对照组，平均准确率相对提升高达46.2%。在四次迭代推理时，使用输入注入的模型中，单次训练表现优于全深度训练；而在无注入的匹配模型中，该优势消失。在GSM8K任务上，仅在第二至第四次迭代中使用更新后的模块即可恢复几乎全部四次迭代的增益，表明一次迭代中学习到的更新可改善后续相同模块的应用效果。

summary: Conversations are central to how people exchange information, share experiences, and develop collective understanding. Yet, across conversational settings, discussions often suffer from uneven participation, unanswered contributions, and a narrow range of perspectives. As generative AI agents increasingly participate alongside humans, hybrid human-AI conversations present a new opportunity to address these challenges. We investigate whether AI agents can serve as catalysts for human interaction, improving conversational engagement and broadening collective discourse. We develop a framework for introducing generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions and evaluate it through two complementary studies. First, using agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains, we find that AI-generated conversations are more positive and less toxic than human conversations, but substantially less semantically diverse. Persona conditioning produces more human-like contributions and narrows this diversity gap, while increasing the representation of underrepresented personas can shift which perspectives emerge without necessarily increasing overall diversity. Second, we conduct a pre-registered experiment with 221 participants across nine discussion threads, comparing human-only conversations with those involving generic or persona-conditioned AI agents. We find that AI participation increases responsiveness, reduces unanswered contributions, and broadens the range of ideas expressed by human participants, even though the AI agents themselves do not fully reproduce human conversational diversity. These findings suggest that the value of hybrid human-AI conversations lies not simply in the content AI agents generate, but also in their potential to stimulate more responsive and diverse interactions among humans.
title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?

title_translated: AI-人类混合对话：AI代理能否提升对话质量？
summary_translated: 对话是人们交流信息、分享经验并形成集体理解的核心方式。然而，在各类对话场景中，讨论常面临参与不均、回应缺失以及观点范围狭窄等问题。随着生成式AI代理越来越多地与人类共同参与对话，人机混合对话为解决这些问题提供了新机遇。我们探究AI代理是否能作为人类互动的催化剂，提升对话参与度并拓宽集体讨论的广度。我们构建了一个框架，将通用型和人格化AI代理引入动态讨论中，并通过两项互补研究进行评估。首先，基于Reddit四个领域的讨论进行基于代理的模拟发现，AI生成的对话比人类对话更积极且毒性更低，但语义多样性显著不足。人格化条件可使AI贡献更接近人类风格，缩小多样性差距；同时，增加代表性不足的人格化角色可改变主导观点，而不一定提升整体多样性。其次，我们在九个讨论线程中对221名参与者进行了注册实验，比较纯人类对话与包含通用或人格化AI代理的对话。结果表明，AI参与提高了响应性，减少了未回应的贡献，并拓宽了人类参与者表达的观点范围，尽管AI代理本身并未完全复现人类对话的多样性。这些发现表明，人机混合对话的价值不仅在于AI生成的内容，更在于其激发人类间更积极、更多样化互动的潜力。

summary: We present open-source FUTO Keyboard layouts and predictive text dictionaries for five endangered Uralic languages: Erzya, Moksha, Komi-Zyrian, Livonian, and Skolt Sami. For predictive text, we construct weighted AOSP dictionaries using translated Finnish lemma frequencies together with morphological frequencies extracted from small target-language corpora using finite-state transducers. This combination provides a practical way to rank inflected word forms when large monolingual corpora are unavailable. The resulting resources offer reusable mobile keyboard support for endangered Uralic languages.

summary: Assistants that answer from supplied reference material often receive material that covers some parts of a user's question and not others. Existing evaluations of insufficient context mostly score one answer per question, and often treat partially sufficient context as simply insufficient. We describe a small, open evaluation that scores each part of a three-part question separately, with a verdict for parts that are answered correctly from the material but carry an added unsupported claim. On 30 cases (five scenarios, six coverage patterns, five samples each) we test claude-haiku-4-5 and llama3.1:8b. Without an explicit instruction to stay within the material, both models fill most gaps from their own knowledge (unsupported-claim rates of 0.71 and 0.90). One added sentence instructing them to answer only from the material brings these rates to 0.00 and 0.06, consistent with prior work. What remains is less visible: answers that strengthen the material, for example turning "many job sites prohibit bots" into a flat "no". We also report on the judge. Three rounds of blind hand labelling show that this added-claim verdict is the hardest to apply, for the judge and the author alike; RAGAS faithfulness is unsuitable for this task because it penalises correct withholding; and a difference between the two models that is clear under one judge disappears when the judge model is replaced. The dataset, code, hand labels and per-run figures are public.
title: When the Knowledge Runs Out: A Part-Level Pilot Evaluation of How Language Models Handle Partially Covered Questions

summary: When users assume that an AI chatbot has mental states, they are more likely to develop over-reliance, emotional dependence, and in extreme cases, psychological harm or self-harm. However, how these mind attributions arise in conversations and how human or AI factors influence this is still unknown. We study how users attribute minds using a minimal framework: a simulated user with different characteristics chats with assistants that differ in social style and memory. We also introduce a message-level measure of who attributes a mind to whom in four directions, checked with trained coders and applied by a fine-tuned encoder that reproduces an LLM judge. Our results show that, on average, nine out of thirteen characteristics raised simulated users' attribution to the assistant. We found that relational needs such as attachment anxiety raised it as theory predicts, some general personality traits raised it as well, and AI-specific characteristics the least. By contrast, the assistant's social style barely changed simulated users' mind attribution. Instead, sycophantic instructions raised the assistant's attribution to itself. Memory raised users' attribution only with some user models. The model playing the user changed overall attribution and the effects of characteristics, style, and memory. Our framework measures how persona descriptions affect mind attribution in simulation. It gives concrete hypotheses for human studies and shows the need for more consistent user simulators.
title: Who Attributes a Mind to Whom? Mutual Theory of Mind in Simulated User-Assistant Conversation

title_translated: 谁赋予谁心智？模拟用户-助手对话中的相互心理理论
summary_translated: 当用户认为AI聊天机器人具有心理状态时，更容易产生过度依赖、情感依附，甚至极端情况下导致心理伤害或自我伤害。然而，这种心智归因如何在对话中产生，以及人类或AI因素如何影响这一过程仍不清楚。我们采用最小化框架研究用户的心智归因：具有不同特征的模拟用户与在社交风格和记忆能力上不同的助手进行对话。我们还引入一种消息级别的双向衡量方法，用于判断谁向谁归因心智，经训练编码员验证，并由微调后的编码器模型复现LLM裁判。结果显示，平均而言，十三种特征中有九种提升了模拟用户对助手的心智归因。符合理论预测的是，关系需求如依恋焦虑会提高归因，某些普遍人格特质也有类似作用，而AI特定特征的影响最小。相比之下，助手的社交风格对用户心智归因影响甚微；相反，奉承性指令反而提升了助手对自身的归因。记忆仅在部分用户模型中提升了用户的归因。扮演用户的角色本身改变了整体归因水平以及特征、风格和记忆的影响。我们的框架测量了人物设定如何影响模拟中的心智归因，为未来人类研究提出具体假设，并凸显了需要更一致的用户模拟器。

summary: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English. We evaluate 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models on 17 tasks in 14 languages, comparing each language with English on parallel items. Every model loses accuracy in every language, from about 2 points in high-resource languages to 8 in Tamil, while confidence falls only half as much: a threshold set for 95\% accuracy in English yields 90% in Tamil. The size of the loss is set by the language and the base model rather than by leaderboard rank. In 81 controlled fine-tuning runs, task skill learned in English transfers to other languages and a few thousand target-language items narrow large losses, but neither more data nor full-parameter tuning closes them. Finally, the same test items are answered more accurately in all 23 benchmark--language pairs we compare when an LLM rather than a person translated them, so LLM-translated test sets understate the gap.
title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
title_translated: 翻译迷失，信心未失：多语言决策模型的基准测试与校准
summary_translated: 决策模型是针对类型化查询中每个选项返回概率的微调语言模型，路由器和防护机制直接对其阈值进行判断。这些模型基于多语言基础，但排名几乎完全以英语为主。我们在14种语言中的17项任务上评估了25个排名靠前的开源决策模型，将每种语言与英语在平行项目上进行比较。每个模型在所有语言中均出现准确率下降，从高资源语言约2个百分点到泰米尔语下降8个百分点，而置信度仅下降一半：为英语设定95%准确率的阈值在泰米尔语中仅能实现90%。损失大小由语言和基础模型决定，而非排行榜排名。在81次受控微调实验中，英语中学习的任务技能可迁移到其他语言，少量目标语言数据可缩小大范围损失，但增加数据或全参数微调也无法消除这些差距。最后，在所有23个基准-语言对中，使用大语言模型而非人工翻译测试集时，测试题回答更准确，因此LLM翻译的测试集低估了实际差距。

summary: Outlet ideology is a standard explanatory variable in media framing, media effects, and political communication research, but continuous, ecosystem-wide coverage lets it enter as graded exposure rather than a coarse bin. For France, existing references are either broad but non-analytic or analytic but sparse and source-specific, and none we are aware of offers ecosystem-wide coverage on a unified continuous scale. We contribute FrIdéo: to our knowledge the first ecosystem-wide continuous ideology scores for the French press, a transparent composite score for 30 French news outlets, fusing nine independent families of evidence with empirical-Bayes-style shrinkage toward a structural prior. For the text-based family we introduce symmetric plain/qualified scoring, which separates the plain use of ideologically loaded vocabulary from its qualified (distanced) use on both sides, a distinction bag-of-words methods miss. The resulting scale runs from L'Humanité on the far left to Valeurs actuelles on the far right; the far-right pole is near-indistinguishable and CNews ties Le Figaro. Because the text family reads current articles, it also captures editorial change that static sources miss, such as the Journal du Dimanche's sharp rightward shift after its 2023 ownership change. The ordering is robust to perturbation and to dropping any single family, and agrees with held-out Media Bias Fact Check labels. We release the scores, confidence intervals, and replication code.
title: FrIdéo: French News Outlet Ideology Scoring via Multi-Source Evidence Fusion and Distancing-Aware Lexical Scoring

title_translated: FrIdéo：基于多源证据融合与距离感知词汇评分的法语新闻媒体意识形态评分
summary_translated: 媒体意识形态是媒体框架、媒体效果和政治传播研究中的标准解释变量，但连续、生态系统范围的覆盖使其成为分级暴露而非粗略分类。对于法国而言，现有参考文献要么范围广泛但非分析性，要么分析性强但稀疏且局限于特定来源，且我们所知无一提供统一连续尺度上的生态系统级覆盖。我们提出FrIdéo：据我们所知首个针对法国新闻业的生态系统级连续意识形态评分系统，为30家法语新闻机构提供透明的综合评分，融合九类独立证据，并采用经验贝叶斯风格的收缩方法向结构先验靠拢。针对文本类证据，我们引入对称的纯文本/限定文本评分方法，区分意识形态词汇的纯粹使用与其限定（距离化）使用，这一区别是传统词袋方法所忽略的。所得量表从左翼的《人道报》延伸至右翼的《价值观报》；极右翼极点几乎无法区分，CNews与《费加罗报》持平。由于文本类读取最新文章，还能捕捉静态来源遗漏的编辑变化，例如《星期日日报》在2023年所有权变更后急剧右倾。该排序对扰动和剔除任一类证据均稳健，并与保留的媒体偏见事实核查标签一致。我们公开评分、置信区间及复现代码。

summary: Text embedding models can conflate surface-form similarity with factual identity. Given an altered near-copy with one corrupted fact and a differently worded fact-preserving rewrite, the base model prefers the altered near-copy. We test whether hard-negative contrastive supervision can reduce this surface-similarity shortcut. We construct FOF-Bench, an 83,263-triplet benchmark spanning five domains. Each anchor is paired with an LLM-generated, fact-preserving stylistic rewrite and a matched fact-altered near-copy. We fine-tune FOF-80M (Focus On Facts), an 80M-parameter embedding model, with a triplet contrastive objective that ranks the rewrite above the factual alteration. On 8,327 held-out test triplets, the base model chooses the factually altered text in 99.58% of cases (0.42% factual preference rate; mean separation -0.1650). After fine-tuning, mean positive--negative separation is +0.0329, 98.5% of individual margins move in the intended direction, and the preference rate reaches 29.37%. On DiSC, an external style-transfer corpus, mean cross-style similarity increases from 0.7905 to 0.9559. The model also penalizes omission and transfers poorly to directional tasks such as NLI and summarization. We characterize FOF-80M as a soft factual fingerprint for studying factual retention under stylistic variation, not as a general-purpose factuality metric.
title: Focus On Facts: Stylistically Invariant and Factually Sensitive Text Embeddings
title_translated: 聚焦事实：风格不变且事实敏感的文本嵌入
summary_translated: 文本嵌入模型可能混淆表面形式相似性与事实同一性。给定一个包含一处事实错误的近似复制版本和一个用不同措辞保持事实不变的重写版本，基础模型更倾向于选择被篡改的近似复制。我们检验硬负样本对比监督是否能减少这种表面相似性捷径。我们构建FOF-Bench，一个涵盖五个领域的83,263组三元组基准。每个锚点配对一个LLM生成的事实保持型风格重写和一个匹配的事实篡改近似复制。我们使用三元组对比目标对FOF-80M（Focus On Facts）——一个8000万参数的嵌入模型进行微调，使其将重写版本排在事实篡改版本之前。在8,327个保留测试三元组上，基础模型在99.58%的情况下选择事实被篡改的文本（事实偏好率为0.42%；平均分离度为-0.1650）。微调后，正负样本平均分离度提升至+0.0329，98.5%的个体差异朝预期方向移动，偏好率上升至29.37%。在DiSC外部风格迁移语料库上，跨风格相似度从0.7905提升至0.9559。该模型还惩罚信息遗漏，且在方向性任务如自然语言推理和摘要生成中表现不佳。我们将其视为一种软事实指纹，用于研究风格变化下的事实保留，而非通用的事实性度量。

summary: Cognitive Load Theory (CLT) shows that human problem-solving is affected by both intrinsic load, arising from task difficulty, and extraneous load, arising from how task information is presented. Large language models (LLMs) show analogous effects: presentation alone can affect model performance, but these effects have not yet been systematically isolated from task difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce CogLoadBench, a controlled benchmark that varies five CLT-inspired presentation factors across three reasoning task families. Across models, we find that higher extraneous load conditions often reduce accuracy by either adding competition or complicating the reasoning path. To support diagnosis and mitigation of load-related effects, we propose the Extraneous Load Score (ELS), a prompt-time metric computed from activations that estimates a model's extraneous load, and show that it generalizes across reasoning task types and load levels. We further show that shifting model representations toward lower-load directions at inference time can improve average model performance without changing prompt content.
title: Extraneous Cognitive Load in Large Language Models

title_translated: 大型语言模型中的额外认知负荷
summary_translated: 认知负荷理论（CLT）表明，人类问题解决受内在负荷（源于任务难度）和额外负荷（源于任务信息呈现方式）的影响。大型语言模型（LLMs）表现出类似效应：仅呈现方式本身就能影响模型性能，但这些效应尚未与任务难度系统性地分离。为填补这一空白，我们引入CogLoadBench，一个受控基准，通过三个推理任务类别变化五种CLT启发的呈现因素。在多个模型中，我们发现更高的额外负荷条件通常会降低准确率，原因在于增加竞争或使推理路径复杂化。为支持对负荷相关效应的诊断与缓解，我们提出额外负荷得分（ELS），一种在提示阶段计算的激活指标，用于估计模型的额外负荷，并证明其在不同推理任务类型和负荷水平间具有泛化能力。我们进一步表明，在推理时将模型表示向低负荷方向调整，可在不改变提示内容的前提下提升平均模型性能。

summary: Materials discovery is an iterative loop: experiments and calculations verify predictions, and each outcome can inform the next. Yet most predictors are specialized single-task models fixed after training. Large language models have recently emerged as predictors across heterogeneous tasks but generally underperform specialized models, and retrieval-augmented variants discard their own outcomes. Benchmarks also score queries in isolation, leaving improvement from outcomes untested. Here we construct MatMemBench, a sequential benchmark of 22 materials tasks that reveals outcomes only after prediction and tests online adaptation, memory retention and cross-task transfer. We present MatRecall, a framework that lets large language models store verified predictions, with evidence, outcome and error, as episodes and recall them without retraining. MatRecall improved median performance by 62% over a memory-free model, exceeded specialized models on 11 tasks, remained useful after feedback stopped and transferred between related tasks. Verified experience could become a reusable resource for self-improving discovery loops.
title: Verified experience improves materials prediction with large language models
title_translated: 经验证据改善大型语言模型的材料预测
summary_translated: 材料发现是一个迭代循环：实验和计算验证预测，每次结果可指导下一次预测。然而，大多数预测模型是训练后固定的专用单任务模型。大型语言模型最近作为跨异构任务的预测器出现，但通常表现不如专用模型，且检索增强型变体会丢弃自身输出。基准测试也孤立地评分查询，未测试结果带来的改进。在此，我们构建MatMemBench，一个包含22个材料任务的序列式基准，仅在预测后揭示结果，测试在线适应、记忆保持和跨任务迁移。我们提出MatRecall框架，使大型语言模型能够以“事件”形式存储经验证的预测，包括证据、结果和误差，并在无需重新训练的情况下回忆。MatRecall使中位性能相比无记忆模型提升62%，在11个任务上超越专用模型，即使反馈停止后仍具实用性，并在相关任务间实现迁移。经验证据可能成为自改进发现循环中的可复用资源。

summary: Studies of time perception in language models focus mainly on text-based settings. Yet multimodal models are increasingly used for tasks that require perceiving the passage of time, making the limits of their temporal perception important to understand. We measure the limits of duration perception from audio against a human baseline to address this gap. Drawing from psychophysics, we operationalise duration perception as a melody recognition task, testing when a melody becomes unrecognisable as it is slowed down. Of 21 tested models, most cannot recognise well-known melodies without labelled in-context examples. With in-context examples, seven recognise melodies reliably, most peaking within the median human recognition band. Generalisation is limited: (i) recognition peaks shift with in-context example speed, (ii) melody titles induce prediction bias, and (iii) providing examples with scientific pitch notation does not prevent accuracy declining at long note durations for most models. In humans, the recognition window is a property of the perceiver; in current models, it is largely a property of the prompt.
title: Psychophysics of Duration Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models

title_translated: 多模态大语言模型中时长感知的心理物理学研究
summary_translated: 语言模型中的时间感知研究主要集中在文本场景。然而，随着多模态模型在需要感知时间流逝的任务中日益广泛应用，理解其时间感知的局限性变得尤为重要。我们通过与人类基准对比，测量了音频输入下的时长感知极限。借鉴心理物理学方法，我们将时长感知操作化为旋律识别任务，测试当旋律逐渐变慢至无法辨认时的临界点。在21个测试模型中，大多数模型在没有上下文标注示例的情况下无法识别知名旋律。在提供上下文示例后，有七个模型能可靠识别旋律，多数表现处于人类平均识别范围之内。但泛化能力有限：(i) 识别峰值随上下文示例的速度变化而偏移；(ii) 旋律标题引发预测偏差；(iii) 即使提供科学音高记谱法示例，大多数模型在长音符持续时间下准确率仍下降。在人类中，识别窗口是感知者属性；而在当前模型中，它更多是提示（prompt）的属性。

summary: Transformer-based automated writing scoring models can achieve strong agreement with human scores while providing limited transparency into the response characteristics associated with their predictions. This study evaluated a feature-based post-hoc explanation approach in which explanatory fidelity was established before feature importance was interpreted. English Language Arts responses from three writing prompts in Grades 6 and 8 were analyzed, with about 12,700 responses per prompt and separate DeBERTa-v3-base research models for Expression and Conventions. Each response was represented by 61 interpretable linguistic and writing-quality features. Four approaches - theory-driven composites, hierarchical feature groupings, exploratory factor analysis, and Random Forest surrogates - were compared in their ability to reproduce DeBERTa predictions. Random Forest surrogates produced the largest observed R2 values across all six prompt-by-trait conditions, with held-out R2 values from .81 to .95. SHAP analyses showed substantial overlap in high-importance features across traits, with 75% to 90% of the top 20 features shared. Trait differentiation occurred mainly through relative feature weighting: Expression showed greater importance for lexical and conceptual indicators, whereas Conventions showed greater importance for sentence-level and syntactic-control indicators. Under researcher-defined mappings, rubric correspondence was 90%-95% for Expression and 12%-18% for Conventions. These percentages are descriptive and conditional on the mappings and available linguistic features. The findings support a fidelity-first framework for examining apparent scoring priorities while distinguishing post-hoc evidence about model behavior from direct explanation of transformer internals.
title: Feature-Based Explainability of Transformer Scoring Models: A Fidelity-First Framework for Automated Writing Assessment
title_translated: 基于特征的Transformer评分模型可解释性：一种以保真度优先的自动写作评估框架
summary_translated: 基于Transformer的自动写作评分模型虽能与人工评分高度一致，但在其预测所关联的响应特征方面透明度较低。本研究评估了一种基于特征的事后解释方法，强调在解释特征重要性之前先建立解释保真度。分析了六年级和八年级三个写作题目的英语语言艺术作答，每题约12,700份答卷，并为表达和规范分别构建了DeBERTa-v3-base研究模型。每份答卷由61个可解释的语言学和写作质量特征表示。比较了四种方法——理论驱动复合指标、分层特征分组、探索性因子分析和随机森林代理模型——在重现DeBERTa预测方面的表现。随机森林代理模型在所有六个题型-特质组合中表现出最大的R²值，保留样本R²值介于0.81至0.95之间。SHAP分析显示各特质间高重要性特征存在显著重叠，前20个特征中有75%至90%相同。特质区分主要体现在特征权重差异上：表达维度更重视词汇和概念指标，而规范维度更重视句级和语法控制指标。在研究者定义的映射关系下，表达维度的评分标准对应率达90%-95%，而规范维度仅为12%-18%。这些百分比是描述性的，且依赖于映射关系和可用语言特征。研究结果支持一种以保真度优先的框架，用于考察表面评分优先级，同时区分事后对模型行为的证据与对Transformer内部机制的直接解释。

summary: Long-horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents need persistent memory that surfaces the right past interaction at the right time across thousands of turns. Many systems index by invoking generative LLMs to rewrite history into summaries, facts, or knowledge graphs--a step that is (a) costly (thousands of generative calls per build), (b) non-deterministic (undermining reproducibility and giving inconsistent answers across runs), and (c) provenance-erasing (the reader sees synthesized text, not the original turn). We propose MGMem, a framework with no generative indexing calls that replaces this step with a deterministic discriminative-parser pipeline: recurring mentions across sessions are organized into an incidence graph, question mentions are resolved by a subject-conditioned three-stage resolver, and raw dialogue episodes are returned to the reader. On English multi-session dialogue QA, MGMem outperforms matched-protocol baselines on LoCoMo without generative indexing calls; on the full LongMemEval-S, it remains competitive overall and leads or ties on single-session types among local retrieval comparisons. Code: https://github.com/junhong-h/MGMem
title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory

title_translated: MGMem：一种高效、确定性且保留溯源信息的长周期智能体记忆框架
summary_translated: 长周期大语言模型（LLM）智能体需要持久记忆，能够在数千轮交互中适时调用正确的过往对话内容。许多现有系统通过调用生成式LLM将历史记录重写为摘要、事实或知识图谱来实现索引——这一过程存在（a）成本高昂（每次构建需数千次生成调用）、（b）非确定性（损害可复现性并导致不同运行结果不一致）、以及（c）溯源信息丢失（读者看到的是合成文本而非原始对话回合）等问题。我们提出MGMem框架，无需生成式索引调用，而是采用确定性的判别式解析流水线：跨会话的重复提及被组织成关联图，问题提及通过受主题条件约束的三阶段解析器解决，原始对话片段则返回给阅读者。在英文多会话对话问答任务中，MGMem在无生成索引调用的情况下优于匹配协议的基线模型LoCoMo；在完整的LongMemEval-S数据集上整体保持竞争力，并在本地检索比较中对单会话类型领先或持平。代码：https://github.com/junhong-h/MGMem

summary: The Bundesrat is Germany's second legislative chamber and a constitutional veto player within its political system. The members of the Bundesrat are delegates of state governments. Tracing the political discourse in the Bundesrat is challenging as it has a limited machine-readable corpus available. To address this issue, we present a speaker-attributed corpus of 1,067 Bundesrat plenary sessions from the chamber's first session on 7 September 1949 to 10 July 2026. In this period, a total of 53,362 speeches by 2,473 individuals were delivered in the chamber, including written statements. Each speech includes a speech ID, the full German text, the speaker's name, the date and location of the session, the federal state that the speaker represents, the speaker's role (if applicable), the type of contribution, and the speaker's gender. The dataset provides interdisciplinary research opportunities across computational political science, legislative studies, and parliamentary discourse analysis, coupled with discourse from the Bundestag.
title: The Bundesrat corpus: A dataset of political discourse in the German Federal Council
title_translated: 德国联邦议院政治话语语料库：一个关于德国联邦议会政治讨论的数据集
summary_translated: 德国联邦议院是德国的第二立法机构，也是其政治体系中的宪法否决方。联邦议院成员是各州政府的代表。由于目前可用的机器可读语料库有限，追踪联邦议院的政治话语极具挑战性。为此，我们呈现了一个包含1,067场联邦议院全体会议的说话人标注语料库，涵盖从1949年9月7日第一届会议到2026年7月10日的时期。在此期间，共有2,473名个人发表了总计53,362篇发言，包括书面声明。每篇发言包含发言ID、完整德语文本、发言人姓名、会议日期与地点、发言人代表的联邦州、发言角色（如适用）、贡献类型及发言人性别。该数据集为计算政治科学、立法研究和议会话语分析等跨学科研究提供了机会，并可与联邦议院（Bundestag）的讨论内容结合使用。

summary: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
title_translated: 图像生成能否助力视觉推理？一项实证研究
summary_translated: 语言模型以文字思考；那么多模态模型或许以图像思考。我们检验生成辅助图像是否能提升视觉问答的答案质量。模型先描述所需辅助图像，然后结合原始图像与生成图像进行回答。在13组视觉-语言模型与生成器配对中，图像生成使平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，其中十项任务中有九项出现下降。两个统一模型BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B各自在八项任务中准确率下降。在VSTAR任务中，将生成图像加入同一规划提示，准确率下降10.47个百分点。重复图像编辑在不同任务中产生不同结果。ChartQAPro和MathVista始终低于无生成基线，而ERQA在经历十次编辑后反而提升三点。

summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT
title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer

title_translated: 循环混合Transformer
summary_translated: 循环Transformer通过在循环间复用共享层来提升表达能力，但以效率为代价。要突破其表达能力与效率的边界，需重新思考相邻循环之间的核心连接机制：应传递什么作为Transformer循环？我们提出循环混合Transformer（MoLT），其循环混合注意力（MoLA）使用键值（KV）作为记忆，在深度和循环间实现选择性复用。在循环残差下，MoLT-R保留残差流，并跨循环读取局部KV以增强表达能力；在循环KV下，MoLT-KV则从嵌入重新开始，读取当前循环的局部KV以及前一循环的记忆KV于早期位置以提高效率。MoLT-KV消除了相同位置的跨循环依赖，并结合循环强制进行并行训练，实现了超越训练循环范围的单遍循环混合（MoL）解码。为平衡效率与质量，我们引入U型MoLT（U-MoLT），将记忆构建与预测读出分离，并跳过未使用的解码遍历而不改变预测结果。在400B token预训练中，U-MoLT在700M/1.5B稠密模型和3B MoE模型上均优于OLMo3，700M模型实现1.7倍验证交叉熵（CE）token效率提升，同时使3B MoE在10个领域困惑度降低0.75、10项任务准确率提升2.1个百分点。在Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base的100B token持续预训练中，我们的U-MoLT适配在所有11个领域上均低于匹配基线的CE，且平均token效率提升1.4倍。推理阶段，U-MoLT与MoL-Hybrid-2在S尺寸（约113M）模型上的延迟为996.6 ms，接近非循环的OLMo3的1,000.6 ms。代码已开源：https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.
title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL

title_translated: 当每次轨迹都失败时：将学习者条件化选项拼接到长时程智能体强化学习中
summary_translated: 基于群体的强化学习在具有可验证奖励的长时程智能体任务中常出现全失败群体：所有采样轨迹均获得零奖励，导致基于群体相对性的方法无法获取基于奖励的策略梯度。常见解决方案是从更强模型中提供完整解法，但完整轨迹成本高昂，并使学习者暴露于长期离策略历史中。我们提出SPLICE，通过在线构建来自失败当前策略轨迹的局部训练目标。对于每个全失败群体，一个提议模型在当前策略轨迹中选择一个拼接点，并从该点生成多个有界选项。我们通过重复当前策略延续来估计每个选项的价值，将正向估计转换为返回加权的局部目标，并在选项上拟合当前策略。我们在两个策略族和两个长时程智能体任务（软件工程中的SWE-bench Verified和深度研究中的BrowseComp-Plus）上评估SPLICE。SPLICE在全部四个设置中均优于GRPO和完整轨迹引导基线，性能提升2.8–9.8个百分点。在初始失败的SWE任务上，其使GRPO的毕业率提升10.8个百分点。进一步实验表明，SPLICE在提升性能的同时减少了昂贵的提议模型计算。

summary: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.
title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
title_translated: 一个模型，多种模式：面向创造性生成的系统提示集成演化
summary_translated: 偏好对齐的大语言模型可能出现模式坍缩，使其输出分布集中在少数高奖励响应上。这限制了创造性生成——后者需要高质量、新颖性和多样性。现有测试时方法通常强调多样性，却较少关注个体响应是否兼具高质量与新颖性。这一区别在实际应用中至关重要，因为用户可能希望获得单一引人注目且原创的响应。我们将创造性生成形式化为多目标分布优化问题，并提出SEPO，一种无需训练的系统提示集成优化框架。该框架结合提示演化与贪婪的最大最小选择，在质量约束下识别行为上不同的系统提示，推理时均匀采样一个提示生成每条响应。在四个具有递增质量要求的创造性生成任务及三个开源权重模型上，SEPO在12个设置中的谐平均得分（质量、多样性、新颖性）排名第一，而无任何基线在超过两个设置中领先。平均而言，其使LLM评价的多样性从1.92提升至3.43，新颖性从1.00提升至3.34（1-5分制），质量从3.72降至3.30。我们还发现，扩展优化后的提示集成能增强提示条件响应分布间的分离度。这些结果支持系统提示集成优化作为提升大模型推理时创造力的一种有前景的方法。

summary: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.
title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection

title_translated: 透过透镜阅读微调差异：用于后门检测的模型差异分析
summary_translated: 我们提出一种基于token读出的通用评分体系，用于评估微调过程中基于权重、激活和输出的模型差异方法在后门检测中的表现。我们还通过引入$J$-透镜及其改进版$J{+}{+}$-透镜，改进了现有的基于权重和激活的方法。我们在实验中将被植入后门的模型与原始基础模型进行对比。结果表明，引入$J{+}{+}$-透镜在所有设置中均提升了基于权重的方法性能，而$J$-透镜则提升了单层内的排名。最强的单一方法是$ΔW J{+}{+}$，即通过基础模型的$J{+}{+}$-透镜解码的权重差异，在12个设置中的11个里将后门命名token排在前十个之内。此外，我们发现基于输出和激活的方法（如ADL和Diff Mining）在后门模型因在干净输入上对后门词汇赋予概率而受到惩罚时容易失效，而基于权重的方法不受影响。相反，打乱隐藏单元或仅训练读取残差流的层会隐藏后门信息，使基于权重的方法失效，但不会影响ADL和Diff Mining。没有任何单一方法能同时抵御两种攻击。

summary: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.
title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs

title_translated: 从共享模式到个体证据：时间知识图谱中新兴实体的两阶段推理
summary_translated: 时间知识图谱（TKGs）持续引入新兴实体，其交互历史从零样本登场演变为稀疏、突发的少样本轨迹。然而，当前范式存在碎片化问题：模式迁移方法缺乏全局事件记忆，而在线记忆模型则因端点角色不对称导致未见答案排名下降。此外，稀疏的早期交互在偏斜分布下表现出长程分散与局部冗余。为应对这些挑战，我们提出INSPIRE（整合共享模式与个体证据的推理），一种基于已知目录的两阶段预测框架。第一阶段，INSPIRE学习一个感知可用性的共享模式预测器，融合全候选目录的事件更新记忆，同时应用协调的查询端与目录端掩码。随后第二阶段冻结该预测器，优化一个轻量级个体证据适配器（EA），结合文本语义先验与相关性加权的长程事件统计，在支持与角色均衡的共答案监督下，结合先验几率去偏与软残差对齐进行优化。此外，我们按端点角色分解评估，并通过查询微观与答案实体宏观指标追踪纵向新兴答案群体。在基于ICEWS和GDELT事件数据集的四个基准上，INSPIRE相较于最强基线，新兴MRR提升16.73%–88.83%。相对于配对的第一阶段预测器，EA进一步使新兴MRR提升8.28%–32.63%，答案新MRR提升7.81%–41.24%，群体宏观MRR提升9.64%–39.94%，这些增益归因于语义先验和候选级别得分竞争抑制了不匹配的已有竞争者，避免了零支持先验捷径。官方代码已公开于 https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE。

summary: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.
title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
