title_translated: 当代理出错时：用于自适应数据采样的错配修正贝叶斯模型
summary_translated: 数据分配方法通常使用小型代理模型来为大型目标模型选择训练数据。然而，该代理可能与目标模型对数据的排序不一致，导致训练性能不佳。为解决此问题，我们建模了代理与目标模型之间的错配，并将其纳入分配决策中。为此，将问题转化为多保真度贝叶斯模型，其中每个臂代表一种数据干预。每轮可观察到代理奖励，而目标奖励仅在相同更新的稀有审计中揭示。成对观测识别出各臂的错配，无需假设共享偏移或排名保持不变。错配修正贝叶斯模型通过成对残差校正代理，仅审计不确定决策，并在训练过程中合理分配审计预算。从理论角度看，我们证明了在平稳条件下的后悔分解和下界。这些界限表明，仅依赖代理的分配可能导致线性后悔，且需要最少数量的成对审计。在突变情况下，过早使用审计预算也可能导致线性后悔。采用滑动窗口策略将审计分散在整个训练过程，可实现阶为 $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ 的后悔，其中 $Γ_T$ 表示变化点的数量。实验上，我们在 CivilComments-WILDS 上进行闭环概念验证，使用 BERT-Small 指导 BERT-Large 的训练。错配修正在相同目标模型预算下，优于仅基于目标的策略，显著提升最差群体准确率。将审计分散于训练过程，可在相同审计次数下使最差群体准确率提高 6.3 至 10.5 个百分点。

summary: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.
title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
title_translated: 神经渲染编译器：生成式视频模型作为可编程渲染器
summary_translated: 生成式视频模型正变得越来越强大，但缺乏传统系统（如 HTML/CSS 引擎或 Blender）所具备的可预测控制接口。其能力隐含于训练过程中，难以确定其能可靠执行的任务。我们提出神经渲染编译器（NeurCo），通过自动探测冻结的视频模型，构建描述其可可靠满足的语义需求的模型特定能力手册。NeurCo 将用户意图以模型无关的中间表示（对象、约束、事件、相机）表达，并将其编译为模型特定的执行策略。可靠的请求保持不变，不可靠的请求则被选择性重写或编译为替代执行策略。我们引入 VComBench，一个包含 380 个组合性、多需求任务的基准，涵盖文本到视频、图像到视频以及参考到视频生成。NeurCo 在 Wan 上将需求满足率从 46.8% 提升至 52.3%，在 Minimax H3 上从 66.5% 提升至 69.3%，并与提示增强技术结合后，在 Seedance 2.5 上进一步取得提升。分析揭示了不同模型在控制能力上的差异以及可控性与逼真度之间的权衡，凸显了以能力为导向的编译是实现可编程生成式视频渲染的有前景路径。

summary: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.
title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
title_translated: vSFT：测试时通过语言调优智能体的学习方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地通过智能体强化学习进行改进，尽管该方法可以是在线策略，但存在代价高昂的轨迹回放和稀疏奖励的问题，限制了其在测试时的应用。本文提出一种名为 verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) 的框架，能够在测试时结合自然语言中的密集反馈与权重更新。具体而言，vSFT 通过超网络在智能体与监督者之间形成闭环：监督者从智能体失败的轨迹中生成语言监督信号，超网络则将该信号转换为低秩权重更新以调整智能体。我们验证了这种测试时的参数内演化过程优于其上下文内对应方法及主流强化学习方法。特别地，使用 Qwen3-4B 的 vSFT 在 ALFWorld 上的成功率分别比 GRPO 和 Reflexion 高 8.7% 和 13.9%，在 WebShop 上分别高 4.8% 和 18.2%。我们认为，学习如何适应模型本身，而非仅仅使用已适应的模型，为构建更强大、能够自我改进的智能体提供了有前景的方向。

summary: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization
title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
title_translated: DocSEAM：用于多页文档理解的双向跨页编码
summary_translated: 多页文档视觉-语言模型独立编码每一页，导致页面边界处出现特征级不连续：视觉标记在无法访问相邻页面内容的情况下生成，语言模型必须在孤立的页面表示上进行推理。我们提出 DocSEAM（通过锚定掩码实现文档选择性增强），这是一个轻量级模块，插入预训练视觉编码器与语言模型之间，向视觉表示注入局部跨页上下文的归纳偏置。对于每一页，DocSEAM 构建与其两个邻居构成的局部三元组，应用中心锚定的掩码自注意力机制并结合方向性显著性门控，融合来自邻页的信息，然后仅返回增强后的中心页标记，保持视觉标记数量不变。在经过监督的跨页预热和多页微调（DocSEAM 冻结）后，我们的 90 亿参数模型在五个多页文档 VQA 基准测试中达到了所评估开放权重模型（最多 100 亿参数）中的最佳表现。我们还发现，在受控重新分页条件下，DocSEAM 能降低对边界位置的敏感性，并改善跨页跨度定位能力。

summary: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.
title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes

title_translated: Any-Rate：具有编码比特平面的半比特多精度大语言模型量化
summary_translated: 嵌套多精度量化通过仅读取每个权重的前导比特即可从单一检查点派生多种精度，使其在内存和能耗预算变化的设备部署中极具吸引力。然而，现有方法仅支持整数比特，导致相邻精度间存在较大准确率差距，且在 2 比特时性能严重下降。为解决此问题，我们提出 Any-Rate，可从同一检查点提供 2 到 8 比特的精度，以半比特步长覆盖 2 到 4 比特区间。Any-Rate 将部分比特平面限制为 8 权重块中的扩展汉明码字（每权重 0.5 比特），在精度间共享每行一个查找表，并为每种精度设置独立目标，联合编码所有精度，从而减少比特平面共享带来的损失。在四个大语言模型上，Any-Rate 在 2 比特和 3 比特时达到多精度方法中的最佳准确率，2 比特时保留 FP16 准确率的 69%，4 比特时接近最优水平。其解码速度与现有内核相当，LPDDR 能耗模型估计在同等准确率下能耗最高可降低 27%。代码已公开于 https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate。

summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong start, uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL match or exceed every evaluated sampling strategy and divergence, without schedules, per-token weighting, or truncation hyperparameters. Uni-MOPD outperforms Open-MOPD at the same training budget while training 3.3 times faster than its released code. We will release the training framework, specialist checkpoints, and unified student.
title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists

title_translated: 强起点，简单配方：来自多模态专家的统一在线教师蒸馏
summary_translated: 多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）将独立训练的领域专家整合到一个统一模型中。现有方法专注于优化蒸馏过程，而学生初始化通常从基础模型或跨领域微调检查点开始，这使得能力集成主要依赖于蒸馏本身。我们则将起始点视为设计变量，提出统一MOPD（Uni-MOPD），即通过一个强起点与简单配方相结合：使用同一基础模型的专家进行无训练均匀合并来初始化学生，并通过短周期MOPD结合均匀域采样和全词汇量反向KL进行精炼。在五个多模态领域和19个基准测试中，我们的研究得出三个发现：(1) 起始点比后续训练选择更重要：在任何训练前，均匀合并已达到基础模型经过200次MOPD更新后的得分，经短周期蒸馏后甚至超过搜索得到的高分起始点；(2) 短周期MOPD恢复了合并过程中未整合的大部分能力；它在所有领域均带来提升，尤其在领域教师仍占优时增益最大；(3) 从强起点出发，均匀域采样和全词汇量反向KL在无需调度、逐token加权或截断超参数的情况下，表现匹配或超越所有评估过的采样策略和散度函数。Uni-MOPD在相同训练预算下优于Open-MOPD，且训练速度比其发布代码快3.3倍。我们将发布训练框架、专家检查点和统一学生模型。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. One seed reverses both signs, so single-seed reward comparisons mislead. Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards ; data, models, demo: https://huggingface.co/counterfactual-sql
title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL

title_translated: 单数据库奖励可被攻破：用于可信文本到SQL强化学习的反事实执行
summary_translated: 针对文本到SQL智能体的强化学习（RL）在查询结果与参考答案在单一数据库上匹配时给予奖励。然而，当数据缺乏暴露错误的行时，错误查询可能因运气而匹配。我们研究了一种反事实数据库（CF）奖励机制，该机制还会在几个隐藏的、由代码生成的数据库副本上运行最终查询，并仅在所有结果都匹配（严格形式）或按匹配比例支付（平均形式）时才给予奖励。在1,302个合成审计问题上，严格形式将完全支付的错误查询比例从29.5%降至16.8%，将奖励欺骗比例从54.1%降至1.9%，同时拒绝了0个正确查询；来自无家族感知生成器的副本也表现出类似效果。在3.35B模型上的受控GRPO对比实验中，使用平均形式训练并未提高域内准确率（8.4% vs 11.7%），因为两种奖励在仅5-7%的轨迹上存在分歧；但在Spider数据集上提升了1.6分。一个种子反转了两个指标的方向，因此单种子奖励比较具有误导性。代码：https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards；数据、模型、演示：https://huggingface.co/counterfactual-sql

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.
title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents

title_translated: MedSkill-E$^{2}$：评估与演化医疗智能体技能
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用技能来访问领域知识并完成现实任务。我们观察到，即使技能明确指定了任务所需的规则和流程，智能体在自主执行过程中仍可能无法有效应用，这种现象我们称为‘技能启用但使用不足’（EBU）。这一问题在医疗任务中尤为严重，忽略单一关键约束可能导致看似合理但错误的结果。为评估和解决EBU问题，我们提出了MedSkill-E$^{2}$，一个用于评估和演化医疗智能体技能的框架。我们构建了EBU-Bench，一个涵盖12个医学相关任务组及其对应技能的挑战性基准，用于评估智能体自主使用可用技能的能力。我们将EBU差距量化为自主使用与显式引导阅读和应用同一技能之间的技能使用准确率差异。在EBU-Bench上，所有评估的模型-工具组合均表现出EBU，平均差距达43.94个百分点（pp）。对于同一模型，不同工具下的自主使用准确率差异可达38.96 pp。基于这些观察，我们提出EBU-Evolve，利用自主和显式引导技能使用中的执行反馈，将有效指导提炼为可重用的技能指令。相较于进化前版本，改进后的技能在自主执行中提升了33.33至55.17 pp的技能使用准确率，并在跨多个模型和工具间迁移时仍保持提升。结果表明，在模型和技能固定的情况下，自主技能使用准确率在不同工具间存在显著差异，模型排名也可能变化。即使技能被公开，EBU仍可能持续存在。EBU-Evolve在相同技能的未见任务上提升了自主技能使用准确率，且提升效果可在模型和工具间迁移。

summary: Providers watermark the outputs of large language models, while applications sample many responses per prompt for self-consistency, best-of-n selection, and uncertainty estimation. We show that deployed configurations of distortion-free watermarks, which deduplicate keyed contexts only within a response, couple the responses of a request: answer templates make all responses query the watermark with the same context before the answer, so collisions across responses, usually assumed rare, become the norm. Key pools reduce or avoid the coupling at the cost of multiple testing, and the exact remedy of a context history shared across the request leaves many positions unwatermarked. We propose SOLO, which keeps a request-scoped context history but anchors its keyed contexts on content selected by min-hash, so that siblings rarely compete for a context and random edits stay local. Its responses are jointly distributed as independent unwatermarked responses, each detectable with a single key. On five language models from three families and three benchmarks, SOLO preserves self-consistency and uncertainty estimation and, at a 1% false positive rate, detects more responses than four-token key pools on most tasks, also after randomly editing 10% of the tokens, and more than the context history on most clean tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhongliangGuo/solo-watermark.
title: SOLO: Towards Sample-Faithful and Detectable LLM Watermarking under Repeated Sampling via Content-Anchored Single-Owner Contexts
title_translated: SOLO：通过内容锚定的单拥有者上下文实现样本忠实且可检测的LLM水印技术
summary_translated: 提供商对大语言模型输出进行水印标记，而应用程序为自一致性、最佳n选一选择和不确定性估计，会对每个提示生成多个响应。我们发现，部署的无失真水印配置——仅在单个响应内去重键值上下文——会耦合请求的多个响应：答案模板导致所有响应在回答前都以相同上下文查询水印，使原本假设罕见的冲突变为常态。虽然密钥池可通过多次测试减少或避免耦合，但共享请求范围的上下文历史的精确修复方式仍会使许多位置未被水印标记。我们提出SOLO，它保留请求范围的上下文历史，但将键值上下文锚定在由最小哈希选择的内容上，从而让兄弟响应极少竞争同一上下文，且随机编辑的影响局限在局部。其响应联合分布表现为独立的未水印响应，每个均可通过单一密钥检测。在来自三个家族的五种语言模型及三个基准测试中，SOLO保持了自一致性和不确定性估计，在1%假阳性率下，多数任务中检测到的响应数量超过四令牌密钥池，即使在随机编辑10%的令牌后仍表现更优，且在多数干净任务上优于上下文历史方法。代码已发布于 https://github.com/ZhongliangGuo/solo-watermark。

summary: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/suat-llm/ClueProbe.
title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?

title_translated: 视而不见，非无线索：视频大模型能否从部分证据中推断？
summary_translated: 在诸如第一人称记录、视觉可访问性及监控审查等真实应用场景中，视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）所获取的视觉证据往往只是部分捕获。一个可靠的模型应根据证据情况作出相应响应：证据充分时作答，部分证据时基于可见线索推测，证据缺失时则放弃回答。然而，现有基准强制采用二元可回答或不可回答划分，导致部分证据未被测量，也掩盖了失败是源于证据缺失还是误判充分性。我们引入ClueProbe，一种诊断性基准，旨在（1）分离感知证据与判断充分性的过程，（2）通过针对性微调验证诊断结果。ClueProbe包含1,721个由人类标注的问题，覆盖598段自然视频，问题标签分为可回答、可推测或不可回答，并附有控制扰动以改变措辞或视觉输入。评估10个开源和专有Video LLMs发现，失败原因在于判断而非感知：模型能感知证据，但缺乏对充分性的分级认知，倾向于直接作答或拒绝，很少基于部分线索进行推测。针对性微调表明，这是由于监督缺失而非容量不足：通过监督推测层级，适当推测率从1.6%提升至40.4%，且未增加误拒率；而传统拒绝微调则拒绝了92%的可推测问题。数据与代码将发布于 https://github.com/suat-llm/ClueProbe。

summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.
title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
title_translated: 通过隐藏状态混合与梯度解耦改进尾部增强的推测性草稿
summary_translated: 多标记预测（MTP）模块和EAGLE风格的草稿生成器通过重用目标模型的隐藏状态支持高效的推测解码。然而，其自回归使用引入了训练-推理不匹配问题：训练时提供来自主干或单步MTP的隐藏状态序列，而推理时则关注目标模型前缀及递归生成的MTP状态尾部。EAGLE-3的训练时间测试（TTT）虽显式模拟此行为，但需额外内存和专用注意力掩码。我们提出两种仅用于训练的方法以改进自回归草稿。隐藏状态混合（HSM）在对齐同一预测目标的主干与MTP隐藏状态间采样，使草稿生成器在不显式模拟推理的情况下接触不同MTP步骤的状态混合。隐藏状态梯度解耦（HSGD）是一种正则化方法，随机阻断隐藏状态和嵌入路径的梯度传播，同时保留前向计算。两种方法均不增加推理开销。在联合预训练后进行监督微调中，HSGD在草稿早期位置取得最高接受率，而HSM在后期表现最佳。这些接受率趋势表明，HSM更适合长草稿服务，HSGD更适合短草稿服务。此外，在四个Nemotron模型和DeepSeek-V4-Pro上，基于HSM的MTP增强（主干冻结）相比共同训练的MTP，平均接受长度提升高达52.2%。对于EAGLE-3草稿器，HSM在TTT竞争中表现相当，且在四步Qwen3-8B对比中峰值预留训练内存降低48%。HSM实现已公开于Megatron-LM和NVIDIA Model Optimizer。

summary: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models of 4B to 14B parameters such landscapes, with win curves from eBay closing prices and from a simulated advertising market (AuctionNet), and score their bids on held-out auctions against an exact calculator. Because the agent is handed the estimates, the lost value can be split by cause. Two failures belong to the models. They pass over the best option even when the values written in their own trace already rank it first, and their wrong answers lean toward the highest bid on the menu. The lean is about the bid's size, not its place in the list, and it survives sampling. At 768 forced tokens on eBay, under pay-your-bid pricing, the wrong answers cost bidders 7-17% of the surplus the calculator's bids earn. Arithmetic errors are rare. Two further losses come from operator choices. A token cap cuts traces short: allowed to stop on their own within 4,096 tokens, five models recover 91-100% of the calculator's lead over a model that does no reasoning. Asking for the answer while the reasoning block is still open misreads it: closing the block first lifts the weakest model from 42% to 84% on eBay and from 24% to 81% on AuctionNet. Finally, an audit that flags bids disagreeing with the trace's own numbers, and overrides them with the calculator's bid, raises the share of the calculator's lead recovered at 768 forced tokens from 42-85% to 84-100% on eBay under nested cross-validation, and the same reader settings transfer from eBay to AuctionNet.
title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding

title_translated: 预算、读出还是推理？小型推理模型在拍卖竞价中的价值流失分析
summary_translated: 广告平台和市场向竞标者展示出价格局，即在每个候选出价下的获胜概率估计，并越来越多地允许基于推理语言模型构建的智能体自主选择出价。我们向六种参数量为4B至14B的开放推理模型提供了来自eBay成交价格和模拟广告市场（AuctionNet）的胜率曲线，并将其出价在保留拍卖中与精确计算器的结果进行评分。由于智能体已获得估计值，可按原因分解其价值损失。其中两个失败源于模型本身：即使自身推理轨迹中已将最优选项排在首位，模型仍会忽略它；且错误答案倾向于选择菜单中最高的出价。这种倾向与出价大小有关，而非列表中的位置，且在采样后依然存在。在eBay上强制768个token、采用按出价支付定价时，错误答案导致竞标者损失计算器出价所获盈余的7%-17%。算术错误罕见。另外两个损失源于操作选择：令牌上限截断推理轨迹：允许在4096个token内自行停止，五个模型恢复了计算器领先优势的91%-100%，而无推理模型则无法恢复。在推理块仍开放时要求答案会导致误读：先关闭推理块可使最弱模型在eBay上的表现从42%提升至84%，在AuctionNet上从24%提升至81%。最后，一项审计机制会标记与推理轨迹数值不一致的出价，并以计算器出价覆盖，这使得在eBay上768个强制token条件下，所恢复的计算器领先份额从42%-85%提升至84%-100%（嵌套交叉验证），且相同设置可从eBay迁移至AuctionNet。

summary: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive experiments on four in-distribution and three out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DLaR achieves the highest average performance across model scales, reaching 27.9%/50.6% Pass@1/Pass@8 on Llama-3.2-1B and 46.8%/68.2% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Code: \href{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}.
title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
title_translated: DLaR：大语言模型潜在线索推理中的动态随机性控制
summary_translated: 潜在线索推理使大语言模型能够在连续嵌入空间中运行，但现有方法存在确定性推理问题，限制了多样化推理路径的探索。尽管近期方法引入随机性以恢复探索能力，但我们识别出两个根本局限：所有步骤的随机性分布均匀并非最优，且不受约束的扰动会破坏推理连贯性。为此，我们提出动态随机性控制潜在线索推理（DLaR），一个在GRPO强化学习框架内具有两个互补机制的框架，分别在不同时间粒度运作。在token层面，自适应随机性调制（ASM）根据置信度-熵融合信号动态调整每一步潜在线索的扰动强度，在模型不确定时增加探索，在自信时保持稳定。在训练层面，训练感知随机性调优（TAST）遵循课程学习调度逐步衰减基础随机性水平。通过这一双层设计，DLaR建立了一个分层的探索-利用策略，同时作用于token和训练层面。在四个分布内和三个分布外数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，DLaR在不同模型规模下均达到最高平均性能，在Llama-3.2-1B上实现Pass@1/Pass@8分别为27.9%/50.6%，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上达到46.8%/68.2%。代码已开源：https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR。

summary: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.
title: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench

title_translated: 技能提升实际测量的是什么？SkillsBench的源码级审计与噪声感知再分析
summary_translated: 智能体技能是编码智能体按需加载的指令、参考材料和脚本目录。根据SkillsBench，尽管人工标注的技能平均可将通过率提高约16.6个百分点，但某些任务中实际上降低了结果。后续研究开始根据任务级收益对技能进行筛选或剔除。我们对上述基准进行了源码级审计，并分析了7,554次公开试验，形成1,421个“(配置, 任务)单元”。源码审计识别出两例受控验证的评分依赖案例和一例操作定义缺口；在这三个任务上的平均提升达74.6个百分点，全集平均提升为18.7个百分点。审计还发现四个任务包含占位符技能目录，且特定执行框架在大多数运行中额外添加了48个内置技能。在经过多重检验校正的合并再分析中，未发现任何任务级削减具有统计显著性。由于每个单元最多仅有三次运行，观察到的负差异极易受运行抽样噪声影响，且从算术上看，58%的单元不可能出现下降。因此，原始负单元数量不能证明技能造成损害。基于无技能得分的筛选策略在日志中看似提升2-3个百分点；然而，即使在打乱条件标签以消除任何技能效应后，仍能实现4-7个百分点的提升。在未用于拟合和决策的保留运行中，也未发现统计显著改善。我们的审计记录和分析脚本已公开发布。

summary: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.
title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
title_translated: 循环模型是快速的多标记预测器
summary_translated: 循环语言模型可通过调整循环次数来适应预测单个标记的计算，而无需成比例地增加唯一模型参数。这一特性已被用于自推测解码，将浅层循环作为快速草稿器，深层循环作为验证器，效果良好，因为草稿阶段仍使用全部参数。本文表明，浅层循环也可预测多个未来标记，并利用这一点大幅加速循环语言模型的推理。为此，我们提出Floodgates，一种简单的自推测解码方法：在末尾附加一组掩码标记作为后缀，并通过低秩适配学习并行草稿这些标记。在七种模型、五个基准、多种批量大小以及贪婪和采样解码下，Floodgates在大多数情况下是最快速的无损解码方法，速度最高可达7.5倍加速。通过分析，我们发现这种加速得益于循环模型的全深度训练，浅层草稿器能够通过验证期间的深层前缀缓存条件，利用全深度计算。

summary: This paper proposes a new paradigm and method for giving large language models spatial understanding. Standard language models operate exclusively over discrete words (secondary representations of things rather than continuous space itself), forcing them to guess geometry verbally. Whereas most multimodal approaches equate spatial grounding with camera images or video frames, spatial structure itself is not a picture: it consists of coordinate frames, solid boundaries, and how objects move and relate to each other in continuous space. Motivated by this distinction, we place continuous object tokens combining pose (position, orientation, and scale) and signed-distance shape embeddings alongside word tokens inside a single uninterrupted transformer sequence, allowing language and geometry to attend to each other as object scenes are built and updated step by step. Control tokens switch output automatically between natural-language words and continuous object state updates to a persistent object workspace, while an attention mask blocks earlier prose when generating the answer, so responses must be read directly from settled geometry. To prove this method works, we attach a narrow parallel spatial stream (+4.4% weights) alongside unfrozen Qwen3-1.7B layers. In our two-dimensional tests, the model spawns and transforms multi-object scenes from English descriptions, transfers shapes to held-out nouns, and relies causally on the workspace to answer spatial questions.
title: The Missing Root: Geometric Imagination Without Images in Large Language Models

title_translated: 缺失的根源：大型语言模型中无图像的几何想象
summary_translated: 本文提出了一种新的范式和方法，以赋予大型语言模型空间理解能力。标准语言模型仅在离散词汇（事物的次级表示而非连续空间本身）上操作，迫使它们通过语言猜测几何结构。与大多数多模态方法将空间定位等同于相机图像或视频帧不同，空间结构本身并非图片：它由坐标系、实体边界以及物体在连续空间中的运动和相互关系构成。基于这一区分，我们在单一不间断的Transformer序列中引入了结合姿态（位置、方向和尺度）与带符号距离形状嵌入的连续对象标记，使语言和几何能够逐步构建和更新对象场景时相互关注。控制标记可自动在自然语言词汇与持续对象工作区的连续状态更新之间切换，同时注意力掩码在生成答案时屏蔽早期文本，因此响应必须直接从稳定后的几何结构中读取。为证明该方法有效，我们在未冻结的Qwen3-1.7B层旁添加了一个狭窄的并行空间流（+4.4%权重）。在二维测试中，模型能从英文描述生成并变换多对象场景，将形状转移到未见名词，并依赖工作区因果回答空间问题。

summary: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.
title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention

title_translated: 状态空间注意力：学习上下文相关的记忆保留
summary_translated: 标准注意力机制的键值缓存随上下文长度线性增长。限制其大小引发了关于序列模型应保留什么以进行长上下文推理的问题。我们认为这一选择应当被学习，并提出了状态空间注意力（SSA），它学习保留一个有限的过去表示集，并用标准注意力读取这些记忆。一个学习到的评分器对每个块相对于新到达的上下文和其余记忆进行重评分。固定上下文Transformer是始终保留最近标记的特例。我们联合训练评分器和读取器，或从可微软加权记忆逐渐过渡到硬保留，或从一开始就采用硬保留。为给评分器提供信号，我们在训练期间生成监督样本，这一技术称为恢复。我们在检索、变量跟踪、多跳推理和语言建模任务中将SSA与循环模型、有界记忆注意力方法及全注意力Transformer进行了比较。在我们的检索和推理基准测试中，SSA在大多数任务上达到或接近全注意力表现，远超具有相同可读预算的Transformer在所有长上下文检索任务上的表现，且优于约四倍预算的模型，同时使用恒定的推理内存。在小规模语言模型上，与全注意力之间的最大差距出现在RULER任务。SSA使固定数量的标记在更长的上下文中保持有用性，由于其使用标准注意力读取记忆，我们建议可将其与KV缓存淘汰方法堆叠。我们还预训练和后训练了4亿参数模型，并测量了SSA在上下文长度和模型规模下的训练与推理成本。这些实验共同考察了学习记忆保留在长上下文序列建模中的能力与局限。

summary: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with coarse Likert-style annotations, limiting scalability and making it difficult to obtain consistent, high-confidence annotations. We introduce Aligned Machine, an interactive, public-facing platform that transforms broad participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB) for evaluating semantic alignment in embedding-based systems. Participants complete a cognitively-natural, forced-choice task, comparing two pairs of items (text or images) and selecting which pair is more similar. This comparative design is accessible to non-experts, yields clean preference data, and supports robust aggregation. We report results from an initial deployment with 115 participants contributing 2,875 total labeled pairs and 872 unique pairs. Using HASB, we evaluated 12 widely used embedding models and found only partial alignment between embedding similarity and human judgments. Text-only models consistently achieve higher overall agreement than multimodal models, while multimodal performance varies systematically by task type: alignment is strongest for image-image comparisons, weaker for image-text comparisons, and lowest for text-text comparisons. Aligned Machine is designed to evolve over time as participation grows, supporting longitudinal analysis, domain-specific studies, bias detection, and measurement of concept drift across model versions. By combining accessible public participation with rigorous comparative evaluation, HASB provides a scalable and accountable framework for auditing semantic alignment in embedding models.
title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
title_translated: 对齐机器：通过人类比较判断评估多模态嵌入相似性的基准
summary_translated: 嵌入模型越来越多地影响人们搜索、推荐和检索信息的方式，但我们缺乏可信的方法来检验这些相似性判断是否反映了人类对意义的理解。现有基准通常依赖静态、专家标注的成对数据，采用粗略的李克特量表注释，限制了可扩展性，也难以获得一致且高置信度的标注。我们推出了“对齐机器”（Aligned Machine），一个交互式、面向公众的平台，将广泛参与转化为持续增长的人类对齐相似性基准（HASB），用于评估基于嵌入系统的语义对齐情况。参与者完成一种认知自然的强制选择任务，比较两组项目（文本或图像）并选择哪一组更相似。这种对比设计对非专家友好，产生清晰的偏好数据，并支持稳健聚合。我们报告了首次部署的结果，115名参与者贡献了2,875个标注对，涵盖872个唯一配对。利用HASB，我们评估了12个广泛使用的嵌入模型，发现嵌入相似性与人类判断之间仅有部分对齐。纯文本模型总体一致性高于多模态模型，而多模态性能按任务类型系统性变化：图像-图像比较对齐最强，图像-文本比较较弱，文本-文本比较最低。对齐机器设计为随参与度增长而持续演进，支持纵向分析、领域特定研究、偏见检测以及跨模型版本的概念漂移测量。通过结合可访问的公众参与与严谨的对比评估，HASB为嵌入模型的语义对齐审计提供了一个可扩展且可问责的框架。

summary: 3D sign language generation aims to produce signing motion from written text. Motivated by the linguistic nature of sign language, recent methods combine a motion tokenizer with a language model to predict motion tokens from text. However, both components are optimized through a two-stage pipeline with mismatched objectives: the tokenizer minimizes reconstruction error in isolation, while the generator learns from rigid one-hot reference tokens. A straightforward end-to-end extension bridges discrete token selection with straight-through estimators (STE), suffering from biased gradients and codebook collapse. To address these limitations, we propose SEEL, an end-to-end framework that aligns tokenization and generation with motion quality through two complementary mechanisms. First, to overcome rigid one-hot supervision, reconstruction-aware generation decodes candidate tokens in context and converts their 3D motion errors into soft targets, guiding the generator with physical motion quality. Second, to propagate generation feedback without STE, generation-aware tokenization passes continuous codebook expectations through the frozen generator, routing generated-motion gradients to the tokenizer to prevent codebook collapse. Combining both mechanisms enables the tokenizer and generator to co-evolve, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and Phoenix-2014T. Code and models will be released to facilitate future research.
title: SEEL: Towards End-to-End 3D Sign Generation with Language Models
title_translated: SEEL：迈向基于语言模型的端到端3D手语生成
summary_translated: 3D手语生成旨在从书面文本生成手语动作。受手语的语言特性启发，近期方法结合动作分词器与语言模型，从文本预测动作标记。然而，这两个组件通过两阶段流水线优化，目标不匹配：分词器独立最小化重建误差，而生成器则从刚性的独热参考标记学习。简单的端到端扩展通过直通估计器（STE）连接离散标记选择，导致梯度偏差和代码本坍塌。为解决这些局限，我们提出SEEL，一种通过两种互补机制实现分词与生成对齐的端到端框架。首先，为克服刚性独热监督，重构感知生成在上下文中解码候选标记，并将3D动作误差转换为软目标，以物理动作质量引导生成器。其次，为在不使用STE的情况下传播生成反馈，生成感知分词通过冻结生成器传递连续代码本期望，将生成动作梯度路由至分词器，防止代码本坍塌。结合两种机制，使分词器与生成器协同进化，在CSL-Daily、How2Sign和Phoenix-2014T数据集上达到最先进性能。代码与模型将公开，以促进未来研究。

summary: Can we distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from those using AI only to rewrite human judgement? Furthermore, can we do so reliably when reviews are generated from diverse AI models and workflows across scientific domains? To this end, we introduce PeerReveal, a new detector that grounds its decisions in learned relationships between a review's claims and reference claims drawn from AI-generated reviews of the same paper, complemented by review-level textual signals. We evaluate PeerReveal on PeerShift, a new, challenging test set of 5,430 reviews spanning multiple domains, including machine learning, life sciences, and social sciences, combining variation in disciplinary review conventions with diverse AI review-production mechanisms. With regular training, PeerReveal achieves 70.52% pooled Macro-F1 on this benchmark, improving over the strongest baseline by 11.48 points. We develop an effective and practical adversarial training framework that further improves the detector's generalization using a small local generator optimized to produce challenging reviews, raising pooled Macro-F1 from 70.52% to 82.40%. These results show that robust AI-review detection benefits from richer review-level evidence and adversarial training on more challenging generation processes.
title: PeerReveal: Learning to Generalize in AI Peer Review Detection
title_translated: PeerReveal：在AI同行评审检测中学习泛化
summary_translated: 我们能否可靠地区分完全由AI生成的评审与仅使用AI重写人类判断的评审？此外，当评审来自不同AI模型和跨科学领域的多样化工作流程时，我们能否做到这一点？为此，我们引入PeerReveal，一种基于学习到的评审主张与其来源AI生成评审中参考主张之间关系的检测器，辅以评审级别的文本信号。我们在PeerShift上评估PeerReveal，这是一个新的、具有挑战性的测试集，包含5,430篇跨越多个领域（包括机器学习、生命科学和社会科学）的评审，融合了学科评审惯例的变化与多样化的AI评审生成机制。在常规训练下，PeerReveal在该基准上取得70.52%的综合宏F1，比最强基线提升11.48个百分点。我们开发了一种有效且实用的对抗训练框架，使用一个小规模本地生成器优化以生成更具挑战性的评审，进一步提升检测器泛化能力，使综合宏F1从70.52%提升至82.40%。结果表明，鲁棒的AI评审检测受益于更丰富的评审级别证据以及在更具挑战性的生成过程上的对抗训练。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically optimises evidence selection for semantic relevance, whereas compliance-sensitive long-form generation also requires evidence supporting explicit structural obligations. Semantically relevant retrieval may therefore omit information needed for mandatory downstream clauses. We propose Constraint-Aligned RAG (CA-RAG), a retrieval-conditioning framework that augments section-specific queries with ontology-derived structural constraints and policy-grounded knowledge-graph relations before evidence selection. Retrieval-only evaluation with manually annotated evidence shows consistent improvements across retrieval budgets. At $k=6$, CA-RAG increases Precision@$k$ from $0.5268$ to $0.5692$, pooled Recall@$k$ from $0.5402$ to $0.5950$, and F1@$k$ from $0.5389$ to $0.5672$ over standard RAG. Generation experiments further show improvements in compliance and reliability in several model--domain settings, while generation-only constraints achieve higher clause coverage but lower overall compliance and reliability. These results indicate that structurally aligned retrieval can improve evidence sufficiency in compliance-sensitive long-form generation.
title: CA-RAG: Constraint-Aligned Retrieval for Structurally Faithful Long-Form Generation

title_translated: CA-RAG：结构忠实的长文本生成中的约束对齐检索
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）通常优化证据选择以实现语义相关性，但在合规敏感的长文本生成中，还要求证据支持明确的结构义务。因此，仅语义相关的检索可能遗漏下游必要条款所需的信息。我们提出约束对齐检索（CA-RAG），一种在证据选择前将特定章节查询与本体导出的结构约束及基于政策的知识图谱关系相结合的检索调节框架。仅通过检索的评估显示，在不同检索预算下均有持续改进。在 $k=6$ 时，CA-RAG 将标准 RAG 的 Precision@$k$ 从 0.5268 提升至 0.5692，Pooled Recall@$k$ 从 0.5402 提升至 0.5950，F1@$k$ 从 0.5389 提升至 0.5672。生成实验进一步表明，在多个模型-领域设置中，合规性和可靠性均有所提升；而仅使用生成阶段约束虽能提高条款覆盖率，但整体合规性和可靠性较低。结果表明，结构对齐的检索可提升合规敏感型长文本生成中的证据充分性。

summary: The success of language models has motivated theoretical work on learning to sample from distributions on discrete domains. A prominent abstraction is the model of language generation in the limit, introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan (NeurIPS 2024), in which the algorithm must generate from the target language after some finite but unspecified number of positive examples. While its positive results are surprisingly general, most guarantees are qualitative. In this work, we seek quantitative guarantees on sample and time complexity, inspired by statistical and computational learning theory.   To this end, we study a PAC model of language generation, proposed (in a different context) by De, Diakonikolas, and Servedio (SODA 2015), in which a Boolean concept class $C$ over $\{-1,1\}^n$ defines the target languages: given uniformly random positive examples of an unknown concept $f \in C$, the learner must output a sampler whose output distribution (conditioned on the training data) is close in total variation to the uniform distribution over $f^{-1}(1)$. Their work implicitly gives an efficient algorithm for PAC learning to sample $C$, given three primitives for $C$: an online learner, approximate sampling and counting oracles, and an SQ learner.   We ask whether these ingredients, in particular online learnability, are necessary. First, we construct a Boolean concept class $C$ for which online learning is cryptographically hard, yet PAC learning to sample is computationally efficient. Then, we develop new algorithms that use offline ERM oracles instead of online learners, together with approximate sampling/counting oracles for intersections of concepts in $C$ and an SQ learner for $C$. We view our results, together with the work of De, Diakonikolas, and Servedio, as a first step towards understanding the computational complexity of language generation.
title: PAC Learning to Sample: On Computational Aspects of Language Generation
title_translated: PAC学习采样：语言生成的计算方面
summary_translated:
语言模型的成功激发了在离散域分布上学习采样的理论研究。一个突出的抽象是 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan（NeurIPS 2024）提出的语言生成极限模型，其中算法在经过有限但未指定数量的正例后，必须从目标语言中生成。尽管其正面结果出人意料地普遍，但大多数保证是定性的。本文旨在获得关于样本复杂度和时间复杂度的定量保证，受统计与计算学习理论启发。为此，我们研究了由 De、Diakonikolas 和 Servedio（SODA 2015）提出的 PAC 语言生成模型（在另一背景下提出），其中定义目标语言的布尔概念类 $C$ 作用于 $\\-1,1\
^n$：给定未知概念 $f \in C$ 的均匀随机正例，学习者必须输出一个采样器，其输出分布（在训练数据条件下）与 $f^{-1}(1)$ 上的均匀分布之间的总变差距离接近。他们的工作隐含地给出了一个高效算法，用于在具备三个基本组件的前提下 PAC 学习采样 $C$：在线学习器、近似采样与计数预言机，以及 SQ 学习器。我们探讨这些成分，特别是在线可学习性，是否为必要条件。首先，我们构造了一个在线学习在密码学上困难的布尔概念类 $C$，但 PAC 学习采样却可在计算上高效完成。随后，我们开发了新算法，使用离线 ERM 预言机替代在线学习器，并结合概念交集的近似采样/计数预言机以及 $C$ 的 SQ 学习器。我们认为，结合 De 等人的工作，我们的成果是理解语言生成计算复杂性的重要第一步。

summary: Reliable deployment of Vision Language Models (VLMs) requires that a model's expressed confidence remain grounded in what it can actually see, and that it recognize when the visual evidence is too ambiguous to commit to a confident response. Standard post-training uses outcome reward models (ORMs) that supervise only the final decision, rewarding a confident answer regardless of whether the image supports one, while existing methods either tend to detect uncertainty post-hoc or assume an objective verdict always exists. We instead split multimodal reasoning into two stages: perception, where the model must factually describe the scene, and calibration, where it must judge whether that evidence is sufficient to commit to a conclusion. We introduce HumblePRM, a lightweight process reward model (PRM) that scores each stage independently, rewarding agreement between evidence and expressed confidence rather than outcome correctness alone. Training with HumblePRM increases abstention due to uncertainty on ambiguous inputs considerably while leaving accuracy on clear images roughly unchanged. We also find that the improvement transfers to Gemma 4 E4B, a larger, popular edge model. Our findings show that process reward supervision is a promising route to VLMs with better calibrated abstention, ensuring more reliability rather than unpredictable behavior.
title: HumblePRM: Improving VLM Abstention in Ambiguous Situations through Process Reward Modeling
title_translated: HumblePRM：通过过程奖励建模提升视觉语言模型在模糊情境下的回避能力
summary_translated: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）的可靠部署要求模型表达的信心与其实际可见内容保持一致，并能在视觉证据过于模糊时识别出无法做出自信回答的情况。标准后训练使用仅监督最终决策的结果奖励模型（ORMs），无论图像是否支持该答案，都会奖励自信回答；而现有方法要么倾向于事后检测不确定性，要么假设客观结论始终存在。我们则将多模态推理分为两个阶段：感知阶段，模型必须真实描述场景；校准阶段，模型必须判断该证据是否足以得出结论。我们引入 HumblePRM，一种轻量级的过程奖励模型（PRM），独立评分每个阶段，奖励证据与表达信心的一致性，而非仅关注结果正确性。使用 HumblePRM 训练显著提升了在模糊输入下的回避行为，同时在清晰图像上的准确率基本不变。我们还发现该改进可迁移至 Gemma 4 E4B 这一更大、流行的边缘模型。研究结果表明，过程奖励监督是实现更校准的回避行为的有前景路径，从而确保更高的可靠性而非不可预测的行为。

summary: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. We explore this gap as a hypothesis we term temporal alignment friction: a conflict where global audio representations disrupt the chronological sequence of visual frames, leading to penalties under visually-focused evaluation metrics. Consequently, by stripping away the audio, our Video-Only ablation conforms more closely to this rigid syntax, achieving 63.0 CIDEr. While trailing larger models such as Qwen2.5-VL (67.4 CIDEr), this establishes a strong baseline for sub-3B parameter LLM-based models. This indicates that CIDEr, as applied to datasets such as MSR-VTT, may exhibit a bias toward visually grounded syntax, limiting its ability to fully capture multimodal semantic richness.
title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning

title_translated: 以语义为先的多模态视频字幕生成：基于冻结编码器与稳定强化学习的方法
summary_translated: 我们提出音频-视觉查询变换器（AVQFormer），一种基于 27 亿参数大语言模型的高效架构，包含固定长度 $K=16$ 的语义对齐模块，通过熵正则化的自批判序列训练（ASCST）实现稳定。多模态大语言模型（LLMs）常依赖全局音频表示来弥补低效的帧级视觉编码器。尽管第一阶段提示评估表明多模态基础模型实现了强大的深层语义对齐（BERTScore F1 得分为 0.889），但针对传统指标优化时暴露出性能差距。我们将其视为一种称为“时间对齐摩擦”的假设：全局音频表示与视觉帧的时间顺序之间存在冲突，导致在以视觉为中心的评估指标下受到惩罚。因此，通过移除音频，我们的仅视频消融版本更符合这种严格的语法结构，达到 63.0 的 CIDEr 分数。虽然低于 Qwen2.5-VL（67.4 CIDEr）等更大模型，但这为参数量小于 30 亿的 LLM 基模型建立了强有力的基线。这表明，CIDEr 在 MSR-VTT 等数据集上的应用可能存在偏向于视觉根基语法的偏差，限制了其全面捕捉多模态语义丰富性的能力。

summary: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing. With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.
title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows

title_translated: 部分路由：面向资源高效的智能体工作流的轨迹调优委托机制
summary_translated: AI 模型的能力和价格差异巨大。模型路由利用这一特性，将简单任务分配给更便宜的模型。然而，单个智能体任务通常包含简单与复杂的子任务，使得对整个任务采用单一模型选择效率低下。我们提出部分路由，引导主模型在执行过程中将合适的子任务委派给更廉价的工作者模型。基于两模型过往运行记录，我们识别出重复出现的子任务，并测量各模型在这些任务上的质量与成本表现。这些测量结果生成委托指导策略，其中参数 $δ$ 控制委派程度。主模型在执行期间自主决定何时以及如何委派，且无需训练任一模型。在 ViBench 和 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的保留任务上，部分路由的平均任务性能优于主模型单独运行或任务级路由。当 $δ=0.75$ 时，主模型在 ViBench 上得分从 70.2 提升至 78.5，成本降低 19%；在 Terminal-Bench 上通过率从 54% 提升至 61%，成本相近。即使仅提供子任务分解而不配备工作者模型，也能在两个基准上降低开销并提升 Terminal-Bench 通过率。结果表明，对历史运行的分析可支持更高效的规划与更有效的委托，且代价极低、实现开销小。

summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated decision-making. However, LLMs may produce incorrect answers with high confidence, limiting their applicability in decisions that affect individuals and organizations. Reliable confidence scores are necessary to gate such decisions, and existing estimates are frequently unavailable or too coarse to support effective gating. This work uses supervised learning to train models to predict the correctness of LLM-generated answers, enabling automated confident responses and routing uncertain ones for human review. A linear confidence score head is fitted to the final-layer hidden state of the frozen LLM backbone, and text-only metamodels are trained as an alternative for closed models. All results come from a single 2B-parameter backbone, on graded answers that are about 98% SQuAD and the remainder TruthfulQA. Against multiple baselines, the confidence score head outperforms all baselines and metamodels, automating the largest fraction of the workload at high accuracy targets. Prompted confidence scores can appear well calibrated yet lack the resolution needed for thresholding. Although transferability to unseen datasets is modest, the confidence score head remains the most robust approach. The proposed confidence scoring framework enhances the safety of automating LLM-based agents and can be adapted to gate other properties, including safety or compliance.
title: Confidence scores for gated automation of large language models
title_translated: 基于门控机制的大语言模型自动化中的置信度评分
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLMs）构建的智能体在自动化决策中表现出强大能力。然而，LLMs 可能在高置信度下产生错误答案，限制了其在影响个人和组织决策中的应用。可靠的置信度评分对于控制此类决策至关重要，而现有的估计往往不可用或过于粗糙，无法有效支持门控。本文通过监督学习训练模型来预测 LLM 生成答案的正确性，从而实现自动化的高置信响应，并将不确定结果路由至人工审核。采用线性置信度评分头拟合冻结的 LLM 主干网络最后一层隐藏状态，同时训练仅文本的元模型作为封闭模型的替代方案。所有实验均基于单一 2B 参数主干，在约 98% 的 SQuAD 和其余 TruthfulQA 的分级答案上进行。与多个基线相比，置信度评分头在高精度目标下表现最优，自动化了最大比例的工作量。提示式置信度评分看似校准良好，但缺乏阈值判断所需的分辨率。尽管在未见数据集上的迁移能力有限，置信度评分头仍是最稳健的方法。所提出的置信度评分框架提升了基于 LLM 智能体自动化的安全性，并可扩展用于控制其他属性，如安全性和合规性。

summary: Degraded images make vision-language models answer wrongly. Using synthetic paired blur, noise, and low light, we trace which clean image states can still repair those answers from the vision encoder through the language model. In four encoder models, 12 to 23 ranked tokens recover half of the full-patch effect, whereas random orders require four to fifteen times as many; encoder-free Gemma needs 22.2 versus 53.1. Full-block repair expires at a model-specific language-model crossing. The matched reverse-direction intervention is algebraically identical to text-token restoration, so its gap from image restoration measures a redundancy band rather than an independent predictor. A clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair with 1.53-layer error, against 3.65 for shared depth. Gemma MMBench has the only large attention-to-repair point gap; Gemma GQA does not. Restormer provides a non-oracle consistency check on two models.
title: Measuring and Predicting Image-Token Repair Boundaries in Vision-Language Models

summary: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. Before any edit, its answers often have the right minute and the wrong separator, and fixing only the separator lifts their mIoU from 13.1 to 19.2. Every improving edit beats a random edit of its size, and the edited models run as fast as before.
title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors

summary_translated: 外科医生先找出问题所在，再仅修复该部分。我们将这一理念应用于视频定位任务，其中视频-语言模型常能准确找到长视频中的正确时刻，但时间标注错误。在时间权重手术（TWS）中，一个通用的 LLM 读取模型的权重和激活值，识别错误来源并在此处进行修复，无需梯度更新。多次独立会话均发现相同原因，这种对模型失败位置与原因的诊断是本文的主要贡献。三次 GPT-6 Astra 会话将 TimeLens-8B 中丢失的数字归因于一个 MLP 层，最大编辑使 1,215 个未见问题的 mIoU 提升 7.9，30 分钟以上视频的 mIoU 提升 18.3。两次 Claude Opus 5.5 会话将 Qwen3-VL-8B 中将分钟误写为秒的问题归因于分隔符，分别带来 2.9 和 1.3 的提升。在任何编辑前，其答案通常具有正确的分钟但错误的分隔符，仅修复分隔符即可使 mIoU 从 13.1 提升至 19.2。每次改进的编辑均优于同规模的随机编辑，且修改后的模型运行速度与之前一致。

summary: AI-assisted coding ranges from fully agentic coding to inline code suggestions in the editor. Inline suggestions require predicting a developer's most likely next edit from an editing session. The next edit may lie at the cursor, in nearby lines, or farther away, and one editing intent can span several of these. The preceding system queries separate completion, nearby edit, and long-distance edit models, each with its own output format, in a fixed sequence; it thus cannot express intents spanning distant locations in one response, can require several sequential model calls per suggestion, and prioritizes completion even when a correction would serve better. We present a unified model that predicts all three edit types in one output space: a sequence of anchored diff patches specifying locations, deleted lines, and added lines. This representation permits multiple edits per response, so the client can serve later edits from a cache without further model calls. We train this model in two phases, first unifying next edit and long-distance edit prediction, then adding code completion. We synthesize multi-edit supervision from single-edit data via model pseudolabeling and edit history playback. We use a binary LLM-graded reward, a patch validity taxonomy shared by data filtering, reward, and evaluation, and grader boosting for targeted failure modes. Phase 2 also adapts how the client processes and presents model outputs. In controlled online A/B experiments in GitHub Copilot, Phase 1 significantly reduces time to display by 6.77% and output tokens by 58.93% relative to the three-model baseline. In Phase 2, the 3-in-1 model and client adaptations reduce dismissed suggestions per user by 10.06% relative to the 2-in-1 model paired with the completion model. Throughout this report, we also share our methodology and learnings in evaluation, training, and end-to-end model and system design.
title: Building a Unified Inline Code Editing Model for GitHub Copilot

title_translated: 构建 GitHub Copilot 的统一内联代码编辑模型
summary_translated: AI 辅助编程涵盖从完全自主的编程到编辑器中的内联代码建议。内联建议需要从编辑会话中预测开发者最可能的下一步编辑。下一步编辑可能位于光标处、邻近行或更远位置，且一种编辑意图可能跨越多个区域。现有系统需依次调用独立的补全、邻近编辑和远距离编辑模型，每种模型输出格式不同，固定序列导致无法在一个响应中表达跨越远距离的意图，可能需要多次模型调用，且优先考虑补全而非更优的修正。我们提出一个统一模型，将三种编辑类型在同一输出空间中预测：一组锚定的 diff 补丁，指定位置、删除行和新增行。该表示允许单次响应包含多个编辑，客户端可从缓存中提供后续编辑而无需额外模型调用。该模型分两阶段训练：首先统一下一步编辑与远距离编辑预测，然后加入代码补全。通过模型伪标签和编辑历史回放，从单编辑数据合成多编辑监督信号。采用二值 LLM 评分奖励，共享的补丁有效性分类体系用于数据过滤、奖励和评估，并引入评分器增强以针对特定失败模式。第二阶段还调整了客户端对模型输出的处理与展示方式。在 GitHub Copilot 的受控在线 A/B 实验中，第一阶段相比三模型基线，显示时间减少 6.77%，输出 token 数减少 58.93%。第二阶段中，3-in-1 模型与客户端优化相比 2-in-1 模型加补全模型，用户拒绝建议次数减少 10.06%。本报告还分享了评估、训练及端到端模型与系统设计的方法论与经验。

summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.
title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
title_translated: 雅各比空间中的柏拉图表征假设：语言与视觉模型大致按旋转一致
summary_translated: 柏拉图表征假设（PRH）认为，即使在不同数据模态上训练，AI 模型也会收敛到对世界的共享表征。先前研究已在视觉与语言模型的激活中发现了 PRH 的证据。本文探讨视觉与语言模型是否也在如何作用于这些表征上趋于一致：即内部表征如何影响模型输出。在 Transformer 的某一选定层，雅各比视角为词汇表中的每个词（或图像分类器中的每个类别）赋予一个隐藏状态向量：该向量在当前位置或之后最能增加模型生成该词或预测该类别的倾向。这些向量共同构成所谓的模型 J 空间。我们在视觉与语言模型的 J 空间中发现了 PRH 的证据，并进一步发现 J 空间主要在旋转意义下收敛。即，仅在部分词语上拟合的单一旋转，即可近似地将一个模型的 J 空间映射到另一个模型，且适用于未参与拟合的词与类别。将文本语言模型的 J 空间中某词的向量旋转至视觉-语言模型的视觉标记，会改变该模型声称图像中物体的内容（且仅在添加区域）。将其旋转至图像生成器的文本条件输入，会改变生成图像中的物体。旋转至未使用文本训练的 ImageNet 分类器，会使其类别得分高于几乎所有其他类别，反之亦然。这表明模型不仅在世界表征上收敛，也在如何作用于表征上趋于一致。

summary: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a problem actually requires, relative to a stated set of inference rules. For each problem, we compute the steps every proof must make, the shortest proof, the number of minimal proofs and the indispensable premises, and export certificates that an independent checker verifies. Audits of eight datasets find depth that is forced (ProofWriter, Blocksworld), problems labelled depth 5 that require about two specific rule applications (FLDx2), and answers that need no particular step (ZebraLogic). We then construct problems whose every proof has a requested structure, using a catalog of shortcuts proved once per rule set. Every constructed problem is checked in full and comes with its own certificate. In training, the best data mixes depths and problem types. At equal size, such mixtures of certified problem types, including model-checking problems that forward generation does not produce, transfer better than FLDx2-style derivation data for Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B.
title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data

title_translated: 验证你所设定的：逻辑推理数据中无捷径的证明深度
summary_translated: 程序生成的逻辑问题被用于评估和训练语言模型的推理能力。其难度通常通过‘植入证明’来设定，即采样一个期望深度的证明，并将前提作为问题。然而，植入的证明只是可能的证明之一，一个问题也可能存在更短的证明或多个无关的证明，因此标称的深度会高估解决问题所需的能力。我们测量了在给定推理规则集下，一个问题实际需要的推理步骤。对于每个问题，我们计算所有证明必须进行的步骤、最短证明、最小证明的数量以及不可或缺的前提，并导出由独立检查器验证的证书。对八个数据集的审计发现，某些数据集的深度是强制性的（ProofWriter, Blocksworld），某些标为深度5的问题实际上仅需约两个特定规则的应用（FLDx2），而某些答案则无需任何特定步骤（ZebraLogic）。随后，我们构建了所有证明都具有指定结构的问题，使用每套规则集一次性证明过的捷径目录。每个构造的问题均经过完整验证并附带自己的证书。在训练中，最佳的数据混合包含不同深度和问题类型。在相同规模下，这种经认证的问题类型混合（包括前向生成无法产生的模型检验问题）相较于FLDx2风格的推导数据，在Qwen3模型从0.6B到8B的迁移中表现更优。

summary: Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. While during pretraining the model's ability to generate with the correct grammar rules coincides with building the internal representations of the corresponding latent, we find that SFT exhibits a very different dynamics: (i) the generation of deleted rules changes on a fast timescale inversely proportional to the magnitude of the token-latent correlation; meanwhile, their corresponding representations stay intact; (ii) the hidden representations of the deleted rules become forgotten on a much longer timescale, associated with a slow drift of the network parameters. Finally, we observe analogous results in a realistic setup with natural language, suggesting that this timescale separation in forgetting is a more general phenomenon of fine-tuning language models.
title: Two Timescales of Forgetting in Fine-tuning of Language Models: Fast Behavioral Suppression and Slow Representational Drift

title_translated: 语言模型微调中的遗忘双时间尺度：快速行为抑制与缓慢表征漂移
summary_translated: 当前人工智能系统的核心流程是先在广泛文本语料上进行预训练，再针对特定任务或期望行为进行微调。然而，我们对在有限数据分布上微调如何改变预训练期间获得的表征仍了解甚少。特别是，表面行为抑制是否伴随支撑其的潜在表征的消除尚不明确。本文研究监督微调（SFT），通过在具有分层潜在结构的受控上下文无关语法——随机层次模型（RHM）上预训练Transformer，并使用其生成规则的子集进行微调。尽管在预训练阶段，模型正确使用语法规则的能力与其内部对应潜在表征的建立同步，但我们发现SFT表现出截然不同的动态：(i) 被删除规则的生成在快速时间尺度上变化，且与词元-潜在相关性的大小成反比；而这些规则对应的表征保持完整；(ii) 被删除规则的隐藏表征在更长的时间尺度上逐渐遗忘，与网络参数的缓慢漂移相关。最后，我们在真实自然语言设置中观察到类似结果，表明这种遗忘的时间尺度分离是语言模型微调中的普遍现象。

summary: Abstract interpretation can certify properties of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), but precise analyses remain expensive. General implementations repeat work when analyzing the same architecture under different inputs and properties. Interleaving this work with numerical operations limits GPU utilization and restricts how much of the analysis a tensor compiler can process together.   We present Scepter, a framework for specializing DNN abstract interpreters through structural semantics. The semantics determine the structure of intermediate abstract values while deferring their numerical evaluation. Structural computations from successive operations can therefore be performed together before certification, generating an executable tensor program. With the abstract interpreter and DNN architecture fixed, the program can be reused with different weights and input regions. We prove that it computes the same bounds as the general interpreter in exact arithmetic. The generated program also exposes operations and their dependencies for tensor compilation and memory planning. We implement Scepter for the tensor programs that Neuton generates from ConstraintFlow specifications.   We evaluate Scepter on eight abstract interpreters and 44 DNNs against six baseline systems on GPUs and CPUs. Scepter handles networks with up to 153x as many neurons as the largest completed by the corresponding baselines. It completes DeepPoly on ResNet50 and VGG-16, whereas none of the evaluated DeepPoly baselines completes either network. On configurations completed by both systems, GPU geometric-mean speedups over Neuton range from 11.9x to 44.4x across eight analyses, with a 2.60x geometric-mean reduction in peak memory. In an input-splitting case study, Scepter proves 68 properties for which the baselines time out.   Code: https://github.com/uiuc-focal-lab/constraintflow.git
title: Fast and Scalable Abstract Interpretation for Deep Neural Networks
title_translated: 面向深度神经网络的快速可扩展抽象解释
summary_translated: 抽象解释可用于验证深度神经网络（DNNs）的性质，但精确分析仍然代价高昂。通用实现会在分析同一架构的不同输入和性质时重复工作，且将此类工作与数值操作交错进行，限制了GPU利用率，并制约了张量编译器能同时处理的分析量。我们提出Scepter框架，通过结构语义专门化DNN抽象解释器。该语义决定中间抽象值的结构，同时推迟其数值求值。因此，连续操作的结构计算可在认证前统一执行，生成可执行的张量程序。在抽象解释器和DNN架构固定后，该程序可复用于不同权重和输入区域。我们证明该程序在精确算术下计算结果与通用解释器一致。生成的程序还暴露了操作及其依赖关系，便于张量编译和内存规划。我们实现了Scepter，用于从ConstraintFlow规范生成的张量程序。我们在八种抽象解释器和44个DNN上评估Scepter，对比六种基线系统在GPU和CPU上的表现。Scepter可处理的神经元数量最多达基线最大完成网络的153倍。它成功完成了DeepPoly对ResNet50和VGG-16的分析，而所有评估的DeepPoly基线均未能完成。在两者均可完成的配置上，GPU几何平均加速比从11.9x到44.4x不等，峰值内存减少2.60倍。在输入分割案例研究中，Scepter证明了68条基线超时无法证明的性质。

summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) distribute reasoning across specialized agents that must exchange messages and invoke tools reliably. Existing evaluations typically couple communication with open domain tasks, making it difficult to determine whether a failure arises from reasoning, malformed tool use, lost messages, or forgotten requests. Prior benchmarks do not isolate communication execution or measure routing redundancy against a known optimal path. We introduce CypherMAS, a synthetic benchmark that isolates communication and routing in fixed multi-agent graphs. Agents in chain, star, bipartite, or ring graphs route cyphered messages to remote peers holding the matching decoders; since the optimal route is known, redundant LLM calls can be measured and routing failures may be easily tracked. Across eleven open-weight models from 4B to 753B, small models fail at routing and tool use, dense models above 27B degrade with diameter, and successful runs exceed minimum LLM calls. These findings identify communication reliability as a distinct scaling bottleneck for multi-agent systems and provide a controlled diagnostic for complex multi-agent systems. The source code is freely available: https://github.com/Andoree/CypherMAS.
title: CypherMAS: Benchmarking Routing Reliability in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

title_translated: CypherMAS：基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中路由可靠性的基准测试
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体系统（MAS）将推理分配给专业化智能体，这些智能体必须可靠地交换消息并调用工具。现有评估通常将通信与开放域任务耦合，难以判断失败是源于推理错误、工具使用不当、消息丢失还是请求遗忘。先前的基准测试未隔离通信执行过程，也未以已知最优路径为参照衡量路由冗余。我们引入CypherMAS，一个合成基准，专门隔离多智能体图中的通信与路由。在链式、星型、二分图或环形图中，智能体需将加密消息路由至持有匹配解码器的远程同伴；由于最优路径已知，可度量冗余的LLM调用并轻松追踪路由失败。在11个从4B到753B的开源模型上测试发现，小模型在路由和工具使用上失败，超过27B的密集模型随图直径增大而性能下降，成功运行的实例均超过最低LLM调用次数。这些发现揭示了通信可靠性是多智能体系统的独特缩放瓶颈，并为复杂多智能体系统提供了可控诊断工具。源代码免费提供：https://github.com/Andoree/CypherMAS。

summary: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($ρ$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $ρ$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks. They falsely flagged 56.9% of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy and detected only 18% of checkpoints after task success fell to zero. Thus, global semantic density did not provide a reliable warning, while local crowding did not transfer consistently across memory designs. In these long-horizon runs, size-limited stores remained stable, while the sole failure arose when unbounded whole-store prompting exceeded model input capacity, which token growth predicted directly.
title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
title_translated: 语义密度无法预测智能体记忆崩溃
summary_translated: 持久的文本记忆可提升LLM智能体的表现，但重复更新可能导致任务性能下降。我们探究记忆存储的统计特征是否能在保留准确率下降前发出预警。我们在ALFWorld、AppWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop及两个ARC-AGI设置中，对13种记忆方法共805个快照进行了注册，涵盖轨迹、规则、工作流、策略或链接记录的存储方式，采用选择性检索或全存储提示。结果显示，没有任何统计特征能可靠预测任务准确率下降的早期迹象，ρ（平均成对余弦相似度）的中位领先时间为零。以峰值准确率后的检查点作为次级下降点，高度相似对和最近邻拥挤度虽变化较早，但并未持续优于存储项数量。我们在此数据集上训练分类器，并将其直接应用于PropWorld中长达5000个制造任务的运行。结果发现，该分类器错误标记了56.9%的尺寸受限存储中准确率稳定的检查点，仅检测到18%的任务成功后准确率归零的检查点。因此，全局语义密度无法提供可靠预警，局部拥挤度在不同记忆设计间亦不具备一致性迁移能力。在这些长周期运行中，尺寸受限存储保持稳定，唯一失败发生在无界全存储提示超出模型输入容量时，而这一情况可通过token增长直接预测。

summary: A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. Dream-instruct is the exception, mainly on prose, where its conditionals are least self-consistent. Among six common marginal rules, pooling over the set beats gating on its weakest position in all 24 paired comparisons. The measurement needs a validated readout: Dream and LLaDA place a position's prediction at different logit indices, and the wrong index inflates an inconsistency diagnostic 14 to 41 times. We give three checks that measure the convention. Our results concern predicting C for a fixed set, not what a dependency-aware decoder gains.
title: How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding

title_translated: 一个边缘规则能看到多少依赖？扩散语言模型并行解码中的总相关性
summary_translated: 一种掩码扩散语言模型之所以快速，是因为它每一步会确定多个词元。每个词元都从其自身的边缘分布中采样，因此词元之间的依赖关系丢失了，这种损失的大小即为所确定集合的条件总相关性C。大多数解码器从位置相关的边缘分布中选择集合，这可以界定C的上界但无法确定其具体值。我们探讨这些方法对其预测效果如何。我们在来自两个家族的四种掩码扩散语言模型上对固定候选集合估计了C。在其中三种模型上，仅基于边缘分布的最佳预测误差约为1比特（0.74至1.17），比仅知道上界的基线方法高出1.8到3.7倍，而大部分准确性来源于该上界本身。在子集上，我们的估计与并行提交的精确KL代价排序一致，但在散文文本中和其余文本仍被掩码时，其结果中位数低于精确值0.4至1.1比特。Dream-instruct是例外，尤其在散文文本中，其条件分布的一致性最差。在六种常见的边缘规则中，对集合进行汇总优于对最弱位置进行门控，在全部24组配对比较中均表现更优。测量需要经过验证的读出方式：Dream和LLaDA将位置预测放置在不同的logit索引上，错误索引会使不一致性诊断指标膨胀14至41倍。我们提出了三种检查方法来衡量这一约定。我们的研究关注的是对固定集合预测C的问题，而非依赖感知解码器所能获得的优势。
